IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Rejected universal exact identification from unrestricted positive text

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Gold 1967 formalizes learning in the limit and distinguishes positive text from informant presentations.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: identification in the limit; text; informant; superfinite class
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Given indefinitely accumulating accepted strings, infer every target language exactly without negative evidence or restrictive class conditions.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Finite successful observations never by themselves exclude an overgeneral language.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: Source-specific documented ancestry where cited; operational predicate and cross-domain constraint are present analytical reconstruction, not claimed historical wording.

LOCATORS: Table I p.452

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not retroactively name every source Evolved System Identification or assert that all branches descend from control. Gold 1967 formalizes learning in the limit and distinguishes positive text from informant presentations.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Reject universal eventual exact identification of a superfinite language class from arbitrary positive text. Preserve the distinct, warranted practice of stating the class, presentation, equivalence and success quantifiers; restricted positive-only results are not rejected.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A language-learning problem (target class, evidence presentation, learner, equivalence and convergence criterion).
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Finite successful observations never by themselves exclude an overgeneral language.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Gold’s impossibility addresses all learners and admissible positive presentations in the stated class. A finite pair of compatible languages illustrates finite ambiguity but is not itself the proof of nonidentification in the limit.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: The negative candidate and its accurate-limit assessment remain explicit. Positive-only observations leave unobserved strings unlabeled. A retains the universal negative as its own claim. B0025 supplies a broader positive rule and is a near-neighbor, not a replacement or duplicate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Prevents an unsupported unique machine from being mistaken for an identified target; directs acquisition toward genuinely distinguishing evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Mathematical impossibility, not an empirical productivity effect: Gold Table I and §9. Positive-only finite-language classes provide a boundary to the negative claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Researcher or engineer deciding whether a unique learned behavior is supportable.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Informant data; exact or approximate active queries; prior restriction of target class; prediction on a bounded input distribution; retain multiple compatible candidates.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An exact or eventual-general recovery assertion invokes arbitrary positive text over an unrestricted superfinite class; a finite trace summary with no such assertion is outside this negative claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known finite target alternatives with a proven distinguishing presentation, or a task requiring only a finite observed-trace summary.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: The negative theorem uses arbitrary positive texts and eventual exact identification of each member; altered probability, presentation or target class requires separate analysis.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Languages of strings; deployed state/time semantics are outside the theorem unless represented and justified.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Universal eventual convergence for every target and admissible text is different from finite consistency and from a learner knowing when it has converged. Retain the criticism of positive-only universal recovery without turning it into a claim that every restricted positive-only learner fails.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: No normative requirement is derived; this is a limit on descriptive inference.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Keep accepted examples, evidence presentation contract, allowed target class and the precise output equivalence criterion.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: Links to BH02 and BH03 as information-changing alternatives. Neither extra notation nor richer states alone supplies missing discriminating evidence.

input_conditions.original_value: Active queries C0202 can change information access; richer representations C0203 change the class but do not erase in distinguish ability.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Re-enter if negative evidence, oracle access or target-class restriction changes; do not carry old impossibility unchanged into a new problem.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: The unqualified candidate that positive-only observations suffice for exact recovery of every regular behavior is rejected. The retained constraint is to state class, presentation, equivalence and success criterion before claiming identifiability. Scope: Languages of strings; deployed state/time semantics are outside the theorem unless represented and justified.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. A change in class, presentation, oracle or success criterion invalidates the prior learnability judgment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The negative theorem uses arbitrary positive texts and eventual exact identification of each member; altered probability, presentation or target class requires separate analysis.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An exact/general reconstruction claim is based only on accepted traces with an unrestricted superfinite candidate class.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: If class is superfinite, presentation is arbitrary positive text, and claim is eventual exact identification for every class member, mark that recovery claim unsupported and retain ambiguity. PASS means this limit is represented accurately; FAIL means universal recovery is asserted; UNKNOWN means class/presentation are unspecified; INAPPLICABLE means no general exact-recovery claim.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. No direct transfer from DFA learning to adaptive asynchronous services or to semantic recovery of organizations.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: An identification guarantee must bind the target class H, information protocol I and success relation R. Limit identification, finite exact query learning, finite consistency and distributional approximation carry different premises and conclusions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: claim c, model class H, information protocol I, success relation R, evidence e
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Determine which language classes can be identified from which presentations, rather than attributing possibility to data volume alone.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Compare the asserted conclusion with the exact theorem’s class, teacher, presentation and equivalence premises; keep unestablished application premises visible instead of inferring them from finite fit.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s general positive constraint and the independent negative ancestry of A0201 only as a relation. The information/success tuple includes epsilon, delta and a named distribution when approximation is claimed; those variables are absent rather than zero for exact learning.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids promising unique or finite-time identification under an information model that cannot support it.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Gold supplies a conditional impossibility theorem; Angluin supplies a conditional constructive theorem. Neither is a field cost-benefit experiment.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: An engineer choosing whether further examples, negative labels or active tests can resolve a behavioral question.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: For a consumer asking only whether a recorded trace occurred, retain the trace with its provenance; language identification need not trigger.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A conclusion generalizes beyond recorded strings or claims a uniquely identified language/model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a consumer asking only whether a recorded trace occurred, retain the trace with its provenance; language identification need not trigger.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Specify finite alphabet or data theory, language class, presentation/admissible queries, naming/equivalence convention and exact versus distributional versus limit criterion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Formal languages and observable input/output behavior. Identical languages need not imply identical hidden implementation or human meaning.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Limit identification is eventual stable correctness without a known convergence point. Angluin exact-teacher and sampling results are separately quantified; language equality is not hidden implementation identity. Retain the Gold contrary result, but do not label the positive premise-matching rule rejected merely because one information regime is impossible.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Descriptive/theoretical claim; no authority to choose required behavior or perform queries follows from learnability.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Angluin 1987 distinguishes exact equivalence from sampling; Vaandrager–Melse2025 develops larger conformance fault domains.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Exact equivalence and sampling are distinct.
No unrestricted finite suite; conditional Wp/HSI guarantee and counterexamples for other methods.
Practical protocol tests are budgeted and harness-bound.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: For this conditional/theoretical claim, empirical replication cannot substitute for its assumptions and proof.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.JUSTIFICATION: No direct field validation of the whole claim was established. The relevant positive witness is: SOURCE-THEORETICAL: HSI/Wp satisfies the stated k-A completeness condition and an independently justified target lies in that domain.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.JUSTIFICATION: CONSTRUCTED from BH027 argument: machine M matches every tested prefix up to maximum length N and changes its output after N+1 repetitions; it defeats unrestricted finite-test equivalence.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.JUSTIFICATION: Conformance to a learned hypothesis is descriptive. Conformance to an intended specification additionally requires an authoritative specification. This property is not presented as a binding standard for an unidentified target.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: For deterministic complete Mealy specification H and implementation M in fault domain F, use an F-complete suite T: agreement on T implies equivalence. Without M∈F, preserve finite-test status or a distributional guarantee. Tool operation/availability does not alone establish the claimed payoff.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.JUSTIFICATION: Nondeterministic ioco and stochastic distribution comparison require different semantics; Mealy completeness is not portable unchanged.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: A larger mathematically complete fault domain still may not contain the real black-box implementation. Target membership in the chosen fault domain can be the difficult unresolved fact.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.JUSTIFICATION: Known input/output alphabet and observation semantics; deterministic complete Mealy model for the stated fault-domain results; justified F or independent sampling distribution with chosen epsilon/delta. Failure: Unknown state/access bound is treated as established, or finite random testing is reported as an exact teacher.

IDENTIFIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: Conditional theorem plus observed finite testing; exactness is not inferred merely from API naming. Nondeterministic ioco and stochastic distribution comparison require different semantics; Mealy completeness is not portable unchanged.

DATA_INFORMATIVENESS.JUSTIFICATION: What rules out an implementation that agrees on all tested traces and diverges later? The needed discriminator is: Establish fault-domain membership or obtain a longer separating trace; if neither is feasible downgrade the conclusion.

ESTIMATOR_ASSUMPTIONS.JUSTIFICATION: Known input/output alphabet and observation semantics; deterministic complete Mealy model for the stated fault-domain results; justified F or independent sampling distribution with chosen epsilon/delta.

UNCERTAINTY_CALIBRATION.JUSTIFICATION: Angluin sampling or the selected stochastic test has local distribution/sample assumptions. Exact equivalence, ioco incompleteness and empirical frequency are not a common confidence scale. See the record-specific oracle/statistical scope.

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: Unrestricted finite-suite impossibility and k-A completeness/counterexamples are proved in BH027; TLS uses practical bounded tests. These support conditional validity, not a universal test budget. Transfer beyond that population remains bounded by: Nondeterministic ioco and stochastic distribution comparison require different semantics; Mealy completeness is not portable unchanged.

ORACLE_OBSERVATION_RELIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: No mismatch found but completeness or M∈F is unestablished; unreliable output/reset also yields UNKNOWN for equivalence. A weak F excludes the very fault of concern; repeated random samples may miss rare/long counterexamples.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Initial-state and observation reproducibility for behavioral queries

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Angluin-style active learning presupposes repeatable membership access; Rivest–Schapire 1989 studies learning without reset.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Reset, homing sequence, strong connectivity, output query
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Replaying an input word may start from a different hidden state or return timing-dependent observations.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Replaying an input word may start from a different hidden state or return timing-dependent observations.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Strong connectivity and homing replace reset under a conditional probabilistic theorem.
Concrete protocol harness reset and timeout decisions.
Stochastic learner still requires step/reset interface.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. A reset-free finite strongly connected automaton result does not guarantee recovery of unreachable transient components.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Repeated words support a repeatable-state learning contract only when initial-state restoration or the specified state-revisitation mechanism and the observation mapping are justified.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: learner L, query harness Q, reset/homing contract R, observation map a, replay evidence E
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Replaying an input word may start from a different hidden state or return timing-dependent observations.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Separate process, session, account and environment state; record resetting, homing or other revisitation assumptions, and distinguish observed replay agreement from a universal restoration guarantee.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A’s initial-state evidence and B’s lifecycle/replay treatment identify the same failure: nominally repeated words can start from different states. B separates lifecycle contract from observed replay consistency. Homing under strong connectivity and a counterexample teacher is a conditional substitute for reset, not free reset. A’s oracle correctness remains BH03.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Prevents inconsistent query tables and false state distinctions caused by hidden session carryover or timing.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Reset-free learning is proved for specified finite-state access; TLS demonstrates fresh-process/socket handling. Neither proves all services are resettable or safely homed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Harness author and user of a learned behavioral model.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: If only a one-way observed session is available, preserve the session trace and do not pretend to answer arbitrary from-start queries.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Queries are interpreted as repeated experiments from one state, or a learner depends on revisitation of a modeled state.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If only a one-way observed session is available, preserve the session trace and do not pretend to answer arbitrary from-start queries.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Reset outcome/hidden persistence specified; observation timing and label map stable; a no-reset result states connectivity/homing and counterexample assumptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Process, session, device, account and external-service state may have different lifecycles; a new socket need not reset all of them.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Finite repeated observations support only those replays; they do not prove every future reset. Homing and reset use different premises and costs. Nondeterminism must not be inferred merely from forgotten state or timeout aggregation. Conversely, forcing a deterministic model does not explain true stochasticity.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: A reset/homing sequence may mutate real state. Legal/operational permission is an external premise, not granted by a learning theorem.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: Strong connectivity and homing replace reset under a conditional probabilistic theorem.
Concrete protocol harness reset and timeout decisions.
Stochastic learner still requires step/reset interface.

INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN.SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENT: Inspect harness and persistent stores; use replay comparisons as bounded observations, not exhaustive hidden-state proof. Repeat authorized traces under stated timing and compare labels; model known stochasticity rather than discarding inconvenient outputs.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: A valid lifecycle contract complements BH03 but does not make approximate equivalence exact. BH07 separately assesses whether the effects needed for reset are authorized and restorable.

input_conditions.original_value: C0204 supplies concrete experiment boundary; C0203 gives class-specific alternatives; C0214 prevents unknown oracle results becoming success.

original_value.CONFLICT: Repetition can be expensive or irreversible; strong connectivity may fail at terminal states.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A stale login/session/counter survives reset, so identical words get incompatible labels misread as distinct states.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Fresh process startup, database cleanup, device reboot and trace retries can exceed learner CPU cost.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Invalidate replay evidence when reset mechanism, environment, timing or persistent storage changes.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Nondeterminism must not be inferred merely from forgotten state or timeout aggregation. Conversely, forcing a deterministic model does not explain true stochasticity.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: SOURCE-THEORETICAL BH003: without strong connectivity or reset, a run can enter a terminal component and lose access to earlier states. A stale login/session/counter survives reset, so identical words get incompatible labels misread as distinct states.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Homing and stochastic/nondeterministic learners offer alternatives, each with narrowed promises and extra assumptions.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: A’s initial-state evidence and B’s lifecycle/replay treatment identify the same failure: nominally repeated words can start from different states. B separates lifecycle contract from observed replay consistency. Homing under strong connectivity and a counterexample teacher is a conditional substitute for reset, not free reset. A’s oracle correctness remains BH03.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: If hidden server/account state is not observed or reset, classify the learner premise UNKNOWN or contradicted by an actual divergence; do not infer a reset from a reconnect command.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: If only a one-way observed session is available, preserve the session trace and do not pretend to answer arbitrary from-start queries. Actual mechanism: Bind each query to initial-state semantics or use an explicit no-reset/homing method. Detect contradictory replay answers and distinguish stochastic variation from instrumentation error.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Repeated words support a repeatable-state learning contract only when initial-state restoration or the specified state-revisitation mechanism and the observation mapping are justified. B:BH003 is the inspected 1989 Rivest–Schapire work; the later expanded version is not an independently read replication. A:C001 supplies Moore’s experiments distinction; B:BH011 supplies concrete TLS harness boundaries.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.JUSTIFICATION: Angluin-style active learning presupposes repeatable membership access; Rivest–Schapire 1989 studies learning without reset. The present property wording is an engineering synthesis, not attributed verbatim to an originator.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: Access-contract reasoning and bounded replay evidence; not universal reproducibility from finitely many successful trials.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: The bounded sources establish Reset-free learning is proved for specified finite-state access; TLS demonstrates fresh-process/socket handling. Neither proves all services are resettable or safely homed. They do not estimate a comparative effect of adopting this entire property.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of the full engineering payoff was identified in the bounded search. Related versions/shared benchmark families are disclosed in sources.json; No general safe-reset solution for irreversible, distributed or adaptive services is established.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.JUSTIFICATION: EMPIRICAL BH011: fresh client processes and controlled server sessions implement documented portions of the query lifecycle. Scope and whether the setting is a field deployment, lab case or expert report must follow the cited source.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.JUSTIFICATION: SOURCE-THEORETICAL BH003: without strong connectivity or reset, a run can enter a terminal component and lose access to earlier states.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.JUSTIFICATION: A reset/homing sequence may mutate real state. Legal/operational permission is an external premise, not granted by a learning theorem. This property is not presented as a binding standard for an unidentified target.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Bind each query to initial-state semantics or use an explicit no-reset/homing method. Detect contradictory replay answers and distinguish stochastic variation from instrumentation error. Tool operation/availability does not alone establish the claimed payoff.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.JUSTIFICATION: A reset-free finite strongly connected automaton result does not guarantee recovery of unreachable transient components.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Reset can be unavailable; repeated observations cannot prove that all hidden state is identical. No general safe-reset solution for irreversible, distributed or adaptive services is established.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.JUSTIFICATION: Reset outcome/hidden persistence specified; observation timing and label map stable; a no-reset result states connectivity/homing and counterexample assumptions. records.title: Data abstraction, symbolic guards and register-memory adequacy

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Data abstraction, symbolic guards and register-memory adequacy

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Symbolic/register learning and practical protocol mappers address finite-alphabet explosion and data-dependent memory.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Effective Boolean algebra, symbolic automaton, register automaton, mapper
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Concrete values are too numerous for naive enumeration, while careless collapsing erases relevant distinctions.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Concrete values are too numerous for naive enumeration, while careless collapsing erases relevant distinctions.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Symbolic learning is conditional on alphabet theory/partition learning.
Register model and bounded comparative scalability; equality-specific query bound.
Protocol mapper controls visible alphabet.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. Large-alphabet symbolic learning is not an automatic register-memory, timing or concurrency guarantee.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Choose a data abstraction and machine class that preserve the consumer’s material distinctions, while retaining the class-specific data theory, memory and query premises.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: concrete behavior C, abstraction a, abstract model H, decision/property family Φ
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Concrete values are too numerous for naive enumeration, while careless collapsing erases relevant distinctions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Distinguish predicates over a current symbolic input from comparisons against stored register values. A nonce can be fresh on one step and equal to a previously stored value later; collapsing those cases can erase required behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A’s richer-class rule and B’s data-class account both reject borrowing finite-alphabet guarantees after changing the represented semantics. A also covers time, nondeterminism and stochasticity, whose facets move to BH06. B contributes the explicit abstraction map, equality/order theory, register bound and finite-index conditions. Neither richer syntax nor a register tool proves all data-rich protocols learnable.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Makes some data-rich systems learnable at useful size without silently changing the consumer’s question.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH013 proves theory-parametric symbolic learning; BH024 compares register learners with fewer queries on specified models. Live Mbed learning did not converge in the reported three-week run.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer deciding which data, time and protocol features a model must preserve.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A small fixed finite alphabet with no relevant cross-message data dependence can use an ordinary Mealy model.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Concrete alphabets/state explosion or parameter relations threaten a decision-relevant distinction; the claim being evaluated specifies whether that distinction must be preserved.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A small fixed finite alphabet with no relevant cross-message data dependence can use an ordinary Mealy model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A declared abstraction map, guard theory/data operations, target model class and property being preserved; reliable concrete query realization.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: A symbolic transition predicate classifies the current datum; a register can relate later inputs to stored earlier values. Neither supports arbitrary program semantics by default.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Adequacy is relative to a declared observation relation and consumer. Equality/register results do not automatically extend to ordered domains, arbitrary arithmetic or unbounded memory. Preserve real-system feasibility limits: the 2026 SLλ Mbed attempt remained inconclusive after three weeks; the 24 intermediate-hypothesis experiments are model relearning, not completed live extraction.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Abstraction is an epistemic design choice, not permission to omit required distinctions or redefine acceptable behavior.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: Symbolic learning is conditional on alphabet theory/partition learning.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Adequacy is relative to a declared observation relation and consumer. Equality/register results do not automatically extend to ordered domains, arbitrary arithmetic or unbounded memory.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Target representation, concrete observation map and class-specific learner.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. Changed datatype theory, timing resolution, hidden state or probability law invalidates the class-specific result.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Equality-only register guards, deterministic one-clock structure, residual-language equivalence, labeled-MDP observability or specified noise law as appropriate; never pool these premises.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Concrete alphabets/state explosion or parameter relations threaten a decision-relevant distinction; the claim being evaluated specifies whether that distinction must be preserved.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Distinguish predicates over a current symbolic input from comparisons against stored register values. A nonce can be fresh on one step and equal to a previously stored value later; collapsing those cases can erase required behavior. Evaluate only the named facet. Find a fresh/equal/order counterexample and determine whether the proposed class represents it; obtain concrete query translation evidence before claiming an implemented learner for the live service.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Specific conditional extensions and bounded benchmarks; no universal rich-system identification guarantee. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a nonce-echo protocol needs equality with a fresh stored value; a register model keeps that distinction while a justified property ignores the literal nonce.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: merging all timeouts into one label hides a deadline violation; applying a deterministic DFA theorem to that quotient does not repair the loss.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A finite alphabet abstraction demonstrably preserves the only property being queried.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Calling every unexplained output noise removes precisely the behavior the richer model should represent.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed datatype theory, timing resolution, hidden state or probability law invalidates the class-specific result.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: More expressive classes cost solver computation, resets, samples and complexity; some algorithms become exponential or time out. Cheaper route: A smaller abstraction justified for the particular property, direct tests at selected data/time boundaries, or a deliberately incomplete model.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not retroactively name every source Evolved System Identification or assert that all branches descend from control. Residual-language, register, timed and stochastic learning extend different parts of finite automata semantics.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Timed, nondeterministic and stochastic extensions require their own observation and equivalence contracts. Keep these as tagged alternatives; no single result supports all forms of behavioral variation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Target representation, concrete observation map and class-specific learner.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Finite alphabet abstraction can erase behavior relevant to the decision; “nondeterministic” names several different problems.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Record reset-time information for timed learning; separate unobserved output, quiescence and timeout for I/O conformance; identify sampling, confidence and convergence semantics for probabilities. Diagnose hidden state and scheduling separately.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Both packets reject treating richer model names as an extension of an unchanged finite deterministic guarantee. A includes smart versus normal one-clock teachers, residual finite automata and almost-sure asymptotic MDP results. B adds table-relative partial-IOTS bounds, the completeness-oracle premise, race-avoiding timers and symbolic-only prototype limits, and fault-injected stochastic protocol models.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Can represent distinctions a finite quotient loses; may reduce model size or interactions, at added access/computation cost.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Register normal-form result; timed teacher complexity contrast; residual automata succinctness; MDP asymptotic result and small noisy benchmarks. These are complementary, not independent proof of one universal method.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer choosing a representation and admissible learning process.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A smaller abstraction justified for the particular property, direct tests at selected data/time boundaries, or a deliberately incomplete model.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Timing, timer races, multiple outputs, quiescence, scheduling or probabilities materially affect the modeled behavior or the claim made about it.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A finite alphabet abstraction demonstrably preserves the only property being queried.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Equality-only register guards, deterministic one-clock structure, residual-language equivalence, labeled-MDP observability or specified noise law as appropriate; never pool these premises.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: A nondeterministic language recognizer is distinct from an interactive system with hidden branching; measurement noise is distinct from true stochastic behavior.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Almost-sure convergence is asymptotic and is not finite-sample exactness. Nondeterministic languages are not hidden-process identification. Partial ioco bounds are relative to the tested table; zero observations do not establish zero probability. Preserve cost, oracle realizability, finite evidence and semantics mismatch. Do not merge stochastic noise, scheduling choice and unmodeled durable state merely because each yields variable observations.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.JUSTIFICATION: I/O automata translations, approximate nondeterministic ioco learning, and timed/stochastic extensions provide distinct alternatives to deterministic finite-state traces. The present property wording is an engineering synthesis, not attributed verbatim to an originator.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: Several native conditional guarantees, not a single unified confidence ladder.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: BH012 gives table-relative lower/upper models but leaves completeness-query implementation assumed; BH025 proves symbolic/concrete realization under race avoidance but prototype uses symbolic model access; BH026 compares statistical learners on simulated models.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of the full engineering payoff was identified in the bounded search. Related versions/shared benchmark families are disclosed in sources.json; Unknown output completeness, nonstationary adaptation and live timing calibration remain material.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.JUSTIFICATION: No direct field validation of the whole claim was established. The relevant positive witness is: SOURCE-THEORETICAL BH012: H− and H+ bound the SUL under the explicitly table-restricted conformance relation.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.JUSTIFICATION: SOURCE-IMPLEMENTATION LIMIT BH025: symbolic BFS equivalence in a prototype cannot establish tested concrete timing robustness.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.JUSTIFICATION: No theorem about possible outputs legitimizes an intervention that exposes them. This property is not presented as a binding standard for an unidentified target.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Distinguish output-set inclusion from exact trace equivalence, stochastic distribution tests from deterministic equality, and symbolic timer queries from concrete timed observations. Preserve unobserved-output uncertainty. Tool operation/availability does not alone establish the claimed payoff.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.JUSTIFICATION: A theorem for one timer class or output-determined I/O automata does not transfer to unrestricted concurrent services.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: The special query/completeness assumptions may relocate rather than solve real observability problems. Unknown output completeness, nonstationary adaptation and live timing calibration remain material.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.JUSTIFICATION: Chosen IOTS/input-enabledness or MMT/stochastic class; quiescence observation rule; race avoidance where invoked; reliable repeated sampling and fixed distributions for statistical tests. Failure: Timeout is treated as semantic quiescence, absent outputs as impossible, or a significance test as proof of distribution equality.

IDENTIFIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: Several native conditional guarantees, not a single unified confidence ladder. A theorem for one timer class or output-determined I/O automata does not transfer to unrestricted concurrent services.

DATA_INFORMATIVENESS.JUSTIFICATION: Is the variation true stochasticity, unobserved state, scheduling, or measurement error? The needed discriminator is: Vary timing/history under controlled permission; compare output-set and frequency predictions on independent traces.

ESTIMATOR_ASSUMPTIONS.JUSTIFICATION: Chosen IOTS/input-enabledness or MMT/stochastic class; quiescence observation rule; race avoidance where invoked; reliable repeated sampling and fixed distributions for statistical tests.

UNCERTAINTY_CALIBRATION.JUSTIFICATION: Angluin sampling or the selected stochastic test has local distribution/sample assumptions. Exact equivalence, ioco incompleteness and empirical frequency are not a common confidence scale. See the record-specific oracle/statistical scope.

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: BH012 gives table-relative lower/upper models but leaves completeness-query implementation assumed; BH025 proves symbolic/concrete realization under race avoidance but prototype uses symbolic model access; BH026 compares statistical learners on simulated models. Transfer beyond that population remains bounded by: A theorem for one timer class or output-determined I/O automata does not transfer to unrestricted concurrent services.

ORACLE_OBSERVATION_RELIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: Output completeness, time calibration, stationarity or oracle realization remains unestablished. Treating zero observations as impossibility or non-rejection as equality yields false positives; overly conservative timing thresholds can hide real distinctions.

REPRESENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Distinguish output-set inclusion from exact trace equivalence, stochastic distribution tests from deterministic equality, and symbolic timer queries from concrete timed observations. Preserve unobserved-output uncertainty. Do not collapse adversarial nondeterminism, hidden-state uncertainty, timing jitter and probabilistic transitions into one noise parameter.

DECISION_USE_VALIDITY.JUSTIFICATION: Learner/harness designer facing asynchronous or variable responses. Expected payoff: Avoids false deterministic models and inappropriate equivalence or confidence claims. Evidence: BH012 gives table-relative lower/upper models but leaves completeness-query implementation assumed; BH025 proves symbolic/concrete realization under race avoidance but prototype uses symbolic model access; BH026 compares statistical learners on simulated models.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Protocol observations and active experiments must be bound to the actual implementation, version, role, backend, credentials, concurrency, timing and allowed effects; generalized reuse may not silently enlarge that envelope.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A concrete protocol/API experiment and its resulting behavioral claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: The same messages can have different effects under different authentication, persistent state, configuration or concurrent clients.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Both versions require version/context binding and separate authorization for effectful queries. Agreement supports the inferential discipline, not a universal empirical benefit. A’s guard covers a generalized observation asserted or reused even in its original environment. B’s text emphasizes active exploration and cross-environment transfer; retain A’s wider assessment guard so passive but generalized claims cannot evade attribution review.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids claiming that one learned machine represents all protocol implementations and avoids invalid query semantics.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: TLS state-fuzzing cases demonstrate flaw-finding feasibility; ChatAFL demonstrates bounded test improvements. No universal experiment-authorization doctrine is claimed from these papers.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Protocol debugger, test author or security reviewer interpreting specific executions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Read existing documentation, inspect a narrow source slice, replay authorized examples, or use passive observations when active effects are not permitted.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An active stateful protocol experiment is performed, or a learned/generalized protocol observation is asserted or reused as evidence. Missing authorization/reset/version evidence does not switch the guard off.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: No active stateful protocol experiment is performed and no learned/generalized protocol observation is asserted or reused; only a supplied concrete message or example is described.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: The tested context and abstraction are recorded; initial-state meaning, asynchronous responses and persistent effects are accounted for.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Credentials, clients, timing, versions and durable side effects are part of the experiment boundary, even if outside the learner’s abstract state.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: The conclusion is about the named version/configuration/observation horizon. Historic implementation flaws and an old suite result do not characterize every current implementation of the protocol. Technical reachability is not permission. Reconnect need not restore account/backend state. A validated authorization boundary does not itself establish the state-reset or observation premise.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: A separate explicit authorization or applicable task scope permits concrete operations. Observed acceptance by the server is not permission.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A concrete protocol/API experiment and its resulting behavioral claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The tested context and abstraction are recorded; initial-state meaning, asynchronous responses and persistent effects are accounted for.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An active stateful protocol experiment is performed, or a learned/generalized protocol observation is asserted or reused as evidence. Missing authorization/reset/version evidence does not switch the guard off.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Bind each claim to its concrete harness and state boundary, separately establish permission for the actual effects, and invalidate attribution after relevant context changes. Merge the same target using A’s broader guard; an already applicable passive generalized claim cannot become INAPPLICABLE merely because no new exploration or transfer occurs.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.rationale: Operational rule derived from the source-supported limit/mechanism; not claimed as a verbatim theorem or universally mandatory process.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Feasibility and bounded testing evidence for particular versions; not all implementations, safe production probing or universal security assurance. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: an authorized lab API fixture records its build, credential role and mapper. Its reset actually restores the modeled server counter to zero, as a raw read confirms. The report attributes the resulting response only to that recorded context. The protocol-boundary predicate is PASS.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: an authorized lab API fixture permits advance and read operations on a server-side counter. After advance changes the durable counter from zero to one, the adapter closes and reopens the socket and declares the modeled state reset to zero. A raw read after reconnect returns one, but the report attributes that response to the all-zero initial context. This demonstrated state/context misbinding is FAIL for C0204 even though every operation was authorized; it does not depend on a normative judgment about the API.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: A protocol experiment or generalized observation claim is present, but relevant implementation/state/credential binding, restoration evidence, observation-map meaning or effect authorization is missing or inconclusive. Absence of this evidence is UNKNOWN; a demonstrated wrong attribution or effect breach is FAIL.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No active stateful protocol experiment is performed and no learned/generalized protocol observation is asserted or reused; only a supplied concrete message or example is described.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: A test fixture can appear isolated while sharing persistent backend state.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Overly broad effect classification can block a harmless direct example already authorized.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Declaring the entire environment the model boundary without observing it provides no assurance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Build/config/credential/adapter/timeouts or concurrency changes re-open affected findings.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Harness engineering, restoration, rate limits, interpretive work and replay can exceed learner computation. Cheaper route: Read existing documentation, inspect a narrow source slice, replay authorized examples, or use passive observations when active effects are not permitted.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Feasibility and bounded testing evidence for particular versions; not all implementations, safe production probing or universal security assurance.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The precise scoped operational rule is satisfied with sufficient stated evidence; does not imply stronger truth, universality or adoption.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.FAIL: A valid witness or directly established mismatch contradicts that operational rule in its applicable context.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: The guard may apply but evidence, mapping, premise or computation is insufficient; this is neither pass nor logical negation.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The declared guard is false; use the named non-trigger route rather than treating absence as failure.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Technical reachability is not permission. Reconnect need not restore account/backend state. A validated authorization boundary does not itself establish the state-reset or observation premise.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed: an authorized lab API fixture permits advance and read operations on a server-side counter. After advance changes the durable counter from zero to one, the adapter closes and reopens the socket and declares the modeled state reset to zero. A raw read after reconnect returns one, but the report attributes that response to the all-zero initial context. This demonstrated state/context misbinding is FAIL for C0204 even though every operation was authorized; it does not depend on a normative judgment about the API.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Use a smaller authorized experiment, passive trace analysis or explicit uncertainty; retain findings without pretending completeness.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Both versions require version/context binding and separate authorization for effectful queries. Agreement supports the inferential discipline, not a universal empirical benefit. A’s guard covers a generalized observation asserted or reused even in its original environment. B’s text emphasizes active exploration and cross-environment transfer; retain A’s wider assessment guard so passive but generalized claims cannot evade attribution review.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: For an actual deployment obtain exact version/configuration, effect permissions, state restoration and observation mapping. No target was inspected and no live experiment is authorized by this research.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: Do not require a universal protocol graph before answering a narrow API question.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Protocol observations and active experiments must be bound to the actual implementation, version, role, backend, credentials, concurrency, timing and allowed effects; generalized reuse may not silently enlarge that envelope. A:C011 was partial TLS access; B:BH011 reads the same work more fully, including nine implementations, harness details, Empty timeouts of 100–1500 ms and initial ClientHello outside the selected alphabet. This improves accessible qualification, not the study’s population or independence.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.JUSTIFICATION: Protocol-state learning combines automata algorithms with concrete cryptographic/session harnesses; TLS2015 exposes instance/version limits. The present property wording is an engineering synthesis, not attributed verbatim to an originator.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: The central claim here is an engineering/interpretive use condition, not a claimed published universal mathematical theorem. Native formal subresults are identified separately where used.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: The bounded sources establish TLS2015 tests nine implementation families with explicit versions and harness choices; it finds concrete flaws. The study is not proof that the same behavior holds across versions/configurations. They do not estimate a comparative effect of adopting this entire property.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of the full engineering payoff was identified in the bounded search. Related versions/shared benchmark families are disclosed in sources.json; Private account state, third-party actions and production-specific failures may remain inaccessible.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.JUSTIFICATION: EMPIRICAL BH011: a model is reported against the named TLS implementation release, selected role/messages and timeout choices. Scope and whether the setting is a field deployment, lab case or expert report must follow the cited source.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.JUSTIFICATION: CONSTRUCTED: unchanged client binary uses a server-side policy flag that changes retry/authentication behavior; old model bytes remain unchanged but applicability fails.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.JUSTIFICATION: Experiment authority is externally granted. Read-only research does not authorize probing, resetting accounts, payment/order creation or destructive actions. A learned model supplies no normative API contract by itself. This property is not presented as a binding standard for an unidentified target.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Record and enforce an experiment envelope including credentials, resets, timeouts, concurrency, external state and allowed mutations; attach each model claim to that envelope. Tool operation/availability does not alone establish the claimed payoff.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.JUSTIFICATION: A successful test-server model is not automatically a valid production or protocol-standard model.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: The envelope can be incompletely known, and shadow/test environments can differ precisely at the behavior of interest. Private account state, third-party actions and production-specific failures may remain inaccessible.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.JUSTIFICATION: Access to a test instance and a truthful environment inventory; experiment permission is established separately; state/observation contracts are feasible. Failure: Same executable with a changed feature flag, credential or backend gives behavior outside the old learned envelope.

IDENTIFIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: This record evaluates protocol experiment, version and effect envelope, not a unique parameter/system-identification theorem. It does not infer hidden-implementation uniqueness.

DATA_INFORMATIVENESS.JUSTIFICATION: Which environment difference could change the downstream conclusion? The needed discriminator is: Obtain an authorized distinguishing test or configuration/deployment correspondence witness; otherwise keep the transfer unknown.

ESTIMATOR_ASSUMPTIONS.JUSTIFICATION: Access to a test instance and a truthful environment inventory; experiment permission is established separately; state/observation contracts are feasible.

UNCERTAINTY_CALIBRATION.JUSTIFICATION: The stated uncertainty is qualitative scope/correspondence/authority uncertainty; no numeric posterior or calibrated probability is asserted.

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: TLS2015 tests nine implementation families with explicit versions and harness choices; it finds concrete flaws. The study is not proof that the same behavior holds across versions/configurations. Transfer beyond that population remains bounded by: A successful test-server model is not automatically a valid production or protocol-standard model.

ORACLE_OBSERVATION_RELIABILITY.JUSTIFICATION: Authority, persistent state or a relevant deployment/version dimension is unavailable; do not infer permission or equivalence. A new socket can hide surviving account state; a sanitized replica may omit the fault while still matching ordinary traces.

REPRESENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Record and enforce an experiment envelope including credentials, resets, timeouts, concurrency, external state and allowed mutations; attach each model claim to that envelope. Include deployment/network/authentication/session and concurrent-client conditions, not only executable bytes.

DECISION_USE_VALIDITY.JUSTIFICATION: Protocol engineer, compatibility tester or security reviewer deciding what a model establishes. Expected payoff: Makes observed behavior reproducible enough to assess and prevents invalid version/protocol-wide generalization. Evidence: TLS2015 tests nine implementation families with explicit versions and harness choices; it finds concrete flaws. The study is not proof that the same behavior holds across versions/configurations.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.canonical_ceiling: The conclusion is about the named version/configuration/observation horizon. Historic implementation flaws and an old suite result do not characterize every current implementation of the protocol. For an actual deployment obtain exact version/configuration, effect permissions, state restoration and observation mapping. No target was inspected and no live experiment is authorized by this research.
EVIDENCE_CEILING.source_access_comparison: A:C011 was partial TLS access; B:BH011 reads the same work more fully, including nine implementations, harness details, Empty timeouts of 100–1500 ms and initial ClientHello outside the selected alphabet. This improves accessible qualification, not the study’s population or independence.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Mined regularities remain candidates whose stated status must match finite support, reliable falsifiers, proof premises and independent challenges. The truth of a candidate and the accuracy of its reported status are separate evaluated propositions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A candidate predicate/temporal pattern and the executions, code and assumptions supporting it.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Tests and templates can produce accidental regularities and omit relevant properties.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Keep the candidate language/program points, generating traces, counterexamples, independent validation and assumptions. Evaluate φ over a stated trace set or proof domain separately from whether a report faithfully describes that evaluation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Both packets forbid turning observed support into universal validity or normative authority. A evaluates promotion fidelity and includes unsafe ownership/nonaliasing premises in Daikon/ESC proofs. B’s predicate evaluates φ itself over T or a proof domain and includes temporal-mining selection and bug-contamination evidence. Their opposite verdicts on a correctly reported refuted candidate are valid.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Reduces unexamined accidental invariants while using mined proposals to focus reasoning effort.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Daikon examples expose incidental bounds; integration with ESC/Java finds useful verifiable candidates and tool defects but also reveals unsafe assumptions and incompleteness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Developer evaluating regression properties, documentation or verification annotations.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Write a small direct assertion from a requirement, inspect a known invariant, or retain a descriptive trace summary.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Assess the reporting/promotion claim when one is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed, and independently assess the candidate truth/support claim over its declared finite T or broader D when that claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. Finite-T truth does not require extrapolation. An exploratory status report can trigger reporting fidelity without asserting candidate truth. Unknown premises affect the verdict, not the existence of either claim-specific guard.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Apply each named target separately. No status report/promotion claim leaves reporting fidelity INAPPLICABLE; no truth/support claim over T or D leaves candidate truth INAPPLICABLE. A bare stored proposal without either claim is the exploratory cheap path. An honest exploratory or UNKNOWN report is not automatically outside reporting assessment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Instrumentation semantics are adequate, generating data are documented, validation checks the intended property and proof assumptions are disclosed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: A mined value invariant and a temporal protocol are different candidate languages; neither spans every property.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: ∀t∈T φ(t) is finite consistency. A universal program property needs its proof assumptions. Finding one t with ¬φ(t) refutes that underlying claim while accurate reporting can still PASS the promotion-fidelity predicate. Do not delete refuted or unproved candidates from the denominator or turn checker UNKNOWN into false. Candidate generation from buggy behavior can faithfully summarize a defect.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Behavioral validity is separate from desired validity; normative adoption follows C0206’s independent-authority condition.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Generator template/prompt, source/build, variable/program point, trace/test generation, all imposed verification annotations.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH10 must independently supply intended behavior. BH23 governs reporting; its PASS can coexist with a candidate-level FAIL or UNKNOWN.

input_conditions.original_value: C0214 governs inconclusive validation; C0206 governs normative promotion; C0207 can expose static/runtime mismatches.

original_value.CONFLICT: Increasing template expressivity creates more spurious candidates and review burden; filtering can hide rare legitimate behavior.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unjustified ownership/nonaliasing makes verification conditional on a false premise; test-range bounds can disappear under new input.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Instrumentation, candidate explosion, validation and expert review; target the few candidates the decision needs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire candidates disproved by valid counterexamples; re-enter after code/input/instrumentation/semantic changes.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For the identified candidate, report, evidence version and declared domain, assess whether each reported evidential status and promotion is justified by available observations, falsifiers, proof results and disclosed premises. This quantifies report fidelity, not the truth of φ. Mined value invariants and temporal protocols remain distinct candidate languages. An accurate report of refutation or unresolved truth may satisfy this predicate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A report or promotion claim about candidate φ, together with its declared domain, executions, code, proof outcomes and assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. Change to code, test distribution, template language or proof annotations reopens supporting evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Candidate meaning, instrumentation and provenance must be adequate to judge the particular report. Disclosed unknown premises can support an honest UNKNOWN report; their truth is not an entry requirement for this reporting assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A report or promotion claim about the evidential status of an inferred candidate is asserted, relied upon, or expressly assessed. This includes a reported exploratory, refuted, or UNKNOWN status; downstream promotion is not required. Missing evidence or unresolved premises do not by themselves make this guard false.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: First identify the report/promotion claim R, candidate φ, declared domain and available evidence E. PASS when R faithfully states what E establishes, refutes or leaves UNKNOWN, including relevant scope limits, counterexamples, proof premises and unresolved conditions. Thus an honest refutation report can PASS while φ FAILs, and an honest UNKNOWN report can PASS while φ remains UNKNOWN. FAIL only on an established mismatch between R and E, such as suppressing a reliable falsifier, reporting an unsupported universal or normative promotion, or presenting a timeout as proof or refutation. A counterexample to φ is not by itself a counterexample to reporting fidelity. UNKNOWN when the meaning of R, provenance or evidence is insufficient to determine fidelity. INAPPLICABLE only when no report/promotion claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.rationale: Operational rule derived from the source-supported limit/mechanism; not claimed as a verbatim theorem or universally mandatory process.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Bind the exact report/status and declared domain to the generator, source/build, program points, trace/test evidence and proof annotations; compare the claimed status with retained outcomes and disclosed limitations.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: The exact candidate, report/status or promotion claim, declared domain and versioned provenance linking the report to generating observations and inference rules.
Supporting and falsifying observations, challenge or proof outcomes, including inconclusive results, disclosed assumptions and any independent normative basis actually claimed.
Enough evidence to compare the report with what was actually observed or proved; an honest UNKNOWN report requires a documented limitation, not a proof of the candidate.
Generator template/prompt, source/build, variable/program point, trace/test generation and imposed verification annotations, to the extent load-bearing for the reported claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Select reporting fidelity as the target before applying the guard. Establish what the report actually claims and compare it with evidence and known limits. Treat a candidate falsifier as evidence for an honest refutation report, and an inconclusive proof as evidence for an honest UNKNOWN report. Decide PASS or FAIL only for fidelity; use UNKNOWN when that comparison is unresolved and INAPPLICABLE only when the reporting target is absent.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Useful candidate generation and conditional validation, not universal or normative completeness. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: φ is x>0 over T={x=2,x=0}; retained x=0 refutes φ, and the report says REFUTED with that domain and witness. Reporting fidelity PASSes while candidate truth FAILs. Separately, a documented proof timeout accurately reported as UNKNOWN can PASS reporting while candidate truth remains UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: the report calls φ universally proved despite the retained in-domain x=0 falsifier, or calls a timeout proof of ¬φ. This mismatch FAILs reporting. The original incidental-bound example also FAILs reporting when tests only construct arrays of length 7–13 but the report promotes that range to all legal callers.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: The report/promotion claim applies, but evidence or meaning is insufficient to establish either fidelity or a mismatch. If uncertainty itself is known and accurately disclosed without stronger promotion, reporting can PASS while candidate truth is UNKNOWN. Missing or unknown premises never make the guard false by themselves.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No candidate-status report or promotion claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. A bare unreported proposal may follow the cheap exploratory route; an explicitly exploratory status report can still be assessed for fidelity.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: Treating unchecked provenance, a shared test generator or unsafe proof premise as sufficient basis for a stronger report can produce a false reporting PASS.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Failing an honest report merely because its candidate was refuted or remained unproved confuses reporting fidelity with candidate truth.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Filtering away every difficult candidate yields an impressive acceptance rate without useful coverage.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Change to code, test distribution, template language or proof annotations reopens supporting evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Instrumentation, candidate explosion, validation and expert review; target the few candidates the decision needs. Cheaper route: Write a small direct assertion from a requirement, inspect a known invariant, or retain a descriptive trace summary.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Evidence-bounded fidelity of the identified report or promotion. Reporting PASS can coexist with candidate FAIL or UNKNOWN and supplies no independent normative authority.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The report or promotion accurately describes available evidence, scope, proof premises and unresolved limits. Accurate reporting of a refuted or UNKNOWN candidate can PASS; candidate truth and normative adoption do not follow.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.FAIL: An established mismatch falsifies the reporting/promotion claim: for example a retained falsifier is hidden, an unsupported status leap is asserted, or timeout/UNKNOWN is reported as proof or refutation. A falsifier of φ alone does not FAIL an honest report.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: A reporting/promotion claim applies, but its meaning, evidence, mapping or provenance is insufficient to decide fidelity. A known unresolved premise can be reported accurately and does not automatically make reporting UNKNOWN.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No report or promotion claim about candidate status is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. Merely calling a report exploratory does not switch off a reporting-fidelity assessment.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: Fidelity of candidate promotion/status to available evidence
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATION_FACET: As specifically named in EVALUATED_PROPOSITION; no implication to a different target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATION_TARGET_PRIORITY: Apply the reporting/promotion target, its guard and its outcome rules together. Candidate truth is the distinct target in ESI-RPG-BH08-02; no candidate counterexample or inconclusive proof is automatically a reporting failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.
