PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For finite T, evaluate exactly ∀t∈T:φ(a(t)) on the declared applicable observations, retaining extraction, missingness and denominator. For a broader D, evaluate ∀x∈D:φ(x), or the explicitly conditional proposition H⇒φ in the stated model M, without changing the target. A sound proof or analysis must cover that exact domain and semantics. Finite support alone does not establish the broader claim; explicitly empty T yields only vacuous finite consistency and no evidence of broader validity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Only instrumented values/events and executed conditions initially support the candidate; unexecuted paths remain open.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Finite observed executions first; universal “always” only with an additional proof in a stated program model.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Candidate language, program points, trace/test generation, missingness and statistical/filter choices must be adequate for the asserted scope. Broader proof claims retain their model, premises and applicability obligations. Unresolved premises affect the verdict rather than cancelling the truth-claim guard.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A truth or bounded-support claim for an inferred candidate φ is asserted, relied upon, or expressly assessed over a declared finite trace set T or a broader declared domain D. A claim confined to T suffices; extrapolation beyond T is not required. Missing evidence or unresolved premises do not by themselves make this guard false.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: First identify the candidate truth claim and its declared T or D. For finite T, PASS exactly when every declared applicable observation is interpretable and satisfies φ under the stated extraction map; explicitly empty T establishes only the vacuous finite statement. For a broader D, PASS only with a sound proof or analysis covering the exact claim and its premises; a conditional theorem establishes only its stated conditional target unless applicability of its premises to the receiving subject is established. FAIL when a reliable in-domain witness falsifies that exact candidate claim. Missing observations, ambiguous semantics, inconclusive proof, timeout, or an unestablished or invalidated proof premise yield UNKNOWN in the absence of a reliable in-domain falsifier; loss of a proof warrant alone does not prove ¬φ. INAPPLICABLE only when no candidate truth/support claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. Evaluate truthful reporting separately; its PASS neither proves φ nor overrides φ’s FAIL or UNKNOWN.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: Native set/conditional-conformance structure where identified; application guards and four-valued verdict discipline are this research’s operational reconstruction.

OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect templates, trace extraction and filter settings.
Re-evaluate candidate on traces with explicit missingness; record where static/proof checks add scope.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: The exact candidate φ, asserted or assessed finite T or broader D, extraction map a, program points, versions and applicable observation boundaries.
All relevant support and falsifier records with missingness, selection/filter settings and denominators; a reliable in-domain counterexample may decide FAIL without establishing every other premise.
For a broader claim, a sound proof/analysis tied to the declared model and explicit premises; distinguish a proved conditional theorem from applicability of its premises to the receiving subject.
Observed regularity is descriptive. Intended requirements and acceptability require the separate normative-adoption basis of ESI-RC-BH10.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Select the candidate truth claim and its exact finite T or broader D before evaluating. Check reliable in-domain falsifiers and declared observation/proof coverage. Return finite-T PASS only for that set, broader PASS only for a valid scope-matching argument, FAIL only for an actual falsifier of the exact target, and UNKNOWN for unresolved warrant without such a falsifier. Do not turn a missing premise into INAPPLICABLE or a failed proof into ¬φ. Assess the report of this result separately.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Checking a predicate on a finite trace set is decidable when its predicates are executable. Universal program invariance is not generally decided by dynamic inference.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.DESCRIPTION: EMPIRICAL BH006: candidate templates are eliminated by observed counterexamples and surviving statements are labeled likely. Constructed finite-domain discriminator: φ is x>0 and explicitly declared T contains x=2 and x=3 with reliable extraction; ∀t∈T φ(t) PASSes without any claim beyond T.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.DESCRIPTION: EMPIRICAL/EXAMPLE BH006: a test-suite-induced array-length range does not characterize all legal inputs. Constructed truth discriminator: φ is x>0 over declared T containing x=0; candidate truth FAILs even when the report faithfully says REFUTED. A proof-premise violation without such an in-domain falsifier leaves truth UNKNOWN.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: A truth/support claim applies, but observations, semantics, proof warrant, premise applicability or coverage are unresolved and no reliable in-domain falsifier is available. An invalidated premise defeats that proof warrant without by itself refuting φ. Explicit unknown premises are UNKNOWN for the affected truth claim, not INAPPLICABLE; a conditional theorem retains only its exact conditional scope.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No candidate truth/support claim over finite T or broader D is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. A status-only report or uninterpreted stored proposal can leave this predicate INAPPLICABLE even if reporting fidelity is assessed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Vacuous preconditions, rare-event filtering and selecting tests after seeing the candidate can inflate support.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Vacuous preconditions, rare-event filtering and selecting tests after seeing the candidate can inflate support. A checker/diagram/oracle interface existing is never itself the property witness.

EVALUATION_SEMANTICS.PASS: The exact finite-T statement holds on every declared applicable observation with adequate interpretation, or the exact broader/conditional statement has a sound proof or analysis with the required premises and scope. Finite-T PASS does not establish a broader D or normative requirement.
EVALUATION_SEMANTICS.FAIL: A reliable witness within declared T or D falsifies the exact candidate truth claim. For an H⇒φ target, the witness must satisfy H and falsify φ. An invalidated proof premise alone is not such a witness.
EVALUATION_SEMANTICS.UNKNOWN: The candidate truth claim applies but relevant observations, semantics, domain coverage, proof warrant or premise applicability are unresolved, and no reliable in-domain falsifier decides it. A failed proof or timeout is not candidate falsity.
EVALUATION_SEMANTICS.INAPPLICABLE: No candidate truth/support claim over T or D is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed; a stored proposal or status-only report without an underlying truth claim does not trigger this predicate.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Do not delete refuted or unproved candidates from the denominator or turn checker UNKNOWN into false. Candidate generation from buggy behavior can faithfully summarize a defect.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed: tests only create arrays of length7–13; declaring that range an invariant for all callers confuses generator coverage with program constraint.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Record assumption discharge and distinguish disproof from failure to prove; use independent challenges and retain unknown.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Both packets forbid turning observed support into universal validity or normative authority. A evaluates promotion fidelity and includes unsafe ownership/nonaliasing premises in Daikon/ESC proofs. B’s predicate evaluates φ itself over T or a proof domain and includes temporal-mining selection and bug-contamination evidence. Their opposite verdicts on a correctly reported refuted candidate are valid.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Determine the actual candidate domain, retained failures and proof assumptions. No generic precision/recall or utility estimate follows from selective case studies.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A long invariant list or high count is not quality evidence; maintain only candidates with a consumer.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Mined regularities remain candidates whose stated status must match finite support, reliable falsifiers, proof premises and independent challenges. The truth of a candidate and the accuracy of its reported status are separate evaluated propositions. A:C012/B:BH006 share Daikon ancestry; A:C013’s ESC result carries unsafe ownership assumptions and true-but-unproved cases. B:BH007’s X11 traces contain bugs. B:BH008 counts author labeling decisions, not elapsed effort; BH009’s 7,611→142→56 funnel is selective, not review of every candidate.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Observed implementation behavior, mined frequency or successful verification alone does not entail that the behavior is required, permitted or institutionally authoritative.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A proposed requirement or policy whose supporting evidence includes observed behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Consistent bugs, missing obligations and historical workarounds can be accurately reconstructed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Separate a descriptive premise from the normative rule and its source. A system may repeatedly implement a bug, and a proof can establish conformance to the wrong intended rule.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retain A’s rejected candidate independently of B0032’s positive adoption mechanism. The original A predicate assesses whether a particular normative adoption has an independent basis. That valid contextual assessment is not truth of the rejected universal descriptive-to-normative entailment.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Prevents regression tests or discovered workflows from institutionalizing defects merely because they are frequent.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: TLS cases show actual behavior containing flaws; mining papers depend on correctness premises and review. The general descriptive-to-normative non-entailment is analytical, not a randomized effect claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Actor choosing requirements, compatibility behavior or enforcement.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Treat property as descriptive; consult existing authoritative requirements; negotiate an explicit compatibility exception; preserve uncertainty.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An observed or mined property is proposed as mandatory, permitted, accepted or enforceable; descriptive-only reporting is outside this promotion assessment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: The artifact claims only that a behavior was observed under a stated context.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A legitimate source of authority and purpose can be identified; observations inform but do not themselves supply this source.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Normative authority may preserve existing behavior intentionally, including compatibility constraints, but the reason must be independent of mere frequency.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: A counterexample in which behavior conflicts with an applicable requirement defeats universal normative entailment. Independent adoption of a particular behavior does not vindicate that universal entailment. Keep normativity explicit. A frequent trace, formally elegant model, interviewee agreement or LLM explanation cannot by itself appoint an authority.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Named stakeholder/contract/policy decision with scope and revision conditions; no authority is inferred from this research packet.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Separate observation evidence, intended requirement source, adopting actor/decision and unresolved conflicts.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH10 is a complementary positive route. BH08 can supply descriptive candidates and BH23 evaluator limits, but their conjunction still lacks the authority premise.

input_conditions.original_value: C0205 validates factual regularity; C0212 uses an independent desired property; C0210 preserves perspective and intervention boundaries.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: If no legitimate authority is known, normative status remains unknown even if behavioral validity is certain.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: A lightweight adoption statement may suffice; no universal approval bureaucracy follows.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Reconsider after changed goal, stakeholder, rule, environment or discovered conflict.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: What the evidence actually says happened or holds in the implementation.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.source_access_comparison: A:C011 supplies historical TLS implementation discrepancies; A:C013 makes proof assumptions visible; A:C018 and C020 show the distinction between observed practice and legitimate prescription. These have different evidential roles, not one pooled causal estimate.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Independent basis and correspondence for normative promotion

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Specification-mining cases confront the difference between code regularity and an independently intended protocol.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Correct protocol, specification debugging, intended versus observed behavior
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: A learned model can preserve a stable defect, while a rarely executed required behavior may be absent.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A learned model can preserve a stable defect, while a rarely executed required behavior may be absent.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Independent ICCCM rule distinguishes bugs from accepted traces.
Specifications can be buggy and need debugging.
Learned TLS behavior enables independent security judgment.
Successful consistency/proof screening does not establish complete intended semantics.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. A native mathematical controllability objective or a model-selected reward does not validate the objective itself.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A descriptive candidate used to judge correctness, impose an obligation or authorize an action needs an independent applicable normative source and an explicit correspondence from that source to the candidate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: candidate φ, intended requirement r, authority A, formalization map f, application E
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A learned model can preserve a stable defect, while a rarely executed required behavior may be absent.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Record the source/version and its scope, interpret the relevant clause, and examine accepted/rejected examples. Keep descriptive support, interpretation, adopted obligation and verified conformance as separate states.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s positive promotion route; A0206’s negative entailment remains BH09, not deleted as a duplicate. A legitimate authority can make a fallible or contestable decision. Provenance is not infallibility, and an existing contract may already supply the needed basis without a new ceremonial approval artifact.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Prevents normalizing defects and supports useful disagreement between implementation evidence and desired behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Ammons2002 used ICCCM rules and expert decisions; Cable 2003 debugs specifications themselves; TLS learning discovered flaws rather than legitimizing them.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A requirement/specification owner, verifier or engineer selecting what behavior to preserve or change.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A descriptive report that clearly makes no acceptance/policy claim can stop before normative promotion.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A descriptive candidate is used to judge correctness, enforce policy or authorize action.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A descriptive report that clearly makes no acceptance/policy claim can stop before normative promotion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: The normative source has applicable authority/version/scope and its interpretation is testable; participants’ account of practice is not automatically organizational permission.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Distinguish desired behavior, existing implementation, formalized interpretation and actual authority to alter or enforce.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Support is clause-, version-, subject- and use-relative. Approval of one rule or a valid example does not authorize all related rules or interventions. No target institution’s legitimate decision-maker is identified by this research. A standard’s existence does not establish applicability to an unnamed deployment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Normative force is external to the inference. Examples are standards/requirements/authorized decisions; no particular target owner is selected in this research.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: Independent ICCCM rule distinguishes bugs from accepted traces.
Specifications can be buggy and need debugging.
Learned TLS behavior enables independent security judgment.
Successful consistency/proof screening does not establish complete intended semantics.

INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN.SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENT: Identify the actual source and its applicability; preserve disputed interpretations. Review positive/negative examples against source and test the formal predicate without assuming source completeness.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: Complements BH09; depends on artifact/source correspondence and interpretation without reducing authority to those descriptive predicates.

original_value.CONFLICT: Independent sources may disagree; proof that code satisfies a mined contract can still validate an unacceptable implementation.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A universally true mined property encodes an existing authentication or resource-management bug and is adopted as required behavior.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Domain/expert adjudication and specification debugging; extra proof cannot replace unresolved authority.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Revisit when requirements, protocol versions, stakeholder authority or interpretation changes, even if model bytes do not.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. Static extraction accuracy does not guarantee runtime activation, architectural intent or policy validity.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A claim assembled across source, build, binary, configuration, runtime, documentation or interview artifacts must preserve each artifact’s version, relation semantics, observation limits and conflict status.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: claim edge/relation r, artifact set A, extraction maps e, version envelope V
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Code, binary, build, configuration, deployment, logs and documentation answer different questions and may disagree.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Align the bearer, relation and time before comparing artifacts; preserve unresolved contradictions and unobserved relations. Agreement from correlated extraction pipelines is not independent corroboration.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A’s general triangulation facet and B’s artifact correspondence concern the same problem of mismatched evidence objects and stale or partial views. A’s reflexion edge/partition facet moves to BH12. B retains explicit conflict states and tool-dependency sensitivity. A source-level call, dynamic event and intended relation remain distinct types.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Exposes missing runtime links, stale documentation and mismatched build/configuration assumptions before a graph is used for decisions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH015 compares dependency inputs and documents metric failures; BH005 shows source-to-design discrepancies. These establish source sensitivity, not a universal requirement to collect every artifact.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Maintainer answering a change-impact, deployment or architecture question.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A local syntactic dependency question may be answered directly by the relevant code/build slice, with no universal triangulation ceremony.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A decision depends on relationships distributed across artifacts, no single artifact establishes the asserted relation, or available artifacts conflict.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A local syntactic dependency question may be answered directly by the relevant code/build slice, with no universal triangulation ceremony.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Artifact identities/versions and extraction rules are available; claims distinguish possible/static relations from observed runtime occurrences.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Incomplete repositories, generated code, reflection, dynamic loading, plugins, flags and external services can change the relevant relation set.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Evidence supports the declared artifact/version/slice. No observed runtime edge is not proof that an edge cannot occur; agreement of extracted graphs is not completeness over all configurations. Plugins, build flags, generated code and stale deployment configuration can invalidate a source-only graph. A shared extractor can duplicate the same omission across apparent independent witnesses.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Documentation may express intent; executable evidence may express current behavior. Neither automatically owns every claim or requirement.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH12 offers a precise discrepancy operator once H,S,m are typed. BH14 keeps the universal-completeness negative; root RT03 handles general transformations without absorbing these artifact-specific semantics.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Entity mapping and relation types are explicit, source versions relate to the running system, and observation limitations are retained.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A decision depends on relationships distributed across artifacts, no single artifact establishes the asserted relation, or available artifacts conflict.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Align the bearer, relation and time before comparing artifacts; preserve unresolved contradictions and unobserved relations. Agreement from correlated extraction pipelines is not independent corroboration. Evaluate only the named facet. Evidence supports the declared artifact/version/slice. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Selected relations and documented discrepancies; not complete runtime causal architecture or automatic intended-design recovery. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a suspected forbidden dependency is mapped from a current call-site to abstract modules and checked against the applicable architectural intention.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: no call is observed during one test, so a dynamically loaded plugin edge is declared impossible.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Which missing source or dynamic mechanism could reverse the current decision? Also unknown when a load-bearing field is missing or assumptions cannot be checked.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The question is resolved by a single authoritative current source and a direct check.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Dropping unmapped entities inflates apparent agreement; coverage must remain visible.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed artifacts, mappings, feature flags, deployment or relation definitions invalidate affected correspondences.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Extraction/mapping and resolving conflicts can dominate; focus on decision-relevant slice and retire unused views. Cheaper route: Directly inspect one call/configuration; read an existing current diagram; use a small runtime trace.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Selected relations and documented discrepancies; not complete runtime causal architecture or automatic intended-design recovery.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The precise scoped operational rule is satisfied with sufficient stated evidence; does not imply stronger truth, universality or adoption.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: The guard may apply but evidence, mapping, premise or computation is insufficient; this is neither pass nor logical negation.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The declared guard is false; use the named non-trigger route rather than treating absence as failure.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Reflexion discrepancy partition with explicit mapping semantics

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Murphy–Notkin–Sullivan1995 combine an engineer’s high-level model, extracted source relation and declarative mapping.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Convergence, divergence, absence, mapped source model
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: An engineer needs to locate disagreements between a chosen architectural view and the implementation without fully reconstructing the whole system.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: An engineer needs to locate disagreements between a chosen architectural view and the implementation without fully reconstructing the whole system.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Formal set construction and interpretation/mapping limitations.
Reference view and element-set assumptions affect measured discrepancy.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. The model is a relation comparison, not a general inverse program specification or a unique recovered architecture.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A reflexion model compares a declared high-level relation H with a mapped source relation R=m(S). Convergence, divergence and absence are relative set differences, not automatic defect or requirement labels.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: relations H,S; map m; mapped relation R; output sets C,D,A
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: An engineer needs to locate disagreements between a chosen architectural view and the implementation without fully reconstructing the whole system.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Compute C=R∩H, D=R∖H and A=H∖R under explicit entity universes, edge types and mapping m; separately inspect the source witness and intended meaning of each discrepancy.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A’s edge-witness/reflexion facet and B’s explicit partition share the bounded discrepancy mechanism. A contributes per-edge evidence and general triangulation cautions. B supplies exact finite partition semantics. The broader artifact conflict row remains BH11, and neither row establishes a complete architecture.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Focuses investigation on decision-relevant discrepancies and permits a rough map to be refined only where needed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH005 reports NetBSD/Excel and other tool cases and mapping tradeoffs; no randomized claim of total engineer-time savings.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer investigating architectural drift or planning a bounded change.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: If the task only needs a direct source relation, use the extraction; if no high-level hypothesis exists, reflexion comparison is not the right initial claim.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A high-level relation view and a comparable source view are being compared, or a claim based on their discrepancy is asserted; missing mapping/evidence is assessed as UNKNOWN rather than a favorable result.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If the task only needs a direct source relation, use the extraction; if no high-level hypothesis exists, reflexion comparison is not the right initial claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: H and R use compatible edge semantics; mapping handles relevant entities and its omissions are known enough for interpretation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: The computation is syntactic over supplied relations; intended semantics comes from the engineer, not the set operation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Finite set equations are exact for the supplied H,S,m. Their correctness does not quantify over unextracted runtime relations or make H normatively authoritative. A missing map can manufacture an apparent absence, and a mistaken H can manufacture a divergence interpreted as a defect. Preserve these as distinct from an arithmetic partition error.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: A high-level diagram can be a hypothesis or an adopted requirement; the status must be stated independently.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: Formal set construction and interpretation/mapping limitations.
Reference view and element-set assumptions affect measured discrepancy.

INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN.SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENT: Extract inputs and trace map application to contributing source tuples. Compute mapped relation R and the specified set intersection/differences; inspect unmapped items.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH11 supplies typed current inputs. BH10 supplies authority if H is treated as obligatory. A correct partition plus a scoped task can challenge BH13’s universal full-graph necessity without proving BH14’s sufficiency.

input_conditions.original_value: C0208 limits comprehensive-graph demand; C0214 controls completeness/proxy evaluation; C0206 separates intended from implemented.

original_value.CONFLICT: Detailed mapping improves interpretability but costs maintenance; a coarse map can be sufficient for one task and misleading for another.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unmapped source entities create apparent absences, which are then called defects without examining the map.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Engineer builds/refines mapping and investigates discrepancies; computation can be cheap while semantics remains costly.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Recompute/reinterpret when H, source relation or mapping changes; source-code edits can make old map rules stale.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Entity mapping and relation types are explicit, source versions relate to the running system, and observation limitations are retained.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A high-level relation view and a comparable source view are being compared, or a claim based on their discrepancy is asserted; missing mapping/evidence is assessed as UNKNOWN rather than a favorable result.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Selected relations and documented discrepancies; not complete runtime causal architecture or automatic intended-design recovery. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Which missing source or dynamic mechanism could reverse the current decision? Also unknown when a load-bearing field is missing or assumptions cannot be checked.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The question is resolved by a single authoritative current source and a direct check.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Dropping unmapped entities inflates apparent agreement; coverage must remain visible.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed artifacts, mappings, feature flags, deployment or relation definitions invalidate affected correspondences.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Extraction/mapping and resolving conflicts can dominate; focus on decision-relevant slice and retire unused views. Cheaper route: Directly inspect one call/configuration; read an existing current diagram; use a small runtime trace.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Selected relations and documented discrepancies; not complete runtime causal architecture or automatic intended-design recovery.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The declared guard is false; use the named non-trigger route rather than treating absence as failure.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Reject the universal requirement that every relevant decision needs a complete architecture graph. A particular graph or slice may be justified by a named consumer, relation scope and lifecycle burden.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A proposed architecture artifact and the decision it is meant to support.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Graph production can become a proxy for comprehension while completeness is undefined or unattainable.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Test the necessity claim against a cheaper adequate view for the same decision; retain local completeness and adequacy assessments without upgrading them to universal graph necessity.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A’s negative necessity candidate remains separate from B0035’s negative sufficiency candidate. A’s original predicate explicitly evaluates contextual graph necessity, completeness, adequacy or a proposed scoped replacement. That useful predicate remains a different target from the truth of the rejected universal requirement.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids maintenance burden and false completeness while preserving necessary dependency understanding.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Reflexion’s selected VM scope is a concrete counterexample to universal completeness necessity; no comparative evidence establishes every graph unnecessary.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer deciding what artifact to build or maintain.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a justified scoped graph, typed edge table, selected source slice or documented open question when it supports the decision. When a graph or replacement adequacy claim is still present, the adequate cheaper path can satisfy this predicate; it is not automatically INAPPLICABLE.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A graph’s necessity, completeness or scope adequacy, or a scoped replacement, is asserted or relied upon for a decision.

It does not prove that no task requires a rich graph or that a supplied graph is complete. An actual local necessity dispute requires the consumer obligation, evidence of adequacy of alternatives and maintenance costs. Unknown alternatives do not establish universal necessity.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: A tempting modern reconstruction claim exceeds the scoped reverse-engineering and reflexion traditions.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Complete system graph (researcher-formulated candidate, not a historical school’s universal theorem)
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Graph explicitness and extractor coverage are mistaken for completeness of runtime, configuration, purpose and institutional context.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Graph explicitness and extractor coverage are mistaken for completeness of runtime, configuration, purpose and institutional context.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Some design history/intent is not recoverable from implementation alone.
No unique correct architecture.
High scores can coexist with missing entities.
Hidden/duplicate tasks and nonunique structures.
Observation asymmetry.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. This negative candidate is not attributed as the universal position of any cited author.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Reject the claim that an explicit internally consistent graph by itself exhausts the system across relevant artifacts, environments and perspectives. A closed, independently declared relation universe can support a narrower completeness result.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: graph G, claimed universe U, extraction e, external witnesses W
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Graph explicitness and extractor coverage are mistaken for completeness of runtime, configuration, purpose and institutional context.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Look for a relevant omitted entity, relation, environment or perspective. Separate exact extraction of a finite declared syntax universe from completeness of the external operational system.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s universal completeness negative with its omission witness and no-found-omission uncertainty. The original bounded-completeness PASS condition is preserved as a distinct named assessment, not used to vindicate universal external completeness. A0208 tests necessity, not this sufficiency implication.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Claimed payoff is a universal authoritative map; no such general payoff is established by inspected studies.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH014/015 show reference-view and extraction sensitivity; BH016 gives hidden-task/nonunique-structure limits; BH021 shows observer/machine asymmetry. These disfavor the unqualified candidate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Anyone tempted to use a generated graph as complete impact, compliance or behavioral evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a scoped graph or relation table that answers one decision and explicitly states omitted relation types.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A graph is asserted to exhaust the system across relevant environments, artifacts or perspectives.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use a scoped graph or relation table that answers one decision and explicitly states omitted relation types.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A legitimate bounded completeness claim would require a closed universe and a complete extraction/correspondence argument for its relation semantics; the universal candidate supplies neither.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: The rejected scope crosses static/runtime/intent/human perspectives. A complete finite parse graph for a specific grammar is a different bounded claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: A reliable omitted relevant relation refutes the claimed universal coverage. Enumerating every relation in a closed declared universe establishes completeness only for that original universe, not a newly narrowed substitute. Correct the R-BH07 crosslink without discarding its valid necessity argument. A graph can be internally consistent and complete for parsed source while omitting an operational plugin edge.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Graph generation cannot confer normative or organizational authority.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: Some design history/intent is not recoverable from implementation alone.
No unique correct architecture.
High scores can coexist with missing entities.
Hidden/duplicate tasks and nonunique structures.
Observation asymmetry.

INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN.SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENT: Ask what counts as a potentially missing relation and what closes that universe. Compare model scope with configuration, runtime or participant evidence relevant to the claimed consumer.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH11 and BH12 can establish typed bounded relations; their success does not imply this rejected universal conclusion. Root RT06 similarly keeps serialization sufficiency separate from positive preservation.

original_value.CONFLICT: Universal completeness is incompatible with acknowledged unobserved effects and legitimate alternative views.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: An explicit graph omits dynamic configuration or invisible work but downstream users treat omission as impossibility.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Unbounded scope invites endless reconstruction and maintenance with no terminating consumer criterion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Any unaccounted environment/view change defeats an unchanged universal claim; a scoped graph can have ordinary version rules.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Process discovery, conformance and timing conclusions depend on justified event meanings, case/object relations and the actual observation envelope; valid event syntax alone is insufficient.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: An event log, case/object relation and discovered workflow representation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Missing events, ambiguous labels, concurrency and wrong case identity change the process that the log appears to show.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Retain occurrence versus recording time, missing/duplicate/ambiguous events, projection and many-to-many object links. Check the native discovery theorem’s process-class and completeness premises before extending its result.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Both records ground process inference in event/case/quality correspondence rather than treating logs as transparent accounts of work. A preserves the restricted α/SWF-net theorem and field case contrasts. B adds object-centric correlation and OCEL schema distinctions. Data quality is separate from the competing-model quality tradeoffs in BH16.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Explains when rediscovery is possible and detects artificial patterns caused by logging/flattening choices.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Alpha rediscovery theorem plus the paper’s own counterexamples; 2026 classification with six practitioner/vendor interviews supports the relevance of relational quality issues, not universal effect.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Analyst deciding which observed process relations warrant a model or discrepancy investigation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A few validated event sequences, direct case inspection, or elicitation of unlogged work.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: The central claim here is an engineering/interpretive use condition, not a claimed published universal mathematical theorem. Native formal subresults are identified separately where used.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.JUSTIFICATION: The bounded sources establish BH017 supplies decisive flower/memorization constructions and a community position; BH036 shows contextual quality issues. REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.JUSTIFICATION: No independent replication of the full engineering payoff was identified in the bounded search. Related versions/shared benchmark families are disclosed in sources.json; No universally justified scalar tradeoff or complete future-log oracle.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.JUSTIFICATION: No direct field validation of the whole claim was established. The relevant positive witness is: CONSTRUCTED: two models replay the training log, but an independent legitimate trace distinguishes memorization from useful generalization.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.JUSTIFICATION: SOURCE-CONSTRUCTED BH017: a flower model replays every log over its activities while permitting many irrelevant orders.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.JUSTIFICATION: Weighting losses/benefits is a decision choice; a methodology manifesto is not an enforceable organizational mandate. This property is not presented as a binding standard for an unidentified target.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.JUSTIFICATION: Generalization and precision are themselves difficult to estimate from incomplete logs, so a vector can become another dashboard ritual. No universally justified scalar tradeoff or complete future-log oracle.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Representations of human judgment, coordination and tacit practice must state the observed roles, situations, missing perspectives, interpretation and intended use. Prescription or enforcement requires an additional applicable authority basis.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A bounded account of situated/cooperative activity and its proposed use.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Observer categories and logged actions can omit circumstances, technical competence and whose meaning matters.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Compare episodes and divergent accounts, document elicitation/observer effects and retain interpretive disagreement. A bounded narrative can be an adequate representation without a formal workflow.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Both packets oppose total capture and an automatic promotion from observed practice to enforceable rules while preserving useful scoped elicitation and coordination artifacts. A preserves maps/scripts as potentially useful coordinating resources and the historical steel-work case. B adds ACTA’s structured knowledge audit and context-dependent expert disagreement. B’s non-trigger example is corrected: an unresolved human-practice narrative remains applicable even when not imposed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Reveals why an apparently simple interface or task can depend on unrecorded practical work.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Suchman’s video-based copier study and Schmidt’s historical steel-plant fieldwork show mechanisms in context; they are not representative causal estimates.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Analyst or designer whose decision depends on how people actually coordinate with the system.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Focused observation or elicitation, technical documentation, a concrete user walkthrough, or no social-model reconstruction for a purely bounded technical question.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A representation claims to describe human judgment, tacit skill, coordination or organizational practice, or such meaning materially affects the receiving decision. Enforcement is an additional use, not the only trigger.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A purely technical checksum or source-syntax count with no claim about human judgment, meaning, coordination or institutional practice.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Records and interpretations are scoped; analyst access, task construction and missing perspectives are exposed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Suchman concerns first-time copier use under selected tasks; Schmidt’s plant fieldwork 1997–2000 is historical and excludes downstream operations.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Claims are bounded to represented roles, situations and uses. Neither a formal task map nor a qualitative case proves universal internal cognition, and no blanket impossibility of useful representation is asserted. Manager-only agreement or participant acquiescence is not complete perspective coverage or institutional authority. Conversely, useful task guides do not require exhaustive tacit capture.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Observation does not authorize monitoring, prescription or enforcement; intervention legitimacy is separately assessed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Field/video/transcript/document context, observation dates, participant roles, analyst interpretation and rival readings.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Recent LLM-based protocol, contract, architecture and interactive-learning work proposes richer automated reconstruction; evidence remains task-specific.

GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: An LLM agent can autonomously recover semantically adequate models/specifications across diverse unseen software environments.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Plausible syntax, benchmark overlap and successful partial extraction can be mistaken for broad semantic fidelity.
GENEALOGY.INFLUENCE_OR_RELATION_CLASS: Source-specific documented ancestry where cited; operational predicate and cross-domain constraint are present analytical reconstruction, not claimed historical wording.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Current bounded evaluations do not settle a broad claim that autonomous LLM systems reliably reconstruct unseen software semantics across distributions, versions and task classes.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A stated LLM/scaffold/version applied to a defined reconstruction task and target distribution.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Plausible syntax, benchmark overlap and successful partial extraction can be mistaken for broad semantic fidelity.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Bind capability claims to model, scaffold, tools, tasks, run accounting and independent semantic checks; distinguish finite success, measured error and transfer to unseen populations.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains A’s unresolved capability claim rather than merging it with B0041’s refutable exact-oracle universal or B0040’s positive grounding discipline. A includes recent autonomous automata-learning, Java-model extraction and code-comprehension studies. Their populations and outcomes differ from LLM-assisted proof acceptance or individual membership-label correctness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Potential reduction in manual specification/architecture work; not yet a general demonstrated effect.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: SpecGen/ChatAFL positive bounded results; ESEM17 systems extraction F1 and June 2026 exact-DFA benchmark expose failures; October 2026 Spec-Harness improves selected adequacy metrics, not all tasks.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Person choosing whether to rely on an autonomous reconstruction result.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Classical learner for finite DFA tasks; deterministic extraction; direct tests; LLM-assisted proposal followed by independent checks under C0213.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A result is trusted as generally semantically faithful because an LLM generated or explained it, or a broad autonomous reconstruction capability is asserted.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: An LLM writes an explicitly provisional label or candidate that is independently checked before use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Versioned model/scaffold, available evidence, task distribution, budgets, groundtruth/reference quality and training-overlap risks are specified.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Benchmarks differ: exact language equality, endpoint/edge extraction, partition similarity and formal-contract tests are not interchangeable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: General reliability across unseen tasks is not exactness on every query. Failure on existing benchmarks does not prove permanent impossibility; successful repeated runs on one application are not independent new applications. Preserve public-benchmark leakage, denominator, failed-run, scaffold and evaluator dependence. Current negative examples limit broad claims but do not license a timeless claim that future autonomous systems cannot improve.

The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a generated finite machine is exactly compared to its hidden target and found equivalent for one task; that task succeeds without proving general reliability.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Observed, version-specific: Menaged et al. v1 (15 June 2026) reports no tested model above 25% success at nine states in its 80-target/six-configuration benchmark. The current v2 (27 September 2026) instead tests 160 targets, three high-reasoning models and two scaffolds: best success for the 8–9-state bucket is 30.0% stateless and 57.5% stateful. Stateful improvements coexist with substantial failures and harm to Gemini 3.8 Flash. Liljas et al. separately reports incomplete architecture extraction. These are bounded observed failures and successor responses, not a claim that v1's percentage remains the current frontier.

EVIDENCE_CEILING.canonical_ceiling: General reliability across unseen tasks is not exactness on every query. Failure on existing benchmarks does not prove permanent impossibility; successful repeated runs on one application are not independent new applications. Require an independently specified unseen distribution, complete run denominators, semantic checks and fair model/scaffold comparison. No such general result is established here.
EVIDENCE_CEILING.source_access_comparison: A:C034 v1 and retitled v2 change tasks, models and scaffolds, so 80 versus 160 tasks is not a controlled longitudinal capability gain. A:C026 has 17 Java applications and 20 retained runs each, not 340 independent systems; A:C027 has six public systems and identity stripping, not a training-data contamination audit.

ceiling.STRONGEST_SUPPORTED_CLAIM: The broad reliability proposition remains unresolved and is not an adoption warrant. Examined studies establish useful bounded capabilities and explicit failed cases under their own conditions.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Rejected unvalidated LLM exact-oracle guarantee

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: A tempting extrapolation from LLM-assisted learning pipelines, challenged by their own primary evaluations.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Exact LLM teacher/general semantic reconstruction (researcher-formulated universal candidate)
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: A generated answer is placed behind an equivalence/membership or semantic-analysis interface and inherits its idealized name.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A generated answer is placed behind an equivalence/membership or semantic-analysis interface and inherits its idealized name.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Exact teacher contract.
Observed LLM membership errors.
Specification failures and semantic-preserving transformation sensitivity.
Proof and candidate-screening limits.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. This negative candidate is not attributed as the universal position of any cited author.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Unvalidated LLM output is not an exact membership/equivalence oracle or a general semantic truth source merely because it is fluent or benchmark-successful; exactness requires correctness on every query in the originally asserted domain.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: generator g,query domain Q,trusted answer relation R,independent evidence E
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A generated answer is placed behind an equivalence/membership or semantic-analysis interface and inherits its idealized name.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: For a named generator g, domain Q and independent answer relation R, evaluate ∀q∈Q R(q,g(q)). A reliable in-domain mismatch refutes it; an unknown checker result is not itself a wrong answer.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s negative universal and the distinction between wrong answers and inconclusive checks. A proof for one generated proposition supports that proposition under a trusted base. It does not certify the generator over Q unless Q was originally that singleton. A finite exhaustive proof can legitimately establish a finite original Q, but silently shrinking Q changes the claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Claimed elimination of oracle construction and expert correction is not established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH028 reports membership errors; BH029 shows poor/variable verifiability and transformation sensitivity; BH030 separates proof failure from spec error. These contradict a universal exact-oracle claim, not every useful LLM role.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer tempted to apply a formal exact-learning guarantee directly to an LLM teacher.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Retain LLM outputs as proposals,validated finite labels or explicit UNKNOWN responses; use a deterministic oracle when available.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Exactness or general semantic correctness is attributed to unvalidated LLM outputs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Retain LLM outputs as proposals,validated finite labels or explicit UNKNOWN responses; use a deterministic oracle when available.

GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A complete model may be expensive and a model-level violation may be spurious.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: An independently defined property can guide black-box exploration toward a decisive violation before a complete model is learned, but a model-level counterexample becomes a system violation only with valid replay or equivalent system evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Finite-state system, independent desired property, learned model and execution counterexample.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A complete model may be expensive and a model-level violation may be spurious.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Interleave hypothesized behavior, property checking and controlled replay; distinguish a real violating trace from a spurious model artifact. Satisfaction claims retain stronger finite-bound, reset, determinism, alphabet and observation premises.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: This A-only claim remains distinct from model ROI and LLM-grounding even where those rows cite later black-box-checking cost work. B:BH034 contributes later bounded query-cost context but is not property ancestry for B0042. The 1999 mechanism and replay bearer remain independently represented.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Original algorithm and stated assumptions; protocol state-fuzzing provides related practical feasibility, not a replication of complete checker guarantees.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A checker deciding a specific desired property, not recovering all source architecture.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Direct hand-written property tests; bounded conformance; inspect source for the exact property.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An independently defined property is to be checked against a black box, or a black-box property-checking conclusion is asserted. Missing access, reset or observation evidence is a premise failure/unknown, not a false guard.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Only descriptive exploration is sought: no desired checking property is supplied and no property-checking conclusion is claimed or relied on.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Deterministic finite target, known state bound for completeness, reliable reset, known alphabet and ability to observe enabled input/outputs as the original setting requires.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Positive no-bug termination differs from finding one replayed bad trace; without bound, budgeted search is not universal verification.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: A replayed finite bad trace can witness existential violation. Absence of a bad trace implies satisfaction only under a complete justified conditional analysis, not ordinary finite exploration. Desired behavior must be independent of the recovered model. A bad path in an overapproximation may be infeasible; a model with no bad path may omit the real violation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Desired property must be independently supplied and scoped; the learner does not invent its authority.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Property version, experiment context, model/hypothesis version, candidate word, raw replay and refinement outcome.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: A property-directed loop can use a learned model to focus checking, but a reported system violation requires replay and a no-violation guarantee retains all bound/reset/model assumptions. Scope: Positive no-bug termination differs from finding one replayed bad trace; without bound, budgeted search is not universal verification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Finite-state system, independent desired property, learned model and execution counterexample.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. Changed property, version, state bound or reset semantics reopens prior checking conclusions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Deterministic finite target, known state bound for completeness, reliable reset, known alphabet and ability to observe enabled input/outputs as the original setting requires.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An independently defined property is to be checked against a black box, or a black-box property-checking conclusion is claimed or relied on. Suitable or authorized access, reliable reset and adequate observation mapping are premises to assess, not prerequisites for activating this assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Apply when a desired property is to be checked or a property-checking conclusion is claimed or relied on. PASS for a violation claim only with a valid replayed counterexample against the independent property; PASS for satisfaction only with all relevant completeness premises and complete checking. FAIL on a demonstrated contradicted replay or mismatched property. UNKNOWN for budget exhaustion, unavailable or unverified suitable/authorized access, unreliable or unverified reset, or uncertain mapping when these leave the checking conclusion unresolved. A demonstrated false premise can defeat an asserted guarantee, but does not make the checking claim disappear or by itself prove the underlying property violated. INAPPLICABLE only for descriptive exploration with no supplied checking property and no checking conclusion claim/use.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.rationale: Operational rule derived from the source-supported limit/mechanism; not claimed as a verbatim theorem or universally mandatory process.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Conditional checking theorem and replayed violation, not unrestricted blackbox certification. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: model predicts a request before authentication succeeds; replay confirms it and the independent requirement forbids it, so the violation is established.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: model-only bad trace fails on the actual system, yet tool reports a live defect without replay.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: A checking question or conclusion is present, but material access, authorization, reset, mapping, replay or completeness evidence is missing, unreliable or inconclusive. Suitable access is an evidential premise; its absence cannot alone make the checking claim INAPPLICABLE. Constructed: an independent no-unauthenticated-success requirement and a fixed target version are supplied. A model checker reports satisfaction after using reconnect as reset, but no evidence establishes that reconnect restores durable authentication state. The satisfaction conclusion is UNKNOWN because its reset premise is unverified; the property-checking guard remains true. This example authorizes no new interaction.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Only descriptive exploration is sought: no desired checking property is supplied and no property-checking conclusion is claimed or relied on.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: A simulator/replica can reproduce a model violation that does not occur in the scoped target.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: A single nondeterministic replay may miss areal reachable violation; do not convert miss to impossibility.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A property weakened to match learned behavior makes checking trivially pass.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed property, version, state bound or reset semantics reopens prior checking conclusions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Testing and reset cost can dominate; stop when real counterexample answers negative question or budget ceiling reached. Cheaper route: Direct hand-written property tests; bounded conformance; inspect source for the exact property.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional checking theorem and replayed violation, not unrestricted blackbox certification.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The precise scoped operational rule is satisfied with sufficient stated evidence; does not imply stronger truth, universality or adoption.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.FAIL: A valid witness or directly established mismatch contradicts that operational rule in its applicable context.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: The guard may apply but evidence, mapping, premise or computation is insufficient; this is neither pass nor logical negation.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The declared guard is false; use the named non-trigger route rather than treating absence as failure.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A claimed benefit of LLM-assisted testing or specification must be supported on a matched task and outcome with a meaningful comparator and declared resource boundary.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A specified assistance pipeline, comparator and measured task outcome.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Generating valid protocol sequences or expressive candidates by hand/template alone can be expensive.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Identify what the LLM proposes, what independently judges it, the baseline, complete task/run denominator and relevant time/query/review/compute costs. Evaluate the particular improvement claimed, not generic AI usefulness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains A’s comparative-benefit target independently of B0040’s per-output grounding target. Grounded candidates and legitimate adoption can form a usable scoped pipeline without establishing comparative utility. Correct A:REL-C013’s composition accordingly: add comparator/outcome/resource evidence before deriving this row.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: More useful test exploration or stronger candidate contracts in examined settings.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: ChatAFL reports comparisons on six text protocol implementations; SpecGen reports more verifiable Java cases and a selected rating study; Spec-Harness shows held-out adequacy gains with mixed statistical significance across agents/tasks.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Tester/developer deciding whether the assistance earns its cost for a particular task.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a classical learner/fuzzer, hand-selected example, direct assertion or static template when adequate. If such a route is an evidenced comparator that contradicts an asserted LLM advantage, the comparative claim is FAIL. If the comparison is not yet established, it is UNKNOWN. INAPPLICABLE requires absence of the comparative claim/use, not a cheap alternative.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A bounded comparative-benefit claim is asserted or relied on, whether or not the comparator, evaluator or cost evidence has already been collected.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: No comparative-benefit claim about LLM assistance is made or relied on. Merely choosing a classical method, or discovering that it is cheaper, does not make an asserted LLM-benefit claim inapplicable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Versioned LLM/pipeline, fair budget, adequate outcome metric, clear failed attempt denominator and no automatic normative promotion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Text protocol benchmark results do not transfer automatically to binary protocols; verifiability is not contract completeness.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Comparison is within a named task population, model/scaffold version, outcome and budget. Equal-duration fuzzing coverage, successful specification proof and complete economic return are different estimands. A cheaper classical baseline contradicts a claimed cost advantage; it does not deactivate the assessment. Missing fair comparator yields UNKNOWN. Failed generations and validation labor belong in the relevant denominator/cost.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: LLM proposal is no authority; adopted tests/contracts still need their independent purpose and scope.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Prompts, models, generated candidates, feedback, all runs, budgets, reference version and actual executed/proved results.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH08, BH10, BH22 and BH23 can improve candidate/evidence discipline but do not entail benefit. Root RT04 supplies the general lifecycle comparison; this row preserves the actual LLM task and empirical populations.

input_conditions.original_value: C0204 authorizes experiments; C0205 retains candidate status; C0214 evaluates adequacy; C0211 remains broad unresolved parent.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A weak metric can reward invalid states, vacuous contracts or over fitted feedback; external API changes reduce reproducibility.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Include prompting/tokens, latency, solver execution, harness setup and rejected outputs, not only successful call counts.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Replace assistance when updated classical/cheap baseline matches value or pipeline change invalidates comparison.

CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE_WHILE_APPLICABLE.ALTERNATIVE: An adequate classical method or direct example.
CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE_WHILE_APPLICABLE.OUTCOME_WHEN_CLAIM_REMAINS: Its existence alone does not deactivate the predicate. A matched comparison contradicting the asserted LLM advantage is FAIL; unavailable comparison evidence is UNKNOWN. If no LLM comparative-benefit claim/use remains, INAPPLICABLE follows from that absence.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: What the LLM proposes and what external check actually judges.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: A specified assistance pipeline, comparator and measured task outcome.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.VALUE_TYPE_AND_DOMAIN: structured{proposal_type, model_version, feedback, acceptance, scope}
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Categorical/structured evidence; any count, time, probability or cost carries its explicit unit and denominator. No aggregate scalar confidence implied.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Use the stated domain; preserve missing fields explicitly and never encode unobserved as false/zero. Bind every value to the stated subject/context.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.QUANTITATIVE_OR_QUALITATIVE: QUALITATIVE_OR_STRUCTURED; quantitative subfields retain units, denominators and uncertainty.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.OBSERVED_DERIVED_ASSUMED_OR_STIPULATED: OBSERVED_STIPULATED
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MEASUREMENT_OR_DERIVATION_METHOD: Inspect pipeline and actual tool validation records.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For the specified task, pipeline, outcome criterion and resource accounting, the LLM assistance has the claimed comparative benefit over the relevant baseline. Scope: Text protocol benchmark results do not transfer automatically to binary protocols; verifiability is not contract completeness.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. New models, prompts, tool versions, protocol families or budgets require re-evaluation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Versioned LLM/pipeline, fair budget, adequate outcome metric, clear failed attempt denominator and no automatic normative promotion.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A bounded comparative-benefit claim about an LLM-assisted testing or specification pipeline is made or relied on. The guard does not require that the evaluator, comparator or cost evidence already be available.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Apply whenever a bounded comparative-benefit claim about LLM assistance is made or relied on, independently of whether its required evidence has been obtained. PASS when the declared outcome/resource claim is supported by an adequate comparator, independent checks and complete relevant denominators. FAIL when an established comparison contradicts that claim or when a demonstrated program change, vacuity or metric substitution invalidates the claimed benefit. UNKNOWN when evaluator, comparator, denominator, cost or uncertainty evidence is missing or inconclusive. INAPPLICABLE only when no corresponding comparative-benefit claim/use is present.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Local comparative effects, not all protocols/languages or intended behavior validity. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a fixed task suite, outcome criterion and total resource budget are declared. An independent held-out check accepts more non-vacuous useful candidates from the assisted pipeline than from the relevant baseline, and all failed attempts and material costs remain in the comparison. A claim confined to that evidenced suite, metric and budget is PASS.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: a pipeline claims lower total cost for producing the same required exact model, but a matched comparison establishes that the classical method produces that model at lower total cost than the LLM pipeline. The asserted cost advantage is FAIL, not INAPPLICABLE. A separate failure occurs when higher verifier-pass rate is obtained by deleting meaningful postconditions while claiming better specification adequacy.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: A comparative-benefit claim is present, but an adequate comparator, independent outcome evidence, complete attempt denominator, relevant resource accounting or uncertainty assessment is absent or inconclusive. The result is UNKNOWN even if a proposal bottleneck has not been established. An established contrary comparison is FAIL.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No comparative-benefit claim about LLM assistance is made or relied on. Merely choosing a classical method, or discovering that it is cheaper, does not make an asserted LLM-benefit claim inapplicable.
