PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Optimizing an empty contract or response-code count avoids the intended consumer benefit.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: New models, prompts, tool versions, protocol families or budgets require re-evaluation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Include prompting/tokens, latency, solver execution, harness setup and rejected outputs, not only successful call counts. Cheaper route: Use a classical learner/fuzzer, hand-selected example, direct assertion or static template when adequate. If such a route is an evidenced comparator that contradicts an asserted LLM advantage, the comparative claim is FAIL. If the comparison is not yet established, it is UNKNOWN. INAPPLICABLE requires absence of the comparative claim/use, not a cheap alternative.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: A claimed benefit of LLM-assisted testing or specification must be supported on a matched task and outcome with a meaningful comparator and declared resource boundary. A:C023 ChatAFL studies six text protocols with ten 24-hour campaigns per condition and response-code proxies. A:C024 SpecGen has 50 isolated Defects4J files plus 15 programs from 15 students. IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Independent grounding of LLM-assisted hypotheses and representations

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: 2025–2026 systems use LLMs for membership suggestions, abstraction, specifications and architecture reconstruction.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: LLM teacher, semantic abstraction, specification inference, architecture recovery
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: LLMs produce plausible labels/formulas/graphs whose correctness and generalization are not established by fluent presentation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: LLMs produce plausible labels/formulas/graphs whose correctness and generalization are not established by fluent presentation.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: LLM-labeled queries may hallucinate despite grounded demonstrations.
Verification and mutation proxy expose failure/unknowns.
Proof success versus inconclusive failures and screened negatives.
12VM proof of concept,abstraction and transfer.
Document-reference diagram evaluation,reporting limits.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. Different tasks—membership labeling,semantic abstraction,proof synthesis and architecture mapping—have different failure/validation semantics.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: An LLM may propose labels, abstractions, specifications or structural claims, but each output relied upon needs independent support appropriate to its particular semantic use and evidence boundary.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: LLM output h, task t, reference/oracle o, evaluation E, use d
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: LLMs produce plausible labels/formulas/graphs whose correctness and generalization are not established by fluent presentation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Record the model/prompt/tool role, grounding reference, contamination exposure, validation outcome and correction loop; distinguish proposal generation from judging, proving and adopting the proposal.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s per-output reliability discipline. Similar sources and controls in A0213 do not make it the same comparative-utility proposition. B spans L*LM, FormalBench, COINS, ATLAS and architecture generation, with distinct evaluators and reference artifacts. The contested status preserves unresolved grounding/transfer, not a claim that every output is false.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: May reduce hypothesis/abstraction effort or improve a specific downstream task while retaining falsifiability.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: BH028 shows demo/LLM combinations but membership errors; BH031 shows same-scenario agent-transfer gains; BH032 reports diagram judgments; BH029/030 expose semantic/prover limitations. No general reconstruction accuracy or lifecycle-saving result.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Researcher or engineer selecting an LLM-assistance stage and assessing its outputs.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use an existing parser,known model,small example set or human explanation when that already answers the question.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: LLM output labels evidence, abstracts traces, generates a formal candidate or supplies a structural/behavioral claim relied on by a consumer.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use an existing parser,known model,small example set or human explanation when that already answers the question.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Task,source evidence,oracle/reference,versions/prompt,baselines and evaluation population are explicit; unmeasured contamination/correction effort remain unknown.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: External behavioral summaries are not evidence of an agent’s internal beliefs; same-task/environment transfer is not broad generalization.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Support applies to each checked output or justified declared family. A validated finite label set does not make the generator universally correct, and same-environment held-out runs do not establish held-out-environment transfer. A self-judged candidate, plausible diagram or syntax-valid formula may preserve the wrong reference or omit a behavior. Shared benchmark families and reused mutations limit independence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: LLM output has no independent normative force. Checker success establishes only its specified obligation under its trusted base.

CLAIM_LINKS.CLAIM: LLM-labeled queries may hallucinate despite grounded demonstrations.
Verification and mutation proxy expose failure/unknowns.
Proof success versus inconclusive failures and screened negatives.
12VM proof of concept,abstraction and transfer.
Document-reference diagram evaluation,reporting limits.

INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN.SPECIFIC_REQUIREMENT: Inspect paper/configuration and bind each result to the actual role and target population. Read methods/tables/limitations; identify what was independently checked and which costs/populations were omitted.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.canonical_consequence: BH19 retains exact-oracle rejection, BH23 reporting fidelity, BH10 normative adoption and root RT03 claim-preserving transformation. BH21 requires an additional fair benefit comparison.

original_value.CONFLICT: Richer prompting/context may improve output while increasing hidden cost and benchmark leakage; self-reflection can repeat errors.
original_value.DIRECTIONAL_DETAIL: See criticism.json INTERNAL_RELATIONS; a listed complement is not an automatically established reverse implication.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A fluent explanation or compilable formula is accepted despite a concrete counterexample or vacuous precondition.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: API/GPU cost,context extraction,prompt iteration,validation,expert repair and version drift; many studies report only subsets.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Invalidate on model/prompt/tool/abstraction/training-data exposure or target-version changes; rerun a proportionate independent discriminator.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Claims about tests, proofs, benchmarks and verifiers must preserve what their outcomes actually establish, including the proposition, assumptions, failed/unknown attempts and scope of aggregation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: An evaluation attempt, scoped proposition, evidence and aggregate metric.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Vacuous specifications can verify, true properties can fail proof, and benchmark denominators can hide missing/failed cases.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Map raw tool outcomes to communicated meaning explicitly. Distinguish proof of a formal proposition, a reliable counterexample, finite nonfalsification, timeout/unknown and vacuous satisfaction; preserve all attempt denominators and material code/contract changes.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains A’s reporting/evidence-operation property as its own bearer rather than subsuming it into general guarantee typing. The underlying proposition may be UNKNOWN or false while the reporting-fidelity predicate PASSes. Root CL19 types guarantees; BH23 checks whether an evaluator’s actual records were faithfully translated into a claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoids rewarding solver weakness, vacuity, altered programs or success-only statistics; improves meaning of validation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Nimmer/Ernst observes true unverifiable invariants; Coins exposes proof-agent limits; Spec-Harnessv3 implements proved accept/reject, unknown checks and held-out feedback with bounded improvements.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Reviewer interpreting check results or deciding whether a candidate isfit for use.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a correct complete direct checker for a fully specified finite proposition when available. A faithful scoped report of that check is an applicable PASS; there is no requirement to manufacture an underlying UNKNOWN. More elaborate adequacy tests are needed only when the asserted meaning goes beyond the exact decided proposition.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A claim about what a tool, verifier, test or benchmark establishes is made or relied on. Missing evaluation evidence does not deactivate the assessment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: No claim about an evaluation result's semantic meaning or acceptance force is made or relied on. A correctly executed exact finite check with a scoped result claim is applicable, not a non-trigger.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Evaluator semantics, proof/test budget, semantic model, reference provenance and denominator are known.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Logical outcome, benchmark credit, observational coverage and normative acceptance are different dimensions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Finite accepted/rejected examples and proof attempts retain their denominators. A proof is conditional on its model/assumptions; inability to prove is not falsity; checking a reference implementation is not automatically validating intent. Timeout-as-false, vacuity-as-adequacy, silently changed implementations, and deletion of failed attempts are material misreporting rather than mere confidence adjustments.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Acceptance policy may assign zero credit to unknown, but that does not make the underlying proposition false or grant normative force.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Apply whenever an evaluation-result meaning or acceptance claim is made or relied on. PASS when the communicated conclusion matches the actual decided proposition and supported assumptions, preserves any underlying unknown, and respects material coverage/vacuity/aggregation limits. A faithful exact finite check is PASS; faithful reporting of an underlying unresolved obligation can also PASS. FAIL on demonstrated semantic overreach such as timeout-to-falsity or trivial-contract-to-completeness. UNKNOWN when the evidence needed to assess the result-meaning claim is missing or inconclusive. INAPPLICABLE only when no evaluation-result claim/use is present.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Strong logical distinctions and bounded working examples; no universal adequacy metric. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: An evaluation-result meaning or acceptance claim is present, but its raw result, decided proposition, semantic assumptions, subject identity, relevant coverage or aggregation cannot be checked. Full model completion unnecessary for some bug witnesses.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The candidate wording is a present synthesis. Named native terms retain their original scope; no claim that all branches descend from continuous control. This negative candidate is not attributed as the universal position of any cited author.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Reject a universal demand for an explicit state machine or formal diagram on every task. A particular artifact can be necessary for a named consumer or obligation, while a trace, table, example or direct measurement may suffice elsewhere.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: artifact mandate M,task d,obligation O,alternative a,evidence E
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: The presence of a diagram or explicit model is used as a proxy for a discharged behavioral or assurance obligation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Compare the demanded artifact with the cheapest representation meeting the same concrete obligation. Separate local consumer requirements from a universal artifact mandate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Retains B’s ceremonial candidate independently of A0208’s architecture-graph necessity because the artifact, consumer interface and task population differ. The original predicate’s local necessity PASS can remain valid when named as a local justification assessment. It does not vindicate the universal requirement appearing in the candidate title.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Claimed universal clarity/assurance benefit lacks general comparative support.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Reflexion1995 allows rough task-specific maps; BBC2025 can stop after a useful hypothesis/counterexample; ACTA uses cognitive-demand representations. These support alternatives,not a blanket no-model rule.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: An organization deciding whether to mandate an artifact independent of the question.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use the smallest representation or evidence that discharges the real consumer obligation; retain no extra artifact when none is needed.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An artifact is demanded because it is called a model, state machine or formal diagram, or a claim of its local necessity is asserted.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use the smallest representation or evidence that discharges the real consumer obligation; retain no extra artifact when none is needed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A legitimate local mandate would identify consumer,failure prevented and maintenance responsibility; formal assurance may genuinely require a model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: This rejects universal ceremony,not automata learning or required formal models in specific verification/control contexts.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: One adequate task without a new state-machine artifact defeats universal necessity. A model checker that specifically requires a machine can justify that local artifact without quantifying over every task. Keep useful explicit formalization and interoperability requirements. The target of criticism is an unsupported universal mandate, not the existence of a legitimate local artifact consumer.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: An authorized local process may require an artifact; research does not override it. A useful artifact still does not create normative authority for its contents.

Full model completion unnecessary for some bug witnesses.

STEPS: Identify the uncertainty kind and applicability.
Establish nonemptiness before computing a diameter.
Evaluate target width and its numerical certificate.
Assess the distinct coverage/posterior/feasibility warrant; preserve an unresolved warrant as UNKNOWN for the corresponding epistemic claim.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The realized C is established nonempty, its target diameter is within the declared delta and the exact asserted uncertainty justification is established; record the confidence/posterior/containment meaning without converting it.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An established nonempty C contains a pair whose target difference exceeds delta, or C is established empty so no estimate satisfies this practical-precision claim. An empty deterministic feasible set diagnoses inconsistency of the asserted model/data/error assumptions; an empty confidence-set realization alone need not invalidate the procedure’s nominal coverage.

Establish nonemptiness before computing a diameter.

Assess the distinct coverage/posterior/feasibility warrant; preserve an unresolved warrant as UNKNOWN for the corresponding epistemic claim.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The realized C is established nonempty, its target diameter is within the declared delta and the exact asserted uncertainty justification is established; record the confidence/posterior/containment meaning without converting it.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An established nonempty C contains a pair whose target difference exceeds delta, or C is established empty so no estimate satisfies this practical-precision claim. An empty deterministic feasible set diagnoses inconsistency of the asserted model/data/error assumptions; an empty confidence-set realization alone need not invalidate the procedure’s nominal coverage.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not attribute this synthesized record wording to a historical author; Åström–Eykhoff1971 already discuss energy/time/output constraints and estimation variance; control-oriented design and nonasymptotic follow-ups change the objective and assumptions.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Choose feasible experiments to reduce uncertainty that matters to a stated decision, while accounting for experiment cost and operating constraints.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A choice among admissible excitation/measurement designs, not merely a model-fitting algorithm.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: An input maximizes nominal Fisher information but violates actuator limits or excites an unmodeled resonance; Rohrs provides a related control consequence, not a direct optimal-design trial.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Define a design objective such as target variance, uncertainty-set diameter or expected decision loss; constrain delivered input, state/output, duration and reset options; test sensitivity to the nominal design model. In dual control the policy changes both the physical trajectory and future beliefs. Belief-state dynamic programming weighs those future observations by their effect on downstream expected loss. Klenske–Hennig §3.1 gives σ²_next = σ² Q/(u² σ²+Q), so the input changes posterior variance. Their §6.3 deliberately leaves an irrelevant parameter unexplored because it does not affect the required trajectory.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use robust/sequential design, bounded stopping and relevant finite-sample objectives when supported; preserve the passive-data alternative.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Acquire more useful data per constrained experiment and avoid experiments whose information has no consumer.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Matched FRF example and exact-noiseless shortest-experiment theory support narrow payoffs; practical nonasymptotic2025 follow-up remains abstract-only. CL031 gives simple source-authored simulations, with 50 shared-seed runs per task, showing delayed and target-selective exploration. These are explanatory comparisons, not field safety or universal practical-value estimates.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: New data can be actively acquired and the expected information benefit exceeds its disruption/cost.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Reuse passive operational data if they answer the target; use a short scalar probe or stop once alternatives no longer change the decision.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CANONICAL_COMMON_AND_DISTINCT_CONTENT: Retain B decision-value optimization as a distinct claim from A external-action admissibility, which has a normative and safety bearer. Assessment of a proposed experiment must not require its benefit or authorization already to be established. Feasibility, authority and benefit are assessed premises.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An experiment, data-acquisition design or its decision-value/feasibility claim is proposed, selected or relied on.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Reuse passive operational data if they answer the target; use a short scalar probe or stop once alternatives no longer change the decision.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: A feasible design set and resource limits are specified; predictive design model/noise assumptions are credible; closed-loop dependence accounted for. For CL031: declared initial Gaussian joint belief, observation/noise model, finite horizon and quadratic cost; static unknown parameters in the base derivation. Approximate Gaussian filtering, local quadratic cost expansion and numerical optimization are additional restrictions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: An optimum is relative to design/model/noise/objective class. No universal D-optimality, shortest-time or safest experiment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Conditional design comparisons and specific demonstrations; no general advantage for a named criterion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: NOT_APPLICABLE as universal normative authority. This is a conditional scientific/methodological claim; any acceptance threshold is a separately stipulated consumer requirement.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Derive target sensitivity and forecast information under each candidate; verify constraints on the delivered experiment, not only commands. Source versions and access levels in sources.json; constructed witnesses explicitly tagged.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unknown admissible operation, unmeasured delivered input or no credible forecast of target benefit. Consequence: weaken or withhold the transferred claim, not automatically reject all model utility.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Constrained optimization, trial operation and safety margins cost effort. Adaptive design can make noise/input dependence invalidate fixed-design guarantees. Dual-control outer optimization repeatedly recomputes the nominal trajectory and uncertain cost-to-go; higher-dimensional planning remains expensive. A shorter horizon or a fixed robust controller can be cheaper when information cannot affect later actions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Stop/refine when marginal decision value falls below acquisition cost, constraints change or design assumptions fail.

mechanism.value: Define a design objective such as target variance, uncertainty-set diameter or expected decision loss; constrain delivered input, state/output, duration and reset options; test sensitivity to the nominal design model. In dual control the policy changes both the physical trajectory and future beliefs. Belief-state dynamic programming weighs those future observations by their effect on downstream expected loss. GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Use y=G(q,theta)u+H(q,theta)e, form innovations/prediction errors and minimize an explicit criterion. Polynomial special cases encode different shared poles and noise locations; Gaussian likelihood adds distribution/initial-state terms.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Noise misspecification can move process estimates, while an apparently expressive model can overfit finite data.

signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: AR/MA/ARMA describe stochastic outputs; ARX/ARMAX add inputs and noise structure. No named family automatically contains the real system. OLS consistency needs an appropriate limit of N^-1 Σ φ_t e_t=0 and nonsingular limiting regressor information; IV replaces φ_t by relevant, exogenous z_t. These are examples, not universal formulas for all methods.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Estimator applied to a model structure and input/output/disturbance process
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Reassess after controller, sensor, regime or disturbance statistics change. This is a conditional evaluation of the stated claim, not an inference of permission from observed behavior.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Model family, delay/order, measurement semantics, disturbance coloring, input exogeneity and instrument validity are specified.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Unknown linear dynamics or transfer functions are estimated from noisy data.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.EXPRESSION: OLS consistency needs an appropriate limit of N^-1 Σ φ_t e_t=0 and nonsingular limiting regressor information; IV replaces φ_t by relevant, exogenous z_t. These are examples, not universal formulas for all methods.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.FOUR_STATE_RULE: PASS: the estimating target and required disturbance/dependence assumptions are specified and supported sufficiently for the claimed inference. FAIL: a counterexample or measured dependence violates a necessary premise. UNKNOWN: disturbance, input errors or instrument validity remain unresolved. INAPPLICABLE: no estimation from noisy observations is claimed.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.procedure: Derive the estimating equation and its population orthogonality or likelihood argument. Use a justified noise model or valid instruments when ordinary regression is endogenous. Apply the four-state rule without converting missingness into failure.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.authoritative_outcomes: PASS: the estimating target and required disturbance/dependence assumptions are specified and supported sufficiently for the claimed inference. FAIL: a counterexample or measured dependence violates a necessary premise. UNKNOWN: disturbance, input errors or instrument validity remain unresolved. INAPPLICABLE: no estimation from noisy observations is claimed.

signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Noise modeling and nuisance estimation add variance and numerical complexity; use only complexity warranted by the decision. Without actual disturbance and sensor evidence, consistency is a conditional claim.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.LIMIT: Read the positive/restricted alternative in that case; rejected overclaims have no positive universal witness.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.MECHANISM: Feedback, colored disturbances, input errors, time variation or wrong model order break different consistency arguments.

signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Without actual disturbance and sensor evidence, consistency is a conditional claim.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: no estimation from noisy observations is claimed.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Residual checking on fitted data can conceal endogeneity; falsely rejecting a correct method because a sufficient condition was unnecessary.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Reporting optimizer convergence as consistency or silently changing the disturbance model after seeing residuals.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reassess after controller, sensor, regime or disturbance statistics change.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Noise modeling and nuisance estimation add variance and numerical complexity; use only complexity warranted by the decision. A short impulse/step-response estimate or direct gain regression can suffice when the consumer and noise conditions are simple.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional estimator theory and constructed bias example; no universal ranking of linear estimators.

signature.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Noise-aware prediction-error estimation: Choose and estimate process and noise dynamics together with their assumptions; an easy least-squares fit is consistent only under the relevant regressor/error conditions.
signature.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: A specified stochastic dynamic model and estimator.; phi_t:regressor vector; e_t:equation error; R_phi:limiting covariance; theta0:target coefficients.
signature.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: phi_t:regressor vector; e_t:equation error; R_phi:limiting covariance; theta0:target coefficients. Input/output units, sample period and innovation variance units; model order dimensionless.
signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Asymptotic probability/almost-sure mode depends on theorem; equation is not a finite-sample unbiasedness statement.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A specified stochastic dynamic model and estimator.
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: LimitN→∞ for a fixed generating regime; no replacement for finite sample error or changing-plant analysis.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Correct target within model class or acknowledged approximation; excitation; regressor/noise assumptions; stable invertible predictor where required; optimization and initial-condition treatment stated.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Estimating dynamics from noisy input/output time series or interpreting LS/PEM/ML consistency claims. Outside: No statistical consistency claim, e.g. exact noiseless interpolation explicitly limited to observed points.
signature.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For linear regression y_t=phi_t^T theta0+e_t, consistency of LS requires appropriate law-of-large-numbers conditions, nonsingular limiting E[phi phi^T], and E[phi e]=0. If the latter moment is nonzero, the limiting bias is R_phi^{-1}E[phi e], under those limits.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.PROVENANCE: Researcher-proposed operational specification derived from cited source distinctions; constructed formulas are labeled in the case ledger. It is not represented as verbatim source notation or an externally mandated rule.
SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.SOURCE_DEFINED_COMPONENTS: Specific theorem/definition/equation locators are in supporting links; a combined operational acceptance rule is researcher synthesis.

signature.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Specify G,H before fitting; derive predictor and likelihood; diagnose residuals and input/residual dependence with appropriate uncertainty. External observation correspondence remains distinct from stipulated model quantities.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Correct target within model class or acknowledged approximation; excitation; regressor/noise assumptions; stable invertible predictor where required; optimization and initial-condition treatment stated.
Specify G,H before fitting; derive predictor and likelihood; diagnose residuals and input/residual dependence with appropriate uncertainty.
A small residual is not evidence of correct noise law or unique process parameters; optimizer local minima remain possible.
signature.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Specify G,H before fitting; derive predictor and likelihood; diagnose residuals and input/residual dependence with appropriate uncertainty. Evaluate applicability first; then expression; then external premise/representation support. Preserve contrary evidence.
signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Exact finite algebra in the explicitly constructed cases; A small residual is not evidence of correct noise law or unique process parameters; optimizer local minima remain possible. Operational qualitative rules require justified review rather than an assumed total decision algorithm.
signature.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Exogenous exact FIR design with zero-mean independent output error gives zero regressor/error moment.
signature.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Past-output regressors with colored equation error generally violate orthogonality; CL006 §8.1 derives the bias.
signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Noise correlations, changing regime or convergence premises unestablished; numerical optimizer convergence alone.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No statistical consistency claim, e.g. exact noiseless interpolation explicitly limited to observed points.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Noise misspecification can move process estimates, while an apparently expressive model can overfit finite data. A model PASS without external premise support is a false promotion; an overly broad guard can reject the legitimate cheap path: For a known finite FIR with exogenous measured input and white output noise, ordinary linear least squares may be adequate.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Selecting the target/envelope after seeing results, omitting material alternatives, or reporting the convenient model result while suppressing noise correlations, changing regime or convergence premises unestablished; numerical optimizer convergence alone.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reconsider model family/noise structure after residual dependence, input-noise correlation, new operating regime or sensor changes.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Richer noise models and orders increase variance and nonlinear optimization burden; simpler shared-polynomial models can bias dynamics under misspecification. For a known finite FIR with exogenous measured input and white output noise, ordinary linear least squares may be adequate.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional estimator statements in a chosen class; not proof of external causality or physical state.

PASS.MODEL: The stated moment/limit assumptions hold and imply the consistency/bias result.
PASS.EXTERNAL: Empirical diagnostics and acquisition design support, but cannot universally prove, the assumed stochastic structure.

FAIL.MODEL: A specified model has nonzero moment causing bias, or singular information for target coefficients.
FAIL.EXTERNAL: Observed diagnostic contradiction or known feedback/noise path defeats the assumed transfer; non-rejection remains limited evidence.

UNKNOWN.MODEL: Noise correlations, changing regime or convergence premises unestablished; numerical optimizer convergence alone. The predicate is not thereby false.
UNKNOWN.EXTERNAL: Unestablished observation, class or premise correspondence: Noise correlations, changing regime or convergence premises unestablished; numerical optimizer convergence alone.

INAPPLICABLE.MODEL: No statistical consistency claim, e.g. exact noiseless interpolation explicitly limited to observed points.
INAPPLICABLE.EXTERNAL: No statistical consistency claim, e.g. exact noiseless interpolation explicitly limited to observed points. Do not count inapplicability as positive evidence.

signature.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: SPECIFICATION_ONLY_FOR_EXTERNAL_TARGET; constructed/source witnesses separately evaluated in criticism.json.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: An instrument can repair regressor/error correlation only if it is sufficiently related to the regressors and orthogonal to the relevant disturbance.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Instrument sequence z, dynamic regression and error process.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Choosing z=u merely because it is measured fails if feedback makes u correlate with e; choosing independent irrelevant noise makes the cross moment rank deficient.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Replace LS normal equations by sum z_t(y_t−phi_t^T theta)=0; consistency needs zero instrument/error moment and nonsingular instrument/regressor cross moment, plus suitable convergence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Trace reference/noise paths, use filtered valid instruments and assess conditioning; choose another estimator when no credible instrument exists.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Obtain consistent dynamics in some colored-noise settings without fully specifying the noise model.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Primary algebra and explicit thesis conditions support mechanism; no field effect size or universal efficiency superiority claimed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Colored disturbances or feedback invalidate LS orthogonality while a valid reference/auxiliary signal is available.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use ordinary LS when its moment conditions hold; no instrument is mandatory merely because data are a time series.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CANONICAL_COMMON_AND_DISTINCT_CONTENT: IV exogeneity and relevance are a mechanism separate from generic estimator matching. Correct a guard that presupposes a valid instrument is available: assess whenever IV estimation or its consistency claim is used. Instrument validity is a premise to establish, not a precondition for asking.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An instrumental-variable estimate or an IV-based consistency/identification claim is used or relied on.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use ordinary LS when its moment conditions hold; no instrument is mandatory merely because data are a time series.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Instrument provenance independent of disturbances in the needed sense; correct process parameterization; rank and law-of-large-numbers conditions; closed-loop reference properties stated.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Statistical instrument validity in the declared dynamic model; not a universal causal-identification license.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Conditional moment-based identification; no external causal interpretation without its own assumptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: NOT_APPLICABLE as universal normative authority. This is a conditional scientific/methodological claim; any acceptance threshold is a separately stipulated consumer requirement.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Derive signal path from reference/controller/noise; estimate cross moments as diagnostics; use experimental provenance to justify exogeneity. Source versions and access levels in sources.json; constructed witnesses explicitly tagged.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Finding strong instruments may require new excitation; weak instruments amplify variance and numerical sensitivity.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Frequency-response inference under stated sampling and ensemble conditions

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Spectral and correlation identification, refined finite-window analysis
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: FRF; leakage; transient error; interpolation error
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Estimate transfer response from finite measured input/output spectra.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A smooth frequency plot or default window is treated as a faithful transfer function independent of record design.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No first-invention claim is made from retrospective similarity. Native vocabulary and the scope of later operational predicates remain distinct.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A frequency-response estimate must carry excitation, record-length, transient, noise and sampling assumptions adequate for its use.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Finite-record frequency-response estimate at specified frequencies
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A smooth frequency plot or default window is treated as a faithful transfer function independent of record design.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Design periodic steady measurements when feasible, or model finite-window transients and quantify window/interpolation bias with noise; do not hide unresolved frequencies by smoothing.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Experiment and leakage analysis are coupled rather than using a spectral window as an automatic correction.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Separates a plant feature from finite-record artifacts and avoids wasteful record length or inappropriate smoothing.

PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE.EVIDENCE: Conditional analytical result and author simulations; journal full body unavailable, conference body inspected.
PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE.UNPROVED: No universal cost-benefit advantage or target-system effect is asserted.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Engineer using a measured resonance, delay or frequency band for design.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A few well-controlled steady sinusoidal measurements can answer a narrow band question without a global parametric model.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CANONICAL_COMMON_AND_DISTINCT_CONTENT: A emphasizes finite frequency-response estimation and nonlinear best-linear-approximation ensemble dependence; B has the same frequency/ensemble bearer. Keep spectrum, amplitude distribution, leakage, transient and uncertainty conditions rather than treating a linear approximation as an intrinsic nonlinear plant.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A few well-controlled steady sinusoidal measurements can answer a narrow band question without a global parametric model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Relevant cited theory assumes stable causal SISO LTI dynamics and its stated input/noise regularity; periodic no-leakage claims require actual periodic steady data and integer periods.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Reenter after sample timing, record length, window, operating point or input spectrum changes.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.FOUR_STATE_RULE: PASS: the claimed frequency feature is supported under a documented acquisition/error budget adequate to the consumer. FAIL: a known transient/window artifact or unexcited band defeats the claim. UNKNOWN: acquisition, stationarity or error budget is missing. INAPPLICABLE: no frequency-domain inference is used.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.PROVENANCE: Source-derived finite-window mechanism, with a researcher acceptance rule.

Use source-compatible finite-window analysis or a discriminating repeated experiment.

REQUIRED_EVIDENCE.SOURCE_PRECONDITIONS: Relevant cited theory assumes stable causal SISO LTI dynamics and its stated input/noise regularity; periodic no-leakage claims require actual periodic steady data and integer periods.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE.DISCRIMINATING_EVIDENCE: Repeat at changed record length or periodic steady excitation and test whether the disputed feature persists.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.procedure: Design periodic steady measurements when feasible, or model finite-window transients and quantify window/interpolation bias with noise; do not hide unresolved frequencies by smoothing. Apply the four-state rule without converting missingness into failure.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.authoritative_outcomes: PASS: the claimed frequency feature is supported under a documented acquisition/error budget adequate to the consumer. FAIL: a known transient/window artifact or unexcited band defeats the claim. UNKNOWN: acquisition, stationarity or error budget is missing. INAPPLICABLE: no frequency-domain inference is used.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.cheap_path_semantics: The cost/cheaper-alternative field is a legitimate method choice. It is not automatically an inapplicable evaluation.

signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Long records improve resolution but cost time and can span drift; averaging/windowing trades variance against bias. Exact aliasing boundary and contemporary local-polynomial refinements are not fully developed here; parent B03 covers sampling separately.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.LIMIT: Read the positive/restricted alternative in that case; rejected overclaims have no positive universal witness.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.MECHANISM: Initial transients, nonstationarity, nonlinear distortion or inadequate line excitation can invalidate the estimate.

signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Exact aliasing boundary and contemporary local-polynomial refinements are not fully developed here; parent B03 covers sampling separately.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: no frequency-domain inference is used.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Smooth plots falsely signal precision; refusing all finite-window estimates would discard useful bounded measurements.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Increase smoothing until an inconvenient feature disappears, without exposing the bias tradeoff.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reenter after sample timing, record length, window, operating point or input spectrum changes.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Long records improve resolution but cost time and can span drift; averaging/windowing trades variance against bias. A few well-controlled steady sinusoidal measurements can answer a narrow band question without a global parametric model.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional analytical result and author simulations; journal full body unavailable, conference body inspected.

signature.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Frequency-domain and best-linear-approximation validity: Interpret a frequency response or best linear approximation under its excited frequency set, sampling, transient, noise and nonlinear-input conditions.
signature.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: An estimated FRF or linear projection of a possibly nonlinear system under a particular input ensemble.; a,b:fixed coefficients with units; u:Gaussian input; s²:input variance>0; linear gain:output/input units.
signature.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: a,b:fixed coefficients with units; u:Gaussian input; s²:input variance>0; linear gain:output/input units. FrequencyHz orrad/s explicitly; FRF output/input units; spectral variance and power units declared.
signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Expectation over the declared input law; one finite noisy sample only estimates it.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: An estimated FRF or linear projection of a possibly nonlinear system under a particular input ensemble.
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Stationary ensemble-specific relation; change in input law can change BLA without time variation in the plant.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Known input and sampling; enough power at target frequencies; treatment of transients/feedback; declared input spectrum/amplitude/distribution for nonlinear systems.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Frequency-domain diagnosis, controller-band modeling or using a linear model where nonlinear response is possible. Outside: No linear/frequency model is being used, or a nonlinear target is directly represented with its own evidence.
signature.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For a memoryless cubic y=a u+b u^3 with zero-mean Gaussian u of variance s², the least-squares linear coefficient is E[u y]/E[u²]=a+3b s². Its validity is conditional on that input law, not a claim that y is physically linear.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.PROVENANCE: Researcher-proposed operational specification derived from cited source distinctions; constructed formulas are labeled in the case ledger. It is not represented as verbatim source notation or an externally mandated rule.
SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.SOURCE_DEFINED_COMPONENTS: Specific theorem/definition/equation locators are in supporting links; a combined operational acceptance rule is researcher synthesis.

signature.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Record actual excitation and period lengths; estimate spectra/repeat variability; identify whether a result is local linearization, FRF of an LTI model or BLA. External observation correspondence remains distinct from stipulated model quantities.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Known input and sampling; enough power at target frequencies; treatment of transients/feedback; declared input spectrum/amplitude/distribution for nonlinear systems.
Record actual excitation and period lengths; estimate spectra/repeat variability; identify whether a result is local linearization, FRF of an LTI model or BLA.
Finite leakage, low input power and nonlinear distortion can dominate nominal sensor-noise variance.
signature.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Record actual excitation and period lengths; estimate spectra/repeat variability; identify whether a result is local linearization, FRF of an LTI model or BLA. Evaluate applicability first; then expression; then external premise/representation support. Preserve contrary evidence.
signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Exact finite algebra in the explicitly constructed cases; Finite leakage, low input power and nonlinear distortion can dominate nominal sensor-noise variance. Operational qualitative rules require justified review rather than an assumed total decision algorithm.
signature.POSITIVE_WITNESS: XCL05: a=1,b=0.1 gives gains1.3 and2.2 at input variances1 and4.
signature.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Declaring the changed BLA gain proof of plant drift when only excitation variance changed.
signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Input distribution unknown, transient/feedback contamination unresolved or measurement records too short for claimed resolution.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No linear/frequency model is being used, or a nonlinear target is directly represented with its own evidence.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Excellent linear fit in one excitation class can obscure nonlinear distortions and understate uncertainty elsewhere. A model PASS without external premise support is a false promotion; an overly broad guard can reject the legitimate cheap path: Estimate only the frequency band needed by a modest decision; do not fit an unrestricted time-domain mechanism when a band-limited FRF suffices.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Selecting the target/envelope after seeing results, omitting material alternatives, or reporting the convenient model result while suppressing input distribution unknown, transient/feedback contamination unresolved or measurement records too short for claimed resolution.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Re-evaluate after excitation amplitude/spectrum/distribution, sampling or operating point changes.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Long periods improve resolution but consume time; repeated realizations distinguish noise/distortion at extra cost; windowing trades leakage and resolution. Estimate only the frequency band needed by a modest decision; do not fit an unrestricted time-domain mechanism when a band-limited FRF suffices.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Specific FRF/BLA estimation under declared experiment; no unique nonlinear mechanism.

PASS.MODEL: Moment derivation yields the specified ensemble-conditioned linear coefficient.
PASS.EXTERNAL: Acquisition and repeated experiments support the specified ensemble and approximation envelope; no extrapolation beyond it.

FAIL.MODEL: A proposed ensemble-independent gain contradicts the cubic moment calculation.
FAIL.EXTERNAL: Observed dependence on amplitude/ensemble defeats the claimed universal LTI interpretation, not the usefulness of a local BLA.

UNKNOWN.MODEL: Input distribution unknown, transient/feedback contamination unresolved or measurement records too short for claimed resolution. The predicate is not thereby false.
UNKNOWN.EXTERNAL: Unestablished observation, class or premise correspondence: Input distribution unknown, transient/feedback contamination unresolved or measurement records too short for claimed resolution.

INAPPLICABLE.MODEL: No linear/frequency model is being used, or a nonlinear target is directly represented with its own evidence.
INAPPLICABLE.EXTERNAL: No linear/frequency model is being used, or a nonlinear target is directly represented with its own evidence. Do not count inapplicability as positive evidence.

signature.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: SPECIFICATION_ONLY_FOR_EXTERNAL_TARGET; constructed/source witnesses separately evaluated in criticism.json.

signature.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: A state-space realization x_next=Ax+Bu,y=Cx+Du of specified external behavior.; A:n×n;B:n×m;C:p×n;D:p×m;T:n×n invertible; initial states transformed.
signature.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: A:n×n;B:n×m;C:p×n;D:p×m;T:n×n invertible; initial states transformed. State coordinates may have arbitrary scale; output/input units retained; rank/order integers.
signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: All admissible inputs and all correspondingly transformed initial states in these exact LTI models.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A state-space realization x_next=Ax+Bu,y=Cx+Du of specified external behavior.
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Behavioral equality over all model time steps; finite-data estimation evidence is a separate premise.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Declared linear class, order/lag bounds, minimality or explicit nonminimal hidden part; data conditions and noise/finite-horizon effects of selected algorithm.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Interpreting identified states, choosing model order, converting FRF/impulse data to matrices or invoking subspace guarantees. Outside: No latent state/realization claim, e.g. direct FRF-only prediction.
signature.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For invertibleT, A2=T A1 T^-1,B2=T B1,C2=C1 T^-1,D2=D1 imply equal Markov parameters and input/output behavior with x2(0)=T x1(0). This does not imply equal physical coordinate meanings.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.PROVENANCE: Researcher-proposed operational specification derived from cited source distinctions; constructed formulas are labeled in the case ledger. It is not represented as verbatim source notation or an externally mandated rule.
SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.SOURCE_DEFINED_COMPONENTS: Specific theorem/definition/equation locators are in supporting links; a combined operational acceptance rule is researcher synthesis.

signature.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Check Markov-parameter equality or similarity transform; compute exact controllability/observability ranks for models, justified numerical order diagnostics for data. External observation correspondence remains distinct from stipulated model quantities.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Declared linear class, order/lag bounds, minimality or explicit nonminimal hidden part; data conditions and noise/finite-horizon effects of selected algorithm.
Check Markov-parameter equality or similarity transform; compute exact controllability/observability ranks for models, justified numerical order diagnostics for data.
Small singular values need tolerance/noise context; exact zeros in a noiseless model do not arise literally in generic noisy data.
signature.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Check Markov-parameter equality or similarity transform; compute exact controllability/observability ranks for models, justified numerical order diagnostics for data. Evaluate applicability first; then expression; then external premise/representation support. Preserve contrary evidence.
signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Exact finite algebra in the explicitly constructed cases; Small singular values need tolerance/noise context; exact zeros in a noiseless model do not arise literally in generic noisy data. Operational qualitative rules require justified review rather than an assumed total decision algorithm.
signature.POSITIVE_WITNESS: XCL02 explicitly transforms a two-state model and preserves its first Markov parameters; CL008 estimates a state basis by projection.
signature.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: A hidden mode with B2=C2=0 is absent from transfer data even if unstable; an identified minimal realization cannot certify the complete physical plant stable.
signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Unknown order, noisy near-rank deficiency, missing initial-state treatment or unestablished coordinate-to-physics map.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No latent state/realization claim, e.g. direct FRF-only prediction.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Algorithmic uniqueness of a chosen basis can be mistaken for unique physical states; noisy singular-value gaps can be overread as exact order. A model PASS without external premise support is a false promotion; an overly broad guard can reject the legitimate cheap path: Use input/output predictions, Markov parameters or a subspace directly when coordinates have no physical consumer.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Selecting the target/envelope after seeing results, omitting material alternatives, or reporting the convenient model result while suppressing unknown order, noisy near-rank deficiency, missing initial-state treatment or unestablished coordinate-to-physics map.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reassess on new measurement channels, changed state dimension/order, basis-dependent downstream code or structural regime change.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: SVD thresholds/order selection, horizon size and noise affect computation/variance; finite-history approximations can introduce bias. Use input/output predictions, Markov parameters or a subspace directly when coordinates have no physical consumer.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Exact representation equivalence plus conditional statistical realization; no complete ontology of the plant.

PASS.MODEL: The algebraic transform and behavior correspondence hold for the models.
PASS.EXTERNAL: The external input/output correspondence is supported in scope; no physical state interpretation is inferred absent independent sensors/constraints.

FAIL.MODEL: The proposed representation changes Markov parameters or initial-state behavior without an allowed correspondence.
FAIL.EXTERNAL: Predictions fail under allowed experiments, or an asserted physical state map is contradicted by measurements.

UNKNOWN.MODEL: Unknown order, noisy near-rank deficiency, missing initial-state treatment or unestablished coordinate-to-physics map. The predicate is not thereby false.
UNKNOWN.EXTERNAL: Unestablished observation, class or premise correspondence: Unknown order, noisy near-rank deficiency, missing initial-state treatment or unestablished coordinate-to-physics map.

INAPPLICABLE.MODEL: No latent state/realization claim, e.g. direct FRF-only prediction.
INAPPLICABLE.EXTERNAL: No latent state/realization claim, e.g. direct FRF-only prediction. Do not count inapplicability as positive evidence.

signature.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: SPECIFICATION_ONLY_FOR_EXTERNAL_TARGET; constructed/source witnesses separately evaluated in criticism.json.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Feedback-aware identification and disturbance correlation

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Åström–Eykhoff1971 warn about identifying the feedback inverse, including operator-mediated feedback. Forssell–Ljung1999 unify direct, indirect and joint approaches.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Closed-loop identification; direct/indirect/joint input–output; reference instruments.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Trace u=r−Ky and disturbance entry; use a valid joint/noise predictor, known-controller indirect method, or reference-based instrument/projection as appropriate.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A blanket claim that closed-loop data are biased is as misleading as ignoring feedback entirely.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not attribute this synthesized record wording to a historical author; Åström–Eykhoff1971 warn about identifying the feedback inverse, including operator-mediated feedback. Forssell–Ljung1999 unify direct, indirect and joint approaches.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Model the actual feedback data-generation path before inferring plant dynamics; feedback creates dependence but does not prohibit identification.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Plant/controller/reference/disturbance loop and estimator.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Treating u andv as independent because u was recorded, while u is generated fromy.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Trace u=r−Ky and disturbance entry; use a valid joint/noise predictor, known-controller indirect method, or reference-based instrument/projection as appropriate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use method-specific direct/indirect/joint conditions; retain the identification/control interdependence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoid learning the controller or operating policy in place of plant dynamics.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Primary analytic limit and constructed static witness; no prevalence estimate of industrial misuse.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Controller or human operator changes inputs in response to outputs, including logged operational data.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use simple open-loop LS only when the actual acquisition and error model meet its assumptions; no need to reconstruct an absent feedback loop.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CANONICAL_COMMON_AND_DISTINCT_CONTENT: Both assess the dependence created by feedback and the need for informative reference/noise treatment. The constructions differ: A supplies an independent reference and recovers the true coefficient with IV; B exhibits an unexcited algebraic feedback ratio. Do not average these as performance estimates.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Controller or human operator changes inputs in response to outputs, including logged operational data.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use simple open-loop LS only when the actual acquisition and error model meet its assumptions; no need to reconstruct an absent feedback loop.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Loop stability/well-posedness and controller/reference/noise assumptions required by method; relevant excitation and correct model class.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Correct direct PEM can be consistent; naive spectral or regression estimators may instead recover loop-induced relations.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Conditional plant inference in a specified loop; not automatic causal interpretation of arbitrary logs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: NOT_APPLICABLE as universal normative authority. This is a conditional scientific/methodological claim; any acceptance threshold is a separately stipulated consumer requirement.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Rohrs et al1981–1985 exposed unmodeled-dynamics fragility of specified adaptive algorithms; Åström1985 accepted the importance while disputing a complete infinite-gain explanation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Adaptive control robustness; parameter drift; unmodeled high-frequency dynamics; excitation monitoring.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Analyze the closed-loop interconnection and uncertainty at relevant frequencies; restrict adaptation/excitation or use robust safeguards whose own assumptions are explicit.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Strong nominal proofs can be arbitrarily fragile to neglected dynamics; disputed explanations must not be collapsed into one retrospective story.

signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: No claim that every identification-control loop converges or that dual-control optimality is computationally available. [true plant∈U_t] ∧ [controller guarantees R for every plant in U_t under common premises] may imply R; either conjunct alone does not.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Model/uncertainty set/controller/operating-envelope composition
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Reenter after controller, model, uncertainty semantics or constraints change. This is a conditional evaluation of the stated claim, not an inference of permission from observed behavior.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Valid uncertainty semantics/enclosure, actual controller model, initial safe state and scope-compatible robustness analysis.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Identified models affect feedback actions, stability or constraints.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.EXPRESSION: [true plant∈U_t] ∧ [controller guarantees R for every plant in U_t under common premises] may imply R; either conjunct alone does not.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.FOUR_STATE_RULE: PASS: an applicable joint argument establishes the claimed performance/constraints for the declared uncertainty and interval. FAIL: a counterexample within those assumptions violates it or the claimed premises are inconsistent. UNKNOWN: only estimator convergence or separate incompatible claims are available. INAPPLICABLE: identification never affects control or safety decisions.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.procedure: Weight identification errors by the controller-sensitive directions, propagate retained uncertainty through the controller, and provide transient/fallback arguments where learning changes actions. signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Robustness analysis and repeated design can be costly/conservative; identify only the needed directions. Actual joint validation remains application-specific.

signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Select the uncertainty set after seeing the successful controller and omit failed regimes.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reenter after controller, model, uncertainty semantics or constraints change.

signature.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Estimator convergence versus adaptive closed-loop robustness: Identification convergence, tracking fit or parameter boundedness does not by itself prove robustness or safety of the closed-loop adaptive system.
signature.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: Plant, estimator, control law, unmodeled dynamics/disturbances and allowed excitation as a combined dynamical system.; Plant setP;disturbance setW;controller/adaptation lawK;initial setX0;closed-loop trace propertyS.
signature.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Plant setP;disturbance setW;controller/adaptation lawK;initial setX0;closed-loop trace propertyS. Frequency, gain, disturbance and state/input limits in declared units; stability is qualitative.
signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Universal only within declared P,W,X0; probabilistic safety must instead specify a probability space and horizon.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Plant, estimator, control law, unmodeled dynamics/disturbances and allowed excitation as a combined dynamical system.
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Asymptotic stability and finite-horizon constraint satisfaction are different conclusions.
signature.ASSUMPTIONS: Specified plant class and uncertainty envelope; controller/estimator implementation; disturbances, saturation, delays and excitation bounds.
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Estimated parameters or models change control actions online, especially when invoking nominal convergence proofs. Outside: Offline descriptive identification with no control authority or robustness claim.
signature.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: A closed-loop robustness claim requires its own implication: all plants/disturbances in the declared uncertainty set, with the specified adaptation law and initial-state set, satisfy the stated boundedness/stability property. Estimator consistency alone is not a sufficient premise. A prior-relative expected-cost optimum is a different quantified claim from all-plants robust safety; neither Gaussian posterior concentration nor a local dual-control cost minimum supplies the missing implication.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.PROVENANCE: Researcher-proposed operational specification derived from cited source distinctions; constructed formulas are labeled in the case ledger. It is not represented as verbatim source notation or an externally mandated rule.
SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.SOURCE_DEFINED_COMPONENTS: Specific theorem/definition/equation locators are in supporting links; a combined operational acceptance rule is researcher synthesis.

signature.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Derive interconnection and test/prove worst-case behavior under bounded uncertainty; keep adaptation and estimation claims distinct. External observation correspondence remains distinct from stipulated model quantities.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Specified plant class and uncertainty envelope; controller/estimator implementation; disturbances, saturation, delays and excitation bounds.
Derive interconnection and test/prove worst-case behavior under bounded uncertainty; keep adaptation and estimation claims distinct.
Finite simulations establish counterexamples or tested feasibility, not universal stability; uncertainty outside the envelope is unassessed.
signature.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Derive interconnection and test/prove worst-case behavior under bounded uncertainty; keep adaptation and estimation claims distinct. Evaluate applicability first; then expression; then external premise/representation support. Preserve contrary evidence.
signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Exact finite algebra in the explicitly constructed cases; Finite simulations establish counterexamples or tested feasibility, not universal stability; uncertainty outside the envelope is unassessed. Operational qualitative rules require justified review rather than an assumed total decision algorithm.
signature.POSITIVE_WITNESS: CL012 §§III–V gives particular references/disturbances causing instability with unmodeled poles; CL013 proposes excitation-aware restrictions and switching off.
signature.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Accepting adaptive deployment because nominal parameter convergence holds while omitted high-frequency poles interact with adaptation.
signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: No uncertainty envelope, unknown saturation/delay, or proof covers nominal plant only.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Offline descriptive identification with no control authority or robustness claim.
signature.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Strong nominal proofs can be arbitrarily fragile to neglected dynamics; disputed explanations must not be collapsed into one retrospective story. A model PASS without external premise support is a false promotion; an overly broad guard can reject the legitimate cheap path: Keep a validated fixed robust controller and freeze adaptation when information is inadequate; adaptation is optional if it offers no supported decision gain.
signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Selecting the target/envelope after seeing results, omitting material alternatives, or reporting the convenient model result while suppressing no uncertainty envelope, unknown saturation/delay, or proof covers nominal plant only.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Re-enter analysis when unmodeled bandwidth, controller/adaptation gain, disturbance amplitude, saturation or model envelope changes.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Robustification, monitoring and restricted excitation can reduce tracking speed or identification precision. Keep a validated fixed robust controller and freeze adaptation when information is inadequate; adaptation is optional if it offers no supported decision gain.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional robustness of specified interconnections; neither nominal convergence nor case success proves deployment safety.

PASS.MODEL: The separately specified closed-loop theorem/property is established for its model class.
PASS.EXTERNAL: Evidence supports the real loop’s inclusion in that class; the theorem does not verify its own uncertainty envelope.

FAIL.MODEL: An admissible model/trace violates the closed-loop property.
FAIL.EXTERNAL: An observed violation or relevant Rohrs-style counterexample falsifies the particular transferred guarantee.

UNKNOWN.MODEL: No uncertainty envelope, unknown saturation/delay, or proof covers nominal plant only. The predicate is not thereby false.
UNKNOWN.EXTERNAL: Unestablished observation, class or premise correspondence: No uncertainty envelope, unknown saturation/delay, or proof covers nominal plant only.

INAPPLICABLE.MODEL: Offline descriptive identification with no control authority or robustness claim.
INAPPLICABLE.EXTERNAL: Offline descriptive identification with no control authority or robustness claim. Do not count inapplicability as positive evidence.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Unknown covariance, unsupported prior support, tuning reused validation data or unexamined hyperparameter sensitivity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No regularization/prior interpretation, or exact adequately conditioned finite regression.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: Priors can create apparent identifiability and precision unsupported by data. A model PASS without external premise support is a false promotion; an overly broad guard can reject the legitimate cheap path: Use a low-dimensional unregularized fit when information and validation already suffice; no kernel is mandatory.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Selecting the target/envelope after seeing results, omitting material alternatives, or reporting the convenient model result while suppressing unknown covariance, unsupported prior support, tuning reused validation data or unexamined hyperparameter sensitivity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reassess after evidence of instability, different decay scales/noise, changed input distribution or target requiring omitted dynamics.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Kernel/hyperparameter selection and sensitivity checks cost computation; strong priors can mask weak data. Use a low-dimensional unregularized fit when information and validation already suffice; no kernel is mandatory.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Conditional Bayes/regularization correspondence; no universal comparative superiority or external calibration.

PASS.MODEL: The conditional posterior/penalized estimator algebra holds.
PASS.EXTERNAL: Observed data and domain evidence support the prior/likelihood envelope; this support is defeasible.

FAIL.MODEL: An asserted estimator correspondence contradicts its covariance/penalty model. Calling a joint-MAP point estimate a fully integrated posterior without an additional integration procedure is an inferential mismatch.
FAIL.EXTERNAL: Known unstable behavior or noise mismatch invalidates the external prior-based claim.

UNKNOWN.MODEL: Unknown covariance, unsupported prior support, tuning reused validation data or unexamined hyperparameter sensitivity. The predicate is not thereby false. An unexamined MCMC mixing error or unresolved joint local optimum can leave the claimed numerical approximation unknown.
UNKNOWN.EXTERNAL: Unestablished observation, class or premise correspondence: Unknown covariance, unsupported prior support, tuning reused validation data or unexamined hyperparameter sensitivity.

INAPPLICABLE.MODEL: No regularization/prior interpretation, or exact adequately conditioned finite regression.
INAPPLICABLE.EXTERNAL: No regularization/prior interpretation, or exact adequately conditioned finite regression. Do not count inapplicability as positive evidence.

mechanism.value: Under a linear Gaussian model, quadratic penalties and Gaussian priors yield related estimators; inspect likelihood-versus-prior influence, tune with an appropriate method and test plausible alternative commitments.

Under a Gaussian linear observation model, the posterior mean equals a kernel-penalized least-squares solution. A transformed Wiener-process kernel encodes decay/smoothness; hyperparameters control the bias/variance tradeoff. With a hierarchy p(h|η)p(η), full Bayes uses p(h|D)=∫p(h|D,η)p(η|D)dη. Empirical Bayes estimates η and conditions on that value. Hierarchical joint MAP instead optimizes (h,η) together. These are distinct inferential operations even when all use a hierarchical model.
