PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: The selected sparse equation satisfies its declared bounded prediction or structural-recovery criterion.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: SparseClaim(claim_target,M,Theta,coordinates,D_train,D_test,R)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: claim_target is BOUNDED_PREDICTION or STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY; Xi coefficients have term-specific units; R is the declared regime set; error tolerance is in output units; support-set equality is nominal.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Across the specified independent trajectories and sensitivity alternatives, not every possible coordinate system
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: equation model and fitted/held-out trajectories
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Finite evidence for current representation; no universal recovery claim
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Recorded library, measurements, numerical derivative/weak quadrature and intended use
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A selected sparse equation is claimed to explain or predict dynamics. Unknown or contradicted state sufficiency or library adequacy does not disable evaluation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Select the actual claimed target before evaluation. For bounded prediction, document terms/coordinates, consider identifiable design alternatives and test the frozen equation against predeclared held-out transient/regime criteria. For structural recovery, additionally assess the state/observation correspondence, dictionary adequacy and distinguishing evidence needed by that structural claim. Missing material state/library support gives UNKNOWN for recovery, not INAPPLICABLE. A concrete same-training/different-required-trajectory or omitted-state structural counterexample gives FAIL of the target it contradicts; an invalidated sufficient proof premise alone does not. Do not transfer a predictive PASS to unique physical-law recovery.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: State measurements feed features; derivatives or integrated weak residuals carry their own noise/quadrature transformation
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Feature/coordinate specification, informative training trajectories, independent initial conditions, noise/error treatment, selection path

STEPS: Activate on the asserted selected sparse equation and record BOUNDED_PREDICTION or STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY.
Compare predictive trajectories and selected structure under justified perturbations; distinguish support instability from equivalent parameterization.
Evaluate only the premises material to the selected target; report separate outcomes if both targets are asserted.

OUTCOMES.PASS: For BOUNDED_PREDICTION, documented terms/coordinates, considered design alternatives and the frozen equation meet the predeclared held-out transient/regime criterion. For STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY, the defended representation, observation/state sufficiency and distinguishing structural evidence also support the stated recovery claim.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An applicable concrete trajectory or structural counterexample contradicts the selected claim, including an omitted-state witness against advertised autonomous structure. A missing or false merely sufficient proof premise alone does not establish falsity of the underlying claim.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Evidence material to the selected target remains unresolved: for structural recovery this includes sufficient-state correspondence, library adequacy and discriminating regimes; a separate bounded predictive result can still be decided on its own evidence.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: Only a known fixed law is fitted directly and no selected sparse prediction, explanation or recovery claim is asserted.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Computable on finite alternatives; exhaustive library/coordinate sufficiency and global law recovery are not decided
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Original SINDy includes canonical sparse systems recovered in appropriate coordinates with informative transients
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: SINDy cylinder-flow slow-manifold-only data produce an erroneous off-manifold form; another coordinate transform can destroy sparsity
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Evidence material to the selected target remains unresolved: for structural recovery this includes sufficient-state correspondence, library adequacy and discriminating regimes; a separate bounded predictive result can still be decided on its own evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Only a known fixed law is fitted directly and no selected sparse prediction, explanation or recovery claim is asserted.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from canonical memorized tasks or redundant feature library; false fail from equivalent symbolic forms
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Select a library after seeing the desired law, or call high R² exact mechanism recovery
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Coordinate, feature, preprocessing, derivative/test function or sampling-envelope change invalidates support/recovery evidence
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Use known-family estimation first when justified; weak integration trades derivative noise for quadrature/test-function design
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: A conditional sparse effective equation on tested regimes; not universal or unique generating mechanism
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: The selected sparse equation meets the explicitly claimed BOUNDED_PREDICTION or STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY criterion within the declared representation and test regime; name the target with the outcome.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: The advertised sparse structural interpretation has a warranted representation, observation and validation basis.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: SparseStructureSupported(data, coordinates, library, estimator, validation)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Function list, coefficient units, singular values and physical prediction errors. Attribute ESI-RAT0133 supplies the structured arguments.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Only the declared model, input/observation regime, horizon and claim scope. Linear in coefficients permits nonlinear products as library columns; failure of a selected dictionary is not failure of all sparse regression.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A sparse-regression equation discovery claim
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Epistemic acceptance at the specified version; it is not a temporal safety invariant unless a cited theorem explicitly says so. Evidence remains valid only within its stated horizon and assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: State/observation sufficiency, representability at the claimed accuracy, reliable derivative/weak estimates and informative regressors are assessed requirements of the defended structural warrant, not prerequisites for invoking this assessment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Physical or structural interpretation is attached to a sparse learned equation, including when observed-state sufficiency or dictionary adequacy is unknown or contradicted.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Assess the stated structural-recovery warrant: check compatible state/observation semantics, representation of the defended structure, distinguishability of rival supports and validation outside the fitting trajectory. Unestablished state/library support gives UNKNOWN while the claim remains applicable. A concrete omitted-state structural falsifier gives FAIL. An established violation of an explicitly required support criterion can FAIL this warrant, but an invalidated merely sufficient proof premise alone is not falsity of the underlying structural equation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_RECONSTRUCTION of a guarded evaluation rule from the cited sources; not represented as a source-authored formula. Exact source theorem/identity terms, when used, are identified by source and locator.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect selected columns and residual dependence; compare support stability across informative resampling and alternative plausible libraries.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Record {coordinates, observed/latent variables, library functions and units, derivative/weak estimator, sampling, support, rank/conditioning, separating validation}. Supporting source links are attached at property level; a deployed judgment additionally requires its own target evidence.

STEPS: Activate on the structural interpretation, without requiring its premises to pass first.
Bind coordinates, observations, library, numerical treatment and intended structural scope.
Distinguish an actual structural falsifier from missing support or failure of a merely sufficient proof route.
Return the warrant outcome and state separately whether an actual underlying-claim falsifier is known.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The scoped coefficient/support interpretation survives specified rival structures and independent regimes with justified observation/state, library and numerical evidence.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: A concrete omitted-state/term, observationally equivalent rival structure or regime counterexample invalidates the defended structural interpretation; or an established violation of an explicitly required support criterion defeats this named warrant. The latter alone does not declare the underlying equation false.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: State sufficiency, library adequacy, derivative bias or structural distinguishability material to the claim cannot be resolved. Failure of a merely sufficient theorem premise without an actual contradiction or violated required warrant criterion also leaves the claim unresolved.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No sparse physical or structural interpretation is claimed; an explicitly bounded fitted predictor has a separate target.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: FR023 Appendix F.3 reports SINDy as best on oscillator 2 with its chosen library; this is an author-reported conditional comparison.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: FR010 Bouc–Wen and tanks examples show hidden dynamics and library choices can yield misleading structure even with useful fit.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: State sufficiency, library adequacy, derivative bias or structural distinguishability material to the claim cannot be resolved. Failure of a merely sufficient theorem premise without an actual contradiction or violated required warrant criterion also leaves the claim unresolved.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No sparse physical or structural interpretation is claimed; an explicitly bounded fitted predictor has a separate target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: An omitted nonlinear term or latent state is mistaken for an absent physical mechanism; collinear trajectory features create ambiguous supports. False negative: Requiring evidence that the true equation is in the library can be impossible; useful discovery often begins with an incomplete hypothesis class.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. Products of nonlinear functions cannot be expressed by linear-in-coefficient sparse regression.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: New regime, omitted variable, changed coordinate or dictionary invalidates prior support claims.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Dictionary growth increases conditioning, search and validation burdens; expert feature design is real labor. Cheaper path: A predictive surrogate is sufficient, or the known equation structure only requires coefficient fitting.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Linear in coefficients permits nonlinear products as library columns; failure of a selected dictionary is not failure of all sparse regression. Sparse recovery guarantees do not establish physical truth under misspecified observations. FR008 demonstrates the method; FR010 documents hidden-state and hard-nonlinearity failures; FR023 itself reports an appropriate-library SINDy win.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY_WARRANT: the advertised sparse coefficient/support interpretation is supported within the declared coordinates, observation semantics, library and regime.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE.witness: Source-reported SINDy examples recover sparse canonical equations in suitable coordinates; this is feasibility evidence conditional on those examples.

NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE.witness: Original SINDy p.3936 explains that training only on the cylinder-flow slow manifold can infer the wrong off-manifold model. Its Discussion gives representation failures.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: Only a known fixed law is fitted directly, with no selected sparse explanation, prediction or discovery claim to assess. A fitted predictor without structural interpretation removes only the structural target; a claimed selected sparse predictor still receives its bounded validation assessment.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: State sufficiency, library adequacy or missing discriminating regimes that are material to the selected recovery target give UNKNOWN while the claim remains applicable. A decisive omitted-state or required-trajectory counterexample gives FAIL. Missing full physical state does not erase a separately established bounded predictive result.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Coordinate, feature, preprocessing, derivative/test function or sampling-envelope change invalidates support/recovery evidence
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.RECONCILIATION_VARIANT_POLICY: Whole original specifications have explicit primary owners. Related clauses can appear in another child only with the declared target allocation. Original variants remain exact ancestry; operative changes are separately recorded.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.RECONCILED_WORKED_DISCRIMINATOR: SINDy cylinder slow-manifold data can miss transverse dynamics. Published Bouc–Wen test winners can miss hysteresis; tanks require the unmeasured upper state. DecAEvolve Table5 reports a SINDy oscillator2 win in its supplied polynomial/Fourier library, so failure is not universal. For dx/dt=z, dz/dt=0, two states with equal observed x and different z have different derivatives: no single-valued autonomous x-only law fits both required states. That defeats the advertised autonomous structure while a separately bounded numerical or predictive result may remain valid. Unknown sufficient-state correspondence without such a falsifier yields UNKNOWN for recovery.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Sparsity is not invariant under coordinate choice, and weak formulations cannot repair absent variables or a wrong library.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Original SINDy p.3936 explains that training only on the cylinder-flow slow manifold can infer the wrong off-manifold model. Its Discussion gives representation failures.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Use weak/integral estimates for noisy derivatives, retain coordinate/library assumptions, and collect trajectories that distinguish competing terms.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: A105 sparse-recovery component maps here; its weak-form numerical mechanism maps FR08. B adds hard-nonlinearity/hidden-state benchmarks and corrects the claim that linear-in-coefficient regression cannot represent products: a product can be a dictionary column. A sparse prediction or structural claim activates assessment before state/library sufficiency is established. The prediction and structural-warrant targets retain separate outcomes; an unknown premise affects only the claim that needs it, and a known structural counterexample cannot become INAPPLICABLE.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: Library adequacy and sufficient-state correspondence often remain assumptions. Compare rival supports on off-manifold or new-initial-state data, with permitted experiments and realistic tuning information.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A sparse-looking equation is not a scientific certificate; count recovered terms only relative to an explicit oracle.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Sparsity is representation-dependent, and more data on an uninformative manifold cannot determine missing terms or hidden dynamics. A105 sparse-recovery component maps here; its weak-form numerical mechanism maps FR08. B adds hard-nonlinearity/hidden-state benchmarks and corrects the claim that linear-in-coefficient regression cannot represent products: a product can be a dictionary column.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Weak-form numerical recovery with explicit quadrature and tuning access

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: WSINDy explicitly modifies SINDy using weak/Galerkin machinery. It is a documented method descendant and import, not a universal successor replacing direct differentiation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: weak form; test function; integration by parts; generalized least squares
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Integrating against suitable test functions can avoid pointwise differentiation of noisy data, but does not remove library error, observation insufficiency, quadrature error or tuning dependence.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Noise amplification by numerical derivatives prevents useful coefficient recovery.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Weak integration transfers differentiation to test functions but retains quadrature, covariance and dictionary requirements; benchmark threshold selection uses true coefficients.
LOCATORS: Section 2.1 weak formulation
Section 2.2 threshold choice using true nonzero coefficients
Sections 2.2–2.3 error correlation and test-function design
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Inspected experiments concern measured states and iid noise. Some threshold tuning uses ground-truth coefficients, weakening blind-recovery extrapolation.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Derivative-coordinate augmentation can amplify noise, motivating weak formulations without solving hidden-state semantics.
LOCATORS: Section 5 pick-and-place derivative-state expansion
Section 6/Table 2 Bouc–Wen structural/metric disagreement
Section 7/Table 3 cascaded tanks hidden state
Section 8 limitations
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Results refute specific naive deployments, not every sparse or latent-state discovery method.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current vocabulary or guarantees backward. Noise robustness is not structural identifiability or hidden-state reconstruction.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Weak/integral formulations can reduce pointwise differentiation noise by moving derivatives to known test functions. Bounded weak-identity/error claims require their numerical and tuning conditions; recovery claims additionally require supported state, library and identifiability assumptions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A weak-form dynamic regression procedure
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Noise amplification by numerical derivatives prevents useful coefficient recovery.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Transfer derivatives from measured trajectories to known smooth test functions, include boundary conditions, and account for correlated residuals from overlapping windows.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Weak/integral formulations can reduce pointwise differentiation noise by moving derivatives to known test functions. Bounded weak-identity/error claims require their numerical and tuning conditions; recovery claims additionally require supported state, library and identifiability assumptions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: More stable sparse estimation under supported noise and sampling conditions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: FR009 supplies the method and numerical demonstrations; its threshold choices partly use true coefficients, limiting claims of blind deployment.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Choose derivative estimation or a weak formulation and its tuning protocol.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Accurate derivatives or low-noise dense measurements already support a simpler regression.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_MECHANISM_AND_TARGET_DISTINCT: A105 is decomposed because numerical error reduction and sparse structural distinguishability have different tests. B contributes a distinct weak-form attribute/predicate and the ground-truth threshold-information limitation. Weak-form use for noisy derivative regression invokes the existing predicate before state sufficiency is known. NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY and RECOVERY_WARRANT are explicit targets within that predicate, with no new property or registry row. State/library sufficiency remains material to recovery but is not automatically a premise of a bounded integral-identity/error statement.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_SHARED_CONTENT: Both inputs identify a concrete numerical response to derivative-noise amplification and explicitly deny that it solves structural identifiability.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Weak forms are used for a noisy derivative-regression problem and their numerical adequacy or an associated recovery warrant is assessed. State sufficiency, library adequacy and numerical premises may be established, unknown or violated; they are not invocation gates.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: No noisy derivative-regression problem is present or weak forms are not used. Accurate derivatives or low-noise dense measurements may support a cheaper direct regression; missing state or an inadequate library is not a non-trigger for an asserted weak-form recovery claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: For NUMERICAL_ADEQUACY, establish the regularity, boundary treatment, quadrature resolution, noise/covariance control and permitted tuning information needed by the stated weak-identity/error claim. RECOVERY_WARRANT additionally needs justified state/observation sufficiency, library adequacy and informative data for the defended recovery scope. These conditions are assessed after invocation; numerical control cannot supply missing structural information.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Noise robustness is not structural identifiability or hidden-state reconstruction.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Test functions must meet integration-by-parts boundary/regularity conditions; quadrature must resolve the data and relevant transitions. Overlap-induced residual correlation needs treatment. A threshold chosen using the true minimum nonzero coefficient is unavailable to a blind learner.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: UniqueSimpleLaw(D,F,complexity,physical_equivalence)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: D observations with units; F admissible laws; complexity grammar-dependent count; equivalence declared
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: All laws attaining the declared simplicity/fit criterion must belong to one relevant generating-mechanism equivalence class Keep the original universal domain fixed; a restriction is a different evaluated proposition.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: expression class and observation regime
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Universal sufficiency candidate; counterexample at one regime refutes it
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Admissible class contains the rival laws and observed trajectory is correct
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: Uniqueness is inferred from simplicity/fit alone
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Evaluate only the original, explicitly stated universal proposition. PASS requires a valid argument for its entire original quantified domain with its original premises. FAIL requires a valid in-domain counterexample. UNKNOWN means the proposition or required evidence remains unsettled; lack of proof alone is not falsity. INAPPLICABLE when no such universal proposition is asserted. A restricted descendant with added premises is evaluated under a different named target and cannot establish this universal.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Counterexample exact; exhaustive symbolic uniqueness is generally not decided by finite search
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: No positive witness for the unrestricted admitted proposition is asserted after the retained counterexample. Restricted successful mechanisms are preserved under ESI-RC-FR09:QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_LICENSE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: In the stipulated one-term family x′=a x with a∈{−1,+1}, both laws have the same term-count complexity and generate x(t)=0 for x(0)=0; at x(0)=1 they generate e^t and e^-t
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: The original admissible class, physical-equivalence relation or evidence is insufficient to establish either a full universal argument or a valid in-domain counterexample. Lack of exhaustive symbolic search does not override an already established pair of compatible, physically different laws.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No physical-law uniqueness claim
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False uniqueness from restricted grammar; false mismatch from algebraically equivalent expressions or gauge conventions
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Report numerical R² as symbolic recovery or optimize the grammar after seeing the answer
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Coordinates, grammar, simplification, oracle, initial-state coverage or interpretation changes invalidate recovery claim
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Use a compact predictor without physical interpretation when enough; collect one discriminating initial condition when feasible
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Rejects uniqueness from simplicity alone; supports no universal statement that symbolic recovery is impossible
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: UNIVERSAL_PROPOSITION: simplicity/fit alone uniquely identifies the generating law
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.name: Original universal simplicity-to-unique-law proposition
RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.reason: The input explicitly says added identifying conditions can PASS while simplicity alone is no longer the warrant. Preserve that qualified license separately instead of using it as a universal-truth PASS.
RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.changed_case: A fully observed known-class experiment with a separating initial condition can license one equation. It does not validate the original all-regime sufficiency claim, still refuted by x0=0 and rival one-term laws. Without the universal claim, its evaluation is INAPPLICABLE.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: A particular physical-law claim is licensed by independently warranted identifying evidence
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: UniqueLawClaimLicensed(equation, data, alternatives, assumptions)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Claims and alternative equations with observable consequences. Attribute ESI-RAT0137 supplies the structured arguments.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Only the declared model, input/observation regime, horizon and claim scope. Rejects the unqualified inference, not all equation discovery.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: An advertised physical-law interpretation of a fitted symbolic model
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Epistemic acceptance at the specified version; it is not a temporal safety invariant unless a cited theorem explicitly says so. Evidence remains valid only within its stated horizon and assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The rejected inference omits representation adequacy and distinguishability; those assumptions cannot be supplied by sparsity alone.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A specified unique physical-law claim is assessed under its declared alternative class, with or without available identifying evidence; the universal sufficiency claim is a separate target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Evaluate the advertised sufficiency claim: sparsity and small error alone are insufficient whenever an admissible alternative has equal observed fit and different relevant physical behavior.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_RECONSTRUCTION of a guarded evaluation rule from the cited sources; not represented as a source-authored formula. Exact source theorem/identity terms, when used, are identified by source and locator.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Compare model predictions under a structural discriminator, not only the original loss.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Record {advertised law, fit metric, rival admissible structures, physical discriminators, prior information}. Supporting source links are attached at property level; a deployed judgment additionally requires its own target evidence.

STEPS: Check applicability before substantive evaluation.
Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.
Apply the specific operational rule and inspect the stated counterexample class.
Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.PASS: Independent evidence, beyond sparsity/fit, excludes relevant alternatives; this is a qualified re-entry, not vindication of the original universal candidate.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An observationally adequate but physically different alternative exists or the source’s test winner misses the claimed physical behavior.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Alternative structure and discriminating evidence have not been examined.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: Only predictive adequacy is claimed.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: A future known-class, fully observed experiment with separating excitation could support a qualified structure claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: FR010’s better test-error Bouc–Wen model does not recover the correct hysteresis structure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Alternative structure and discriminating evidence have not been examined.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Only predictive adequacy is claimed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: Compact syntax and prediction are promoted beyond observational distinguishability. False negative: Physical discovery can be probabilistic rather than logically unique.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. Sparsity is physical truth.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Re-enter as ESI-RC-FR07 if independent structural evidence and assumptions become available.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: One decisive alternative or counterexample can suffice; universal exhaustive search is unnecessary. Cheaper path: Describe the expression as a scoped empirical predictor.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Rejects the unqualified inference, not all equation discovery. No finite empirical study excludes every imaginable model. FR010’s Bouc–Wen example separates metric ranking from hysteretic structure; analytical nullspaces also refute unconditional uniqueness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_LICENSE: a particular law claim has identifying evidence beyond sparsity/fit
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.changed_case: Separating evidence can PASS this qualified license while the inherited universal simplicity/fit-only claim remains refuted or, if unasserted, inapplicable.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE.original_universal: No positive universal witness is asserted after a valid counterexample; for FR19 broader capability truth can remain UNKNOWN.
POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE.restricted_mechanism: Preserved in the separately named bounded target or child. A preserves grammar-dependent complexity and oracle equivalence up to constants versus numerical or physical equality. B adds a published metric/structure mismatch. A universal-truth predicate and B qualified-license predicate are separate targets, not contradictory verdicts.

NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE.witness: Constructed equilibrium observation admits x′=x and x′=−x with equal term-count complexity in the stipulated candidate family, but dynamically opposite behavior away from zero. Source nonlinear examples also admit different internal arrangements with the same input/output behavior.

NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE.witness: A compact interpolating formula can be used for a bounded lookup/prediction task without claiming its generating mechanism.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Unknown admissible class, hidden variables or incomplete simplifier/oracle
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Coordinates, grammar, simplification, oracle, initial-state coverage or interpretation changes invalidate recovery claim
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.RECONCILIATION_VARIANT_POLICY: Whole original specifications have explicit primary owners. Related clauses can appear in another child only with the declared target allocation. Original variants remain exact ancestry; operative changes are separately recorded.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.RECONCILED_WORKED_DISCRIMINATOR: In xdot=a*x with a in{-1,+1}, equal one-term complexity and x(0)=0 produce the identical zero trajectory; x(0)=1 yields exp(t) versus exp(-t). Published Bouc–Wen fit can favor wrong hysteretic structure.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.BASE_WITNESS_ALLOCATION_NOTE: Original base worked examples are ancestry, not an instruction to reuse a qualified positive as a universal PASS. Operative canonical predicates and the reconciled discriminator determine the target-specific outcomes.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.RECONCILED_NEGATIVE_TARGET_RULE: For the named universal proposition: PASS requires proof or warranted evidence covering the original full quantifier; FAIL requires a reliable in-domain counterexample; UNKNOWN means neither; INAPPLICABLE means the proposition is not asserted. For FR19 advertised broad reliability, scoped evidence does not automatically falsify all future capability. Separately named bounded predicates retain their own meaning.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Simplicity is representation-dependent; a benchmark may call expressions equal up to constants while a physical decision depends on those constants.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Constructed equilibrium observation admits x′=x and x′=−x with equal term-count complexity in the stipulated candidate family, but dynamically opposite behavior away from zero. Source nonlinear examples also admit different internal arrangements with the same input/output behavior.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Publish the oracle/grammar, retain equivalent candidates and distinguish a useful effective law from a uniquely identified mechanism.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: A preserves grammar-dependent complexity and oracle equivalence up to constants versus numerical or physical equality. B adds a published metric/structure mismatch. A universal-truth predicate and B qualified-license predicate are separate targets, not contradictory verdicts.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: A particular known-class recovery can be established with further information; exhaustive uniqueness across arbitrary symbolic classes is not decided by finite search. Identify a separating experiment or preserve the equivalence class.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A readable formula or operator count is not an engineering payoff or scientific proof.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Compact syntax and predictive fit can coexist with physically different compatible mechanisms. A preserves grammar-dependent complexity and oracle equivalence up to constants versus numerical or physical equality. B adds a published metric/structure mismatch. A universal-truth predicate and B qualified-license predicate are separate targets, not contradictory verdicts.

records.title: Nonvacuous residual verification with fixed dictionary and warranted quadrature

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Nonvacuous residual verification with fixed dictionary and warranted quadrature

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Residual methods respond to spectral pollution and data-dependent dictionary failures in the DMD/EDMD family, with no sole-ancestor attribution.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: DMD; Koopman-invariant subspace; linear consistency; residual pseudospectrum
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Fit a linear map to paired snapshots or a finite operator on chosen observables, then analyze its modes.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A convenient finite matrix can produce spurious spectral claims or fail to close the nonlinear state dynamics.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.SPECIFIC_CLAIM: DMD is related conditionally to Koopman, ERA and LIM.
Exact finite lifts containing the state face restrictions.
Residual verification addresses spectral pollution and finite-data pathologies.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Koopman’s 1931 source and Schmid’s original body were not independently read. Conditional connections do not make DMD the origin of operator theory.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A ResDMD residual supports only its stated finite diagnostic or asymptotic pseudospectral conclusion when dictionary selection and quadrature preserve nonvacuity; data overlap alone neither establishes nor defeats validity.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A residual spectral diagnostic with a selected observable dictionary, evaluation/quadrature protocol and declared operator target
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Dictionary capacity or same-data interpolation forces a zero residual; a finite diagnostic or asymptotic bound is promoted to exact or complete spectral recovery.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Fix the selected dictionary, check nonvacuity and use a warranted quadrature limit for the stated residual/pseudospectral conclusion. Closure and state reconstruction are separate FR10 targets, not additional claims of this residual test.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A ResDMD residual supports only its stated finite diagnostic or asymptotic pseudospectral conclusion when dictionary selection and quadrature preserve nonvacuity; data overlap alone neither establishes nor defeats validity.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Exclude some spurious spectral conclusions under the stated conditions while exposing a residual that is forced by interpolation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: ResDMD Theorem3.1 gives its asymptotic pseudospectral bound; §§3.3.1–3.3.2 exhibit the forced-zero case and permitted evaluation constructions. §3.2.2 limits completeness. No universal exact-spectrum or physical-state recovery is established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Whether a learned mode/eigenfunction or reduced dynamic model can support prediction, analysis or control.
ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Bounded empirical predictor without a spectral claim
Different fixed dictionary with warranted quadrature
Direct evaluation of the actual finite-horizon observable target
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_MECHANISM_AND_TARGET_DISTINCT: Preserve A-only ResDMD source, attribute and residual predicate as a distinct canonical property. Exact finite lift existence and residual spectral verification are different bearers, limits and tests.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_SHARED_CONTENT: B58 discusses closure and finite fit but does not subsume A’s residual-specific theorem and dictionary-capacity interaction.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A finite DMD/Koopman model is used to claim spectrum, exact closure, long-horizon dynamics or physical state interpretation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a bounded empirical one-step linear predictor, report that predictor directly; no claim to recover an infinite-dimensional spectrum is needed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: In the full-row-rank r=M same-data construction the residual vanishes algebraically. The theorem fixes the dictionary while quadrature converges. Allowed routes include independent random splitting, suitable additional quadrature points, or a dictionary fixed from an initial ergodic segment and evaluated on an expanding overlapping prefix.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Observable dynamics and pseudospectral inclusion under stated operator/domain, not arbitrary global physical equivalence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: In the full-row-rank r=M same-data construction the residual vanishes algebraically. The theorem fixes the dictionary while quadrature converges. Allowed routes include independent random splitting, suitable additional quadrature points, or a dictionary fixed from an initial ergodic segment and evaluated on an expanding overlapping prefix.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: No external normative authority asserted. Mathematical claims are conditional; proposed acceptance procedures need a consumer-defined tolerance.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Record observables, scaling, snapshot pairing, dictionary-selection and evaluation sets including overlap, fixed dictionary size, evaluation-size sequence, quadrature measure/weights and numerical thresholds.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: C0105 library capacity, C0111 dependence-matched validation and C0112 asymptotic guarantees interact; dictionary growth can defeat a fixed-data residual test.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Non-invariant finite span, spectral pollution, unresolved continuous spectrum or reused interpolating data can invalidate the claimed conclusion.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Use additional or expanding quadrature data only as needed for a nonvacuous check; a simple predictor can avoid a costly global spectral claim
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Changing dictionary, state projection, sampling measure, rank or observation map requires rechecking closure/residual validation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RECONCILED_COMPOSITION_CONSEQUENCE: CL18 validation must preserve this source-specific dependence exception. CL19 prevents asymptotic inclusion from becoming finite physical-spectrum truth. The capacity×rank×quadrature interaction is a configuration, not a new emergent property.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: g observable; lambda spectral parameter; epsilon≥0 in normalized operator-residual scale; M′,M″,N,r counts; dictionary fixed while M″ grows

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: PASS for the bounded diagnostic when a nonvacuous residual meets epsilon and the invoked sampling/quadrature conditions and finite/asymptotic scope are warranted. Allowed routes include splitting independently sampled snapshots, suitable fresh quadrature snapshots, or a dictionary fixed from an initial ergodic-trajectory segment with evaluation on an expanding prefix of that same trajectory (§3.3.2). FAIL if full-row-rank r=M interpolation forces zero or the residual exceeds epsilon; UNKNOWN if dictionary fixing, sampling measure, quadrature convergence or nonvacuity is unsupported; INAPPLICABLE for a plain predictor without a spectral claim. Overlap/dependence alone implies neither FAIL nor UNKNOWN.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Rejected universal multi-equilibrium finite-smooth-embedding obstruction

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Critical claim-response connection to Brunton2016 is documented retrospectively by the 2025 source; it is not invented as a direct 2023 citation of 2016. Restricted refinement directly engages counterexamples.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: linearizing embedding; super-linearization; isolated equilibria
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Rejected candidate: every nonlinear system with multiple isolated equilibria lacks a finite smooth linearizing embedding, even when the embedding contains the state.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Reasoning about the whole ambient linear state space ignores the nonlinear invariant embedded submanifold.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Theorem1 constructs smooth super-linearizable systems with any finite number of isolated equilibria in dimension k>1.
LOCATORS: Theorem 1: finite number of isolated equilibria in dimension k>1
Example 1 and Remark 2: invariant embedded surfaces
Proof pp. 5–6; Remark 4 limits countable super-linearization extension
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Existence counterexamples do not give a generic algorithm, compact-attractor representation, or arbitrary-system finite closure.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Later restricted obstructions reconcile the counterexamples through additional hypotheses rather than restoring the universal assertion.
LOCATORS: Standing assumption: path-connected state space
Theorem 1: continuous immersion, precompact trajectories, countable omega-limit sets, closed target basins
Corollary 2 and discussion of discontinuous embeddings
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Removing precompactness, continuity or other hypotheses can change the conclusion. No global prohibition on useful approximate Koopman models.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current vocabulary or guarantees backward. The counterexample does not assert that every multi-equilibrium system is finitely linearizable.

records.title: Structured operator inference to a projected-model target

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Structured operator inference to a projected-model target

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Nonintrusive projection-based reduction is the native tradition; fitting an operator does not make OpInf a descendant of every DMD/Koopman algorithm.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Nonintrusive operator inference; intrusive projected operators; polynomial reduced dynamics
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Infer reduced operators from projected full-state trajectories rather than accessing full-model operators.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A black-box simulator supplies trajectories but not operators needed for intrusive projection.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.SPECIFIC_CLAIM: Inference is explicitly compared with intrusive projection of the full model.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Least squares and projection precede this method; no claim that it is the origin of all operator learning.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Operator inference estimates the specified structured reduced operators from projected full-state data under rank and numerical assumptions; its convergence theorem does not promise arbitrary fixed-small-order physical recovery.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A learned reduced polynomial operator and the source full simulator
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Convergence to a projection is described as exact physical-law recovery or guaranteed accuracy at any fixed small reduced dimension.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Project full state data into a declared basis, form a polynomial least-squares design and compare inferred coefficients with the intrusive reduced target under stated limits.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Operator inference estimates the specified structured reduced operators from projected full-state data under rank and numerical assumptions; its convergence theorem does not promise arbitrary fixed-small-order physical recovery.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Construct reduced models when full operators are unavailable but appropriate trajectories are available.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Source examples use a linear climate model and polynomial tubular reactor; they demonstrate feasibility of nonintrusive reduction, not independent validation of the full physics. Theorem 1 compares inferred and intrusive operators under full-rank and discretization conditions and allows n→N; it does not give a universal fixed-small-rank result.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Whether a reduced surrogate is accurate/useful enough for repeated simulation, analysis or later control validation.
ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Regularized constrained operator inference with separate proof
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_MECHANISM_AND_TARGET_DISTINCT: A explicitly preserves the existential reduced-dimension/time-step quantifiers. B labels the same native method domain-specific. Both describe a conditional theorem, so the canonical status reflects assumption sensitivity rather than averaging favorable labels.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_SHARED_CONTENT: The reference target is the intrusive projection of a supplied full model, not automatically the external plant.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Full state trajectories and polynomial structural information exist, while full operators are inaccessible or expensive to use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If the full model is cheap and rarely queried, or an adequate reduced model is already available, operator inference may have no lifecycle benefit.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Known polynomial structure, projection basis, full-state snapshots, consistent derivative/time approximation and full-column-rank design. For every epsilon the theorem permits suitable n<=N and sufficiently small time step, potentially n approaching N; it is not for every prechosen small n.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: The reduced projection of a specified mathematical full model, not nature itself.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Known polynomial structure, projection basis, full-state snapshots, consistent derivative/time approximation and full-column-rank design. For every epsilon the theorem permits suitable n<=N and sufficiently small time step, potentially n approaching N; it is not for every prechosen small n.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: No external normative authority asserted. Mathematical claims are conditional; proposed acceptance procedures need a consumer-defined tolerance.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Record full model/version, state access, projection basis, input trajectories, derivative estimator, step size, design rank and downstream validation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: C0103 regularization can alter bias/target; C0112 quantifiers prevent fixed-rank overclaim; C0111 validates surrogate behavior independently.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Rank deficiency, missing state access, basis truncation or derivative bias can prevent the theorem conditions or accurate useful reduced dynamics.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Use direct simulation or existing surrogate when reuse cannot amortize inference/validation
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Full model, reduced basis/dimension, structural terms, time step or input regime changes require new rank and surrogate checks.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RECONCILED_COMPOSITION_CONSEQUENCE: FR10 finite linear closure and FR13 polynomial reduction have no general implication in either direction. CL19 carries the exact target/quantifiers; RT04 allows an existing full simulator for a few queries.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The exact theorem’s rank, structure and numerical assumptions hold and the advertised conclusion retains its dimension/error scope.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: A fixed-small-order or physical-truth guarantee is claimed without support, or a required rank/structure condition is contradicted.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Snapshot semantics, derivative convergence or design rank is unverified.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The task is not projection-based structured operator inference.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: omitted quadratic features or a rank-deficient trajectory permits multiple operators and defeats unique least-squares recovery.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Snapshot semantics, derivative convergence or design rank is unverified.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The task is not projection-based structured operator inference.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: A reduced operator fit is advertised as unrestricted external system recovery or guaranteed stability at any small fixed order. False negative: The existential dimension can be too large for the intended computational saving.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. Operator inference proves any small learned surrogate stable and physically correct.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed full model, forcing, projection basis, operator structure or data rank invalidates inherited conclusions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Snapshot generation, basis construction, derivative estimation and conditioning control. Cheaper path: Intrusive projection is available, or a simpler linear surrogate already meets the use tolerance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: The theorem does not establish convergence at every fixed small n or correctness of the full physical simulator. The original proof is not an end-to-end plant-validation guarantee. FR015 provides least-squares formulation and a conditional approximation theorem; the proof allows reduced dimension to approach full dimension.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: Operator inference identifies a structured reduced surrogate under projection and rank conditions — evaluate the precisely scoped claim, including its rejection where applicable.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE.witness: Theorem 1 supplies a conditional convergence result to intrusive reduced operators; a noiseless full-basis linear regression is a legitimate limiting witness.

NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE.witness: A fixed tiny basis can omit dynamically important directions regardless of sample count; the theorem’s existence of a larger n does not certify that tiny model.

NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE.witness: If the full model is cheap and rarely queried, or an adequate reduced model is already available, operator inference may have no lifecycle benefit.

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.justification_and_limit: Theorem 1 compares inferred and intrusive operators under full-rank and discretization conditions and allows n→N; it does not give a universal fixed-small-rank result.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.justification_and_limit: Source examples use a linear climate model and polynomial tubular reactor; they demonstrate feasibility of nonintrusive reduction, not independent validation of the full physics.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.justification_and_limit: No independent replication of this particular claimed payoff was established by the inspected sources; alternate URLs/versions and same-study analyses are not counted twice.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.justification_and_limit: No independently examined field study establishes this property’s general payoff. Source-specific simulations and benchmark results are identified in the empirical partition.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.justification_and_limit: A fixed tiny basis can omit dynamically important directions regardless of sample count; the theorem’s existence of a larger n does not certify that tiny model.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.justification_and_limit: No external standard or normative mandate is asserted for this mathematical/descriptive candidate. Proposed intake checks are researcher constructions.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.justification_and_limit: Published procedures or supplied code establish inspectable mechanisms; this branch did not execute those research implementations.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.justification_and_limit: Do not transfer simulator-operator recovery to physical-law or policy-effect identification without model-to-world and causal evidence.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.justification_and_limit: The projection reference may itself be biased or inaccurate, and an existence theorem can require a dimension that removes the hoped-for computational savings.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.justification_and_limit: Polynomial/linear-in-state full structure as specified; a supplied basis; full-column-rank designs; convergent state/derivative approximations; theorem permits reduced dimension to approach full dimension and time step to shrink.

IDENTIFIABILITY.justification_and_limit: Least-squares operator identification requires informative design in the supplied reduced representation.

DATA_INFORMATIVENESS.justification_and_limit: Full-column-rank data matrix matters, not raw trajectory count alone.

ESTIMATOR_ASSUMPTIONS.justification_and_limit: Polynomial structure and numerical derivative/step consistency are part of the result.

UNCERTAINTY_CALIBRATION.justification_and_limit: The cited convergence result is not a general finite noisy uncertainty interval.

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.justification_and_limit: Examples compare modeled systems; nature-to-simulator validation is separate.

ORACLE_OR_OBSERVATION_RELIABILITY.justification_and_limit: Full state trajectories required by the setup may be unavailable from real sensors.

REPRESENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.justification_and_limit: Intrusive projection is the reference; physical correspondence is not supplied.

DECISION_USE_VALIDITY.justification_and_limit: Repeated-use payoff and control safety need additional evidence.

Does the proof allow n to increase?
What remains of the guarantee at the deployed dimension and noise level?

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Deep subspace/encoder state-space identification addresses training-state initialization and section losses; it is a documented mechanism distinct from neural-ODE numerical integration.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Neural ODEs import numerical integration and adjoint sensitivity; Ott’s solver critique and augmented architectures are distinct descendants/responses, not proof of universal physical recovery.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Neural ODE; adjoint method; solver dependence; continuous flow
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Learn a derivative function and use a numerical differential-equation solver as the model layer.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Numerical integration error can become a learned feature, and latent coordinates can be mistaken for physical state.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.SPECIFIC_CLAIM: Neural vector fields and adjoint differentiation combine established numerical and learning components.
Solver changes expose coarse-discretization dependence and motivate adaptation.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Neither neural ODEs nor adjoints originated continuous-time system identification. The critic’s classification tasks are not direct physical identification trials.

STEPS: Check applicability before substantive evaluation.
Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.
Apply the specific operational rule and inspect the stated counterexample class.
Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.PASS: Architecture assumptions are matched and numerical/external errors are separately measured or bounded.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: The required mapping violates the proved flow/head restriction, or numerical tolerance is used as the sole evidence of physical accuracy.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Regularity, output map or error decomposition is not documented.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No continuous-time neural flow or solver-based accuracy claim is used.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: FR018 adds latent dimensions to represent tasks obstructed in the specified unaugmented feature space.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: A tiny ODE integration tolerance faithfully integrates the wrong vector field and can still yield a large plant-prediction error.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No continuous-time neural flow or solver-based accuracy claim is used.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: Architectural expressivity limits or solver inaccuracies are confused with estimation/data error, or solver precision is advertised as physical accuracy. False negative: Observed outputs may cross even when full-state trajectories do not; ignoring the observation map overstates the obstruction.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. A neural ODE can represent any dynamical mapping without structural qualification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changing vector-field regularity, augmentation, output map, tolerances or event handling changes the argument.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Extra dimensions and adaptive integration add computation; training gradients may have numerical error. Cheaper path: A discrete-time model or simple observed-state ODE already meets the required behavior.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: The topology result is architecture-specific, not impossibility for all observed neural dynamics or augmented systems. Expressivity does not ensure optimization, identifiability or stable control. FR018 proves topology-related limits for specified unaugmented architectures and demonstrates augmentation; FR017 defines solver-driven continuous dynamics.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: Neural ODE flow topology and solver tolerances constrain different claims — evaluate the precisely scoped claim, including its rejection where applicable.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE.witness: Ott et al. report regimes in which tighter training precision yields solver-robust behavior; this is task-specific numerical evidence.

NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE.witness: Executed scalar decay witness: x(1)/x(0)=e^-1 is fit by Euler parameter e^-1−1, which differs from the continuous generator −1 s^-1. Swapping the solver changes prediction.

An accurate solver using that theta changes prediction. Augmenting state can address a topology obstruction without fixing this numerical binding.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Solver robustness can be passed by a physically wrong model; a coarse discrete model can still be perfectly useful for a discrete task.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Executed scalar decay witness: x(1)/x(0)=e^-1 is fit by Euler parameter e^-1−1, which differs from the continuous generator −1 s^-1. Swapping the solver changes prediction.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Use the test only for continuous-time claims, retain discrete models when adequate, and add physical/causal evidence separately.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: PINN known-operator/parameter inference is followed by soft-constraint optimization critique and comparator studies. The criticized universal is researcher-formulated, not imputed to every advocate.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Physics-informed neural network; soft PDE constraint; collocation residual
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Optimize a neural field against data/boundary terms and a supplied PDE-family residual; some constraints can be enforced by parameterization.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Sparse data can benefit from physical structure, but residual optimization is often mistaken for identified correct physics.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.SPECIFIC_CLAIM: PINN source separates forward solution from unknown-parameter inference and uses a supplied operator family.
Failure-mode study changes training/curriculum rather than claiming all physics-informed methods fail.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The rejected universal wording is a research candidate, not a quotation or claim imputed to all PINN advocates.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Finite physics-residual minimization alone does not universally establish the differential equation throughout its domain or the physical truth of the supplied operator family.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Finite collocation loss and a claimed physical law/solution
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Constraint residual, optimization convergence, PDE solution and physical correspondence are collapsed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: The actual useful mechanism is known-physics regularization or hard parameterization plus data; a finite soft residual is not a universal certificate.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Finite physics-residual minimization alone does not universally establish the differential equation throughout its domain or the physical truth of the supplied operator family.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Retained bounded form can combine sparse data and justified physics; universal form has no demonstrated payoff.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Krishnapriyan et al. show optimization failures and curriculum/sequential remedies on selected equations; Grossmann et al. compare specified FEM/PINN implementations and expose solution/evaluation cost differences. Finite-point implication is refuted by the polynomial witness. A hard parameterized identity can be exact without identifying all remaining physics.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Whether a fitted field/parameter may be treated as physically correct or used only as a tested approximation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_MECHANISM_AND_TARGET_DISTINCT: Keep A negative and hard-versus-soft enforcement distinction; send A’s bounded useful-mechanism content as ancestry to FR17. An exact encoded identity is not a PASS for all physical truth.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_SHARED_CONTENT: B63 recognizes these limits but is a positive qualified mechanism row. It cannot replace the inherited rejected universal.

original_candidate_claims.candidate_name: Physics-informed residual minimization universally establishes physical truth
original_candidate_claims.actual_candidate_claim: Candidate universal proposition: minimizing a physics-informed residual is sufficient to establish the correct physical system. Disposition rejects this implication while retaining bounded constrained estimation.
original_candidate_claims.original_method_or_historical_form: Optimize a neural field against data/boundary terms and a supplied PDE-family residual; some constraints can be enforced by parameterization.

CRITICIZED_PROPOSITION_AND_TARGETS.qualification: The historical method form is not the criticized universal. Preserve actual inherited candidate claims separately from bounded positive methods, rejection assessments and contextual-justification targets.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A PINN/physics-informed loss is cited as sufficient proof of the correct physical solution or generating law.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: When a known PDE can be solved efficiently by an established numerical method for a few queries, compare that method before paying for neural training.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Original universal quantifier ranges over admissible fitted functions and physical claims. A theorem with independently justified physics is a separate restricted target. Nonconvergence of one optimizer is not itself a universal impossibility proof.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Encoded mathematical equations versus physical system; finite training points versus a continuous domain; known parameter family versus unknown law.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Original universal quantifier ranges over admissible fitted functions and physical claims. A theorem with independently justified physics is a separate restricted target. Nonconvergence of one optimizer is not itself a universal impossibility proof.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: No external normative authority asserted. Mathematical claims are conditional; proposed acceptance procedures need a consumer-defined tolerance.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Record PDE/operator family, coefficient units, boundary/initial conditions, collocation selection, loss weighting, optimizer, simulator-derived versus physical data and independent evaluation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: C0103 regularization, C0108 numerical realization, C0111 validation, C0112 proof type and C0115 lifecycle cost.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Wrong physics can be enforced accurately; inadequate optimization/collocation can miss a correct equation’s solution; nonunique parameters or gauge remain.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Use an established PDE/inverse solver or direct observation when adequate; account for training cost
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire physical-truth wording unless independent correspondence/identification evidence exists; reconsider bounded use after domain and solver validation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RECONCILED_COMPOSITION_CONSEQUENCE: FR17 useful constraints do not erase FR16 negative. FR05 inverse ambiguity, FR15 numerical error and external observation correspondence stay separate.

UNKNOWN means the proposition or required evidence remains unsettled; lack of proof alone is not falsity. INAPPLICABLE when no such universal proposition is asserted. A restricted descendant with added premises is evaluated under a different named target and cannot establish this universal.

STEPS: Check applicability before substantive evaluation.
Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.
Apply the specific operational rule and inspect the stated counterexample class.
Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.PASS: Required components meet scoped tolerances with justified physics and independent validation.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: A soft penalty is advertised as exact enforcement, optimization failure is hidden by aggregate loss, or the assumed physics contradicts the use regime.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Coefficient identifiability, residual coverage or external tests are unavailable.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No physical-constraint or physics-informed claim is made.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Coefficient identifiability, residual coverage or external tests are unavailable.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No physical-constraint or physics-informed claim is made.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: The presence of a physics term is treated as proof of correctness while the optimization fails or the assumed physics is incomplete. False negative: Hard physical constraints can reduce flexibility when the supplied physics is approximate; fewer physical violations need not improve predictive performance.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. Physics-informed means physically correct.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed boundary conditions, coefficients, physics regime, collocation or loss weights invalidate earlier checks.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Automatic differentiation, residual evaluation, loss balancing and difficult optimization can dominate. Cheaper path: A conventional solver with calibrated parameters, or a simpler empirical model, meets the actual decision need.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Parameter estimation within a known family is not unrestricted equation discovery; low collocation residual does not certify unobserved regions. Choosing valid approximate physics and balancing competing errors remains application-specific. FR019 demonstrates parameter discovery in specified PDE families; FR020 exhibits ill-conditioned loss failures and tested mitigations. FR027 is only a partial-access corroborating lead.

STEPS: Check applicability before substantive evaluation.
Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.
Apply the specific operational rule and inspect the stated counterexample class.
Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No comparison is asserted.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Symbolic benchmarks, LLM-specific novelty controls and active simulated experimentation are different developments. Direct LLM-SRBench-to-Unsatz historical influence remains unestablished absent receiving attribution.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.SPECIFIC_CLAIM: Benchmark constructs transformed/generated tasks and compares LLM-assisted methods.
Active experiment benchmark removes a given ansatz and tests hidden regimes.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: No claim these benchmarks originated scientific discovery automation or prove all preceding LLM methods unreliable. Unsatz is a recent preprint, not a replicated field result.
