HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.justification_and_limit: Benchmark constructs transformed/generated tasks and compares LLM-assisted methods. [ESI-RS0056, §§2–3]; Active experiment benchmark removes a given ansatz and tests hidden regimes. [ESI-RS0057, §§2–4]

FORMAL_OR_THEORETICAL_RESULT.justification_and_limit: No theorem or universal guarantee of autonomous system identification is supplied by these benchmarks.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_RESULT.justification_and_limit: LLM-SRBench is a peer-reviewed 2025 benchmark with explicit construction/judging dependencies; Unsatz is a 31 October 2026 preprint of active experiments on simulated worlds. Neither establishes general field identification.

REPLICATION_OR_EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.justification_and_limit: No independent replication of this particular claimed payoff was established by the inspected sources; alternate URLs/versions and same-study analyses are not counted twice.

INDUSTRIAL_OR_FIELD_CASE.justification_and_limit: No independently examined field study establishes this property’s general payoff. Source-specific simulations and benchmark results are identified in the empirical partition.

NEGATIVE_RESULT_OR_INCIDENT.justification_and_limit: Unsatz §4.4 separates finding hidden variables from learning their mechanisms; Appendix M reports failed and worsened final models. LLM-SRBench identifies transformed-task scientific/oracle limits.

STANDARD_OR_NORMATIVE_REQUIREMENT.justification_and_limit: No external standard or normative mandate is asserted for this mathematical/descriptive candidate. Proposed intake checks are researcher constructions.

PRACTITIONER_OR_TOOL_EVIDENCE.justification_and_limit: Published procedures or supplied code establish inspectable mechanisms; this branch did not execute those research implementations.

TRANSFER_OR_DOMAIN_ANALOGY.justification_and_limit: No transfer from seeded simulated tasks to an unknown physical domain without new observation/oracle/intervention evidence; no anthropomorphic claims.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.justification_and_limit: Benchmark novelty controls and external scoring are valuable but cannot establish general scientific discovery; task generators, fitters and judges inject substantial structure.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.justification_and_limit: Declared model/version, prompt/priors, allowed grammar/experiments, fitter, budget, known oracle, genuinely held-out evaluation and complete unsuccessful/correction outcomes.

IDENTIFIABILITY.justification_and_limit: Correct predictions or hidden-state counts do not ensure the internal mechanism is recovered.

DATA_INFORMATIVENESS.justification_and_limit: Active query menus can supply information beyond passive data but within designer-defined worlds.

ESTIMATOR_ASSUMPTIONS.justification_and_limit: DSL, domain text and numeric fitter shape the search.

UNCERTAINTY_CALIBRATION.justification_and_limit: Generated confidence language is not a calibrated discovery probability.

EXTERNAL_VALIDATION.justification_and_limit: Held-out synthetic tests are useful; independent real-world transfer not established here.

ORACLE_OR_OBSERVATION_RELIABILITY.justification_and_limit: LLM symbolic judge and simulator/reference evaluator have distinct limits.

REPRESENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.justification_and_limit: Transformed equation equivalence may lose scientific causal meaning; program graph can differ despite adequate forecasts.

DECISION_USE_VALIDITY.justification_and_limit: Costs, failures and final-worsening matter to useful assistance.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Scientific priors can be useful; contamination controls narrow specific shortcuts rather than proving all pretraining exposure absent. DecAEvolve adds decomposition/adaptation/evolution to a limited tested search setting.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: symbolic regression; scientific equation discovery; LLM hypothesis generation; test-time adaptation
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: LLMs can generate useful equation hypotheses, but a discovery claim must distinguish remembered formulas, data-supported novelty, predictive fit, symbolic equivalence and evaluator error.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Known benchmark equations or model-based judges inflate apparent discovery; useful predictions are mistaken for structural truth.

LOCATORS: Sections 2.1–2.2: 111 transformed +128 synthetic problems
Section 2.3: GPT-4o symbolic judge, 130-problem human agreement check
Section 3/Table 1: 1000-call budget; LSR-Transform 31.53% best symbolic accuracy

LOCATORS: Main method: decomposition, GRPO adaptation, evolution
Limitations p.9: extra computation
Appendix F.1/Table 3: ten chemistry problems and imported baseline results
Appendix F.3/Table 5: SINDy configuration and oscillator 2 advantage
Appendix F.4: matched sample counts, not end-to-end cost
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: No new identification theorem, independent deployment, or general superiority established. Table 3 CRK19 bolding conflicts with displayed numeric ordering.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Sparse equation discovery predates LLM hypothesis generation and retains representation/information requirements.
LOCATORS: Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics; equations 1–3
Discussion of coordinates, candidate functions and noise

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: A bounded discovery capability claim stays within its evaluated protocol and scope
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: SupportedDiscovery(system_version,task_scope,oracle,budget,results,claim,claim_target); claim_target distinguishes BOUNDED_TASK_RECOVERY, NOVELTY_OR_GENERALIZATION and DATA_DRIVEN_DISCOVERY_MECHANISM
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Task/domain set nominal; success/error criteria declared; resource counts/time/currency explicit; probability claims specify population
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Only the explicitly claimed task population, metric/horizon, access and evidence target. A verdict about a directly observed task result is not a verdict about novelty, data-dependent discovery or general autonomous physical identification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: versioned agent-tool pipeline and benchmark/experiment record
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evidence current for tested versions and contamination state
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Reliable task/output definition and the evaluation information required by the particular claim. Independent holdout is required when the claim asserts independent generalization; it is not an extra prerequisite for reporting an otherwise reliable directly observed bounded task fact. Disclose relevant prior tools, data and budgets.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A named bounded discovery/recovery or transfer proposition is being assessed; identify its exact claim target before using evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Select the claim target first. BOUNDED_TASK_RECOVERY passes when the declared output meets reliable task-specific criteria; it fails on a reliable contrary task check and is unknown if that outcome is not established. NOVELTY_OR_GENERALIZATION requires evidence for the advertised exposure/transfer claim. DATA_DRIVEN_DISCOVERY_MECHANISM requires controls separating use of observations from the specified retrieval/context-only alternative. Missing training provenance limits affected novelty/mechanism claims without automatically making an observed bounded task result UNKNOWN. INAPPLICABLE when no evaluated recovery/discovery claim is made.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.basis: ESI-RS0056 §§2–3/Appendix E; ESI-RS0057 §§2–4 and Appendix M

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Separate generated hypotheses from measurements; simulator/judge/fitter interfaces are part of the observation and evaluation contract
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: The actual protocol/model/evaluator versions, relevant inputs and outputs, declared task metric/horizon and reliable checks for the selected target. Add exposure controls, independent transfer tests, comparison baselines and total-cost evidence when those are required by the asserted novelty, mechanism, comparative or value claim; disclose failures/corrections relevant to that claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Bind the exact asserted target and actual information access; apply the corresponding claim-target rules retained in ESI-RPR0105. Report separate outcomes for separately asserted targets. Do not infer novelty from task success or negate directly observed task success solely because training provenance is opaque.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite evaluation can be executed; universal novelty, general reliability and physical mechanism truth are not decided by a benchmark
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: LLM-SRBench and Unsatz support bounded comparative evidence for their disclosed tasks and protocols
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Unsatz reports executable poor models, hidden-variable counts without correct dynamics, and revisions that worsen held-out outcomes; good training fit is not discovery
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Material outcome/oracle evidence is missing for the selected bounded task, or exposure, transfer or mechanism evidence is insufficient for the separately asserted broader target. Independent replication and physical testing are required only to the extent warranted by the actual claim; unknown training provenance alone does not erase directly checked task recovery.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: LLM outputs are explicitly treated as unverified candidate proposals
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False pass from memorized tasks or privileged fitter; false negative from unsuitable grammar/budget rather than all-model incapacity
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Count agent activity, compilable programs or cherry-picked successful episodes as general discovery
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Model/prompt/tool/oracle/task exposure or resource policy changes require new validation
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Use simple fitting/non-LLM search when enough; account for human correction and experiment costs
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Bounded benchmark or experiment support only; no general autonomous physical-law identification claim established
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: BOUNDED_CLAIM_SUPPORT: SupportedDiscovery scope/evidence match, not universal autonomous capability
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.reason: Allocate the actual SupportedDiscovery assessment to FR20, preserving the general capability candidate in FR19. Refine unknown-training-provenance handling by B65’s separate claim targets.
RECONCILIATION_OPERATIVE_CHANGE.changed_case: A directly checked bounded task result may PASS BOUNDED_TASK_RECOVERY while novelty and data-dependent-discovery attribution remain UNKNOWN. A blanket UNKNOWN merely from opaque training provenance is not imposed on the directly observed task fact.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: LLM-assisted equation discovery requires contamination, evaluator and hypothesis-provenance controls — evaluate the precisely scoped claim, including its rejection where applicable.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: LLMDiscoveryClaimSupported(search, data, novelty_controls, evaluator, validation); claim_target in {BOUNDED_TASK_RECOVERY,NOVELTY_OR_GENERALIZATION,DATA_DRIVEN_DISCOVERY_MECHANISM} with a precise proposition and scope
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Model versions, counts, time/cost, NMSE and categorical equivalence judgments. Attribute ESI-RAT0155 supplies the structured arguments.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Only the declared model, input/observation regime, horizon and claim scope. FR022’s best 31.53% symbolic score refers to LSR-Transform, not an aggregate exact-recovery rate across all 239 problems.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: An LLM-assisted equation search and its evaluation
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Epistemic acceptance at the specified version; it is not a temporal safety invariant unless a cited theorem explicitly says so. Evidence remains valid only within its stated horizon and assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Training contamination cannot be ruled out merely by transformation; evaluation needs domain validity, independent data and reliable equivalence checks.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A language model is credited with discovering scientific equations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Select and state the exact recovery, novelty/generalization or discovery-mechanism proposition; use CLAIM_TARGET_EVALUATION_RULES. A task may pass a bounded metric while novelty remains UNKNOWN. Which held-out test would distinguish a plausible program from the correct mechanism?
What correction and experiment cost was paid?

A language-model judge is a mathematical proof oracle.

An LLM-assisted equation search and its evaluation is assessed using the validation falsification profile. Specific scope: FR022’s best 31.53% symbolic score refers to LSR-Transform, not an aggregate exact-recovery rate across all 239 problems.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Agent-assisted identification: final-model evaluation and search reproducibility

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: The agent combines existing identification model families with autonomous coding/search; no new generic identifiability theorem follows from orchestration.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: autonomous coding agent; model search; cross-validation; test leakage; reproducibility
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: An agent can reduce manual model-search work, but competitive final scores support only the evaluated search pipeline; test access, search variability and final-model reproducibility must be treated separately.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A nominally held-out test is visible in logs, or a reproducible final model is treated as proof that the search process is reproducible and unbiased.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: The agent searches model/code choices on two plant benchmarks, while IV-A–E acknowledges test visibility and search reproducibility limitations.
LOCATORS: Section III-A cascaded tanks
Section III-B and Table I nanodrone
Section IV-A logged test information
Sections IV-B–E search/process reproducibility and methodological limits
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Two cases and limited search comparison; equal iterations do not equal total cost. All technical judgments are version-bound to v1; no claim that paper remained unpublished as of cutoff.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.CLAIM: Public benchmark/leaderboard protocols contextualize plant-model comparison; they are not independent replications of agentic search.
LOCATORS: Section 4 baseline normalization and lag choices
GP training cap of first 1000 samples
Section 5/Table 6: baseline simulation errors and unstable PNARX case
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.ACCESS_CEILING: Off-the-shelf baseline study; no claim of maximally tuned model-family ranking. Leaderboard admission can censor weak methods.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current vocabulary or guarantees backward. Agent helping identify a plant is different from identifying an agent’s hidden internals.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Preserve actual information access during agentic model/code search, evaluate a frozen result independently for an independent-generalization claim, and distinguish reproducibility of that exported model from repeatability of the stochastic search process.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: An agent-controlled identification workflow
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A nominally held-out test is visible in logs, or a reproducible final model is treated as proof that the search process is reproducible and unbiased.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Bind the selected claim and actual information access, freeze/version the final executable artifact and evaluate its named bounded result. For independent generalization, insulate fresh final evaluation from selection. For repeated-search claims, record agent/tool/prompt versions, selection rules, run variation and total costs, and assess repeated searches separately from executing one saved model.

Test visibility limits the interpretation of selection evidence without making every observed task result meaningless; an instruction not to use visible metrics is not access isolation. The existing predicate explicitly selects BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT, INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION or REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY before applying evidence conditions. Honest exposed-benchmark evidence can PASS its own bounded target; isolation and repeated-run conditions apply only to the targets that need them. No source result or evidence category is upgraded.

Keep access categories, version identifiers, iterations, compute/time and metric units. The existing agent-search access/reproducibility attribute supplies the relevant structured arguments for the selected target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT is bound to the named artifact, data, execution/training protocol, environment and measured criterion. INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION is bound to the stated evaluation population, inferential unit, horizon and selection boundary. REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY is bound to the declared search versions, run population, budgets and reproducibility/distribution criterion. Helping identify a plant does not identify an agent’s hidden internals.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: An agent-controlled identification workflow
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Epistemic acceptance at the specified version; it is not a temporal safety invariant unless a cited theorem explicitly says so. Evidence remains valid only within its stated horizon and assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Choose the actual claim target. BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT requires the final model/data/execution protocol and reliable evidence for the named metric or repeatability criterion, with actual benchmark access disclosed. INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION additionally requires a justified fresh evaluation boundary insulated from selection and matched to the claimed population/horizon. REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY requires versioned repeated-search evidence for its declared run population, budgets and criterion. Missing evidence affects only the target that needs it.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An agent writes, trains or selects identification models and a bounded final-artifact result, independent-generalization claim or repeated-search reproducibility claim is assessed. Disclosed benchmark exposure does not suppress assessment of a bounded result.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: First select the asserted target. For BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT, verify the versioned model/data/protocol, reliable measured result and any actually claimed repeatability, while disclosing exposure; a fresh insulated holdout is not a requirement for an honestly bounded exposed-benchmark statement. For INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION, additionally establish final selection before fresh insulated evaluation and the target-matched performance criterion. For REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY, require actual repeated searches and process/version/resource evidence for the stated run criterion; rerunning one saved model cannot establish it. Use target-specific FAIL and UNKNOWN rules, and never borrow PASS from another target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: RESEARCHER_RECONSTRUCTION of a guarded evaluation rule from the cited sources; not represented as a source-authored formula. Exact source theorem/identity terms, when used, are identified by source and locator.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Trace actual information access instead of relying on a textual prohibition. Bind and check final-artifact execution or training only to the extent claimed; perform independent generalization evaluation or repeated search trials only for the corresponding asserted target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Record the selected claim target and the relevant components of {agent/version, tools/prompts, writable code, selection metric, visible logs/test data, search budget, run seeds, final artifact, evaluation freeze}. For bounded artifact evidence, require the model/data/protocol/runtime and reliable metric or claimed repeatability record; require selection isolation for independent generalization and actual repeated-run/process records for repeated-search reproducibility. Preserve unsupported broader conclusions as such.

STEPS: Establish the modifying/selecting agent context and identify every actually asserted target.
Bind artifact, data, protocol, metric and access evidence relevant to the selected target; do not require unrelated search details for a directly checked artifact claim.
Apply that target’s evidence boundary and outcome rules.
Keep final-model execution/training repeatability, independent generalization and repeated-search reproducibility separate.
Return a named outcome with decisive evidence and remaining limits; if multiple targets are asserted, return separate outcomes.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The evidence establishes the selected target at its declared scope: a reliable bounded frozen-artifact result/repeatability check, a properly insulated independent-generalization evaluation, or the advertised repeated-search criterion demonstrated by appropriate repeated runs. Honest disclosed benchmark exposure does not prevent PASS for the bounded artifact target.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: A reliable execution/metric counterexample contradicts the bounded claim; exposure contradicts claimed independent evaluation; actual repeated-search evidence contradicts its criterion; or final-artifact reruns are misrepresented as completed repeated-search evidence. The latter two evidential-category failures defeat the named warrant, not automatically the underlying model performance or search reproducibility.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Material evidence for the selected target is unestablished: artifact/data/protocol or metric reliability for a bounded result; access isolation/population evidence for independent generalization; or repeated runs and relevant process/version/variation evidence for repeated-search reproducibility. Unrelated missing search detail does not erase a fully checked bounded artifact result.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No agent modifies or selects the identification pipeline, or no claim concerning its final artifact, generalization or search reproducibility is being assessed.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: FR024 yields executable trained model pipelines which can be evaluated after the LLM is removed; this is a narrower reproducibility target.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: FR024 IV-A acknowledges logged test metrics that may influence reasoning; Table I also contains short-horizon cells where ASIA is not best.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Material evidence for the selected target is unestablished: artifact/data/protocol or metric reliability for a bounded result; access isolation/population evidence for independent generalization; or repeated runs and relevant process/version/variation evidence for repeated-search reproducibility. Unrelated missing search detail does not erase a fully checked bounded artifact result.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No agent modifies or selects the identification pipeline, or no claim concerning its final artifact, generalization or search reproducibility is being assessed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: exposure is mislabeled independent evaluation, or rerunning a saved model is mislabeled repeated search. False negative: an honestly disclosed, directly verified bounded artifact result is withheld solely because it lacks an independent holdout or reproducible hosted search. Each target requires its own evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: An attribute’s existence, a source citation or a small aggregate metric is not satisfaction. Autonomous model search makes expert judgment unnecessary.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Changed agent weights, prompts, tool environment, data access or validation policy invalidates the process comparison.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: LLM calls, training jobs, failed code, human oversight and full search variance. Cheaper path: A fixed candidate family with random/Bayesian search is adequate and easier to reproduce.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: The original two benchmark cases, logged test visibility, limited comparison, opaque priors and evolving hosted-model limits remain. No agent search or plant experiment was rerun in this reconciliation. A bounded artifact PASS is not an empirical upgrade to independent generalization, repeated-search reproducibility, universal superiority or general savings in human effort.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: EVIDENCE_WARRANT_FOR_SELECTED_CLAIM: the evidence supports the explicitly selected BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT, INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION or REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY claim at its declared scope.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ACTUAL_EVALUATION_STATUS: EXTERNAL_TARGET_NOT_EVALUATED; constructed and source-reported witnesses are separate evidence.

BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT.TARGET: The specified frozen model achieves the directly observed named benchmark result or satisfies a stated execution/training-repeatability criterion on the declared data and environment.
BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT.PASS: Reliable versioned execution and correctly computed metrics establish the stated bounded result; repeatability is checked to the extent actually claimed. Fully disclosed exposed-benchmark selection is compatible with this PASS.
BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT.FAIL: Actual execution, metric or repeatability evidence contradicts the named bounded criterion.
BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT.UNKNOWN: The artifact, data, relevant runtime/training procedure, metric or required repeatability evidence is missing or unreliable.
BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT.LIMIT: No independent generalization, repeated-search reproducibility, universal superiority or general labor saving follows.

INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION.TARGET: The evaluation evidence warrants the specifically claimed independent prospective-generalization conclusion.
INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION.PASS: Final selection is fixed before a fresh evaluation whose data/results are insulated from selection, and the evaluation supports the claimed scope, inferential unit, horizon and criterion.
INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION.FAIL: Known test-result access contradicts the asserted independence, or a valid target-matched evaluation contradicts the advertised performance criterion. Exposure FAILs independence warrant, not the truth of all possible generalization.
INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION.UNKNOWN: Access, freeze chronology, evaluator reliability, target population or required generalization evidence is unresolved.
INDEPENDENT_GENERALIZATION.LIMIT: An honest exposed-benchmark result belongs to BOUNDED_FINAL_ARTIFACT; prompts forbidding use do not establish inaccessible information.

REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY.TARGET: Repeated searches under the declared pipeline, version/resource conditions and run population meet the advertised reproducibility or outcome-distribution criterion.
REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY.PASS: Appropriate repeated-search runs and versioned process/resource records establish that criterion, including claimed run variation.
REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY.FAIL: Actual repeated-search evidence contradicts the criterion, or artifact-only repetitions are falsely represented as completed repeated-search trials. The latter is failure of evidence warrant; it does not prove that repeated search could never reproduce.
REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY.UNKNOWN: Only a saved artifact or insufficient repeated-search/process evidence is available and the missing repeated-run evidence is honestly acknowledged.
REPEATED_SEARCH_REPRODUCIBILITY.LIMIT: Execution of the same frozen artifact is not another stochastic search; repeated-search results do not establish independent generalization without that target’s separate evaluation boundary.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATION_PRIORITY_RULE: Check the agent/claim context, then select the exact target before applying any test-isolation or repeated-run condition. If the target itself is unspecified, the judgment is UNKNOWN. A decisive applicable contradiction or established misrepresentation of the selected warrant yields FAIL; established target-specific evidence yields PASS; otherwise missing material evidence yields UNKNOWN. Unasserted broader targets cannot veto a bounded PASS, and a bounded PASS cannot establish them.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Conditional forcing, autonomous closure and causal interpretation

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: HAVOK explicitly combines delay coordinates, SINDy regression and Koopman-inspired forced dynamics. The inspected2016 preprint and2017 journal descendant remain distinct access identities.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: delay coordinate; forcing; closure; residual; conditional prediction
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: A residual or learned forcing term may represent unresolved endogenous dynamics; prediction conditional on newly measured forcing must not be described as autonomous prediction from an initial state alone.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Endogenous closure error is called an exogenous physical cause, or future information is silently supplied through forcing.

Section 6: synthesis

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.RECONCILED_MECHANISM_AND_TARGET_DISTINCT: Keep B-only row with signed time offsets, reconstruction and observation dependence. A useful forced model is not a failed autonomous model when conditional monitoring is the intended task.

STEPS: Check applicability before substantive evaluation.
Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.
Apply the specific operational rule and inspect the stated counterexample class.
Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The claim is explicitly conditional on available forcing, or a validated forcing forecast closes the requested horizon; causal interpretation has its own evidence.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: Future/validation measurements are supplied while autonomous prediction is claimed, or a coordinate residual is labeled exogenous without support.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Forcing provenance, timing or closure is undocumented.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No learned forcing or residual input is used.

Bind the attribute record to actual versions and classify observed versus assumed components.

Return one outcome with the decisive evidence and remaining scope.

OUTCOMES.PASS: The model option remains preferable under the agreed uncertainty/sensitivity range and satisfies required nonmonetary constraints.
OUTCOMES.FAIL: An adequate cheaper alternative dominates, or plausible cost/consequence evidence reverses the claimed value without acknowledgement.
OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: Decision benefit, total cost or reuse horizon is too uncertain to distinguish options.
OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No material model-investment or continuation decision exists.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: A finite protocol audit or numerical comparison is decidable for supplied artifacts; universal continuous-domain equality, causal uniqueness or physical correspondence may require theorem reasoning and need not be decidable from finite data. Numerical checks establish only their sampled/bounded claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: FR025 explicitly allows comparison among data tracking, simple regression and a digital twin.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: A detailed twin is maintained after the original decision disappears, while its metrics improve but no consumer uses them.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No material model-investment or continuation decision exists.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Data are informative for the specified property or common controller
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: informative(D, Sigma, P) or stabilizing_gain(D,Sigma,K)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: D is finite exact input-state data in the LTI example; Sigma a class; K a feedback gain with input/state units
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For all S in nonempty Sigma_D, P(S); for control, there exists one K such that for all S in Sigma_D, P(S,K).
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: informative(D, Sigma, P) or stabilizing_gain(D,Sigma,K)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: The data are finite; the stability claim is an infinite-time property of every compatible model under fixed feedback.

ASSUMPTIONS.MODEL_CERTIFICATE: A defined nonempty set of models consistent with the declared exact/noisy data and one fixed quantified property; control uses one common realizable K within the mathematical decision class.
ASSUMPTIONS.EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION: Separate evidence must establish actual-system inclusion, measurement/noise assumptions and physical realizability before transferring the model certificate.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A bounded analysis/control objective can be evaluated over a compatible-system set.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: Sigma_D != empty and Sigma_D subseteq Sigma_P; for stabilization, exists K: forall (A,B) in Sigma_D, spectral_radius(A+B*K)<1.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Informativity definition source-defined in ESI-RS0214 Definition 1; explicit nonemptiness guard and four-outcome wrapper are researcher additions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Bind recorded inputs/states, time alignment and noise to the matrices defining consistency.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Declared class, data, verified consistency/noise assumptions and a common certificate; external inclusion evidence assessed separately. State whether the selected claim is MODEL_CERTIFICATE or EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION; do not use missing empirical mapping to negate an exact model proof.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.PASS: A sound proof/certificate establishes the quantified claim on a nonempty compatible set.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.FAIL: For a fixed K, an admissible compatible model violates the property; existential failure needs a complete impossibility result.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.UNKNOWN: A nonempty compatible set or common quantified certificate is unestablished; a failed solver search alone does not show impossibility.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.INAPPLICABLE: No well-defined common property/decision or outside the selected model family.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The inspected noiseless LTI state-feedback case has rank/LMI characterizations; no universal solver asserted for arbitrary models or properties.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: ESI-RCA0112: a=b+1/2 for all consistent scalar models and K=-1 makes the closed-loop coefficient 1/2.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: If all-zero observations leave arbitrary unstable uncontrollable scalar models admissible, the desired stabilization certificate need not exist.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: A nonempty compatible set or common quantified certificate is unestablished; a failed solver search alone does not show impossibility. Unknown physical meaning, actual-system membership or measurement assumptions leaves EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION unknown, not a proved MODEL_CERTIFICATE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: An interpretive institutional account lacking a defined system class and decision property.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_positive: Exclude the real plant by an unjustified noise bound, or use a different K for each model.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_negative: Demand unique identification even though one common K exists.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Empty model sets make universal inclusion vacuous; per-model controllers do not establish a common controller.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Reassess after changing model class, data policy, observation map, noise description, objective or actuator envelope.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: A small model set or direct certificate may be cheaper than unique identification; robust feasibility can also be more conservative/computationally costly.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: A conditional mathematical guarantee; no authority, safety during learning, optimality for another objective or external plant validity follows.

MODEL_CERTIFICATE.PASS: A sound proof/certificate establishes the quantified claim on a nonempty compatible set.
MODEL_CERTIFICATE.FAIL: For a fixed K, an admissible compatible model violates the property; existential failure needs a complete impossibility result.
MODEL_CERTIFICATE.UNKNOWN: A nonempty compatible set or common quantified certificate is unestablished; a failed solver search alone does not show impossibility.
MODEL_CERTIFICATE.INAPPLICABLE: No well-defined common property/decision or outside the selected model family.

EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION.PASS: The model certificate passes and independent evidence establishes all material correspondence, inclusion, noise and realization premises for the particular external claim.
EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION.FAIL: A reliable external witness contradicts the asserted correspondence, membership or application consequence.
EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION.UNKNOWN: External inclusion/correspondence or another material transfer premise is unestablished, even if the mathematical certificate is proved.
EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_APPLICATION.INAPPLICABLE: Only the explicitly mathematical model theorem is asserted; no external application claim is requested.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.RULE: Each predicate decides its explicitly named proposition. Applicability, model truth, external warrant, retention and completion are separate axes. There is no default AND across alternatives or inherited variants.

bearer.value: Component Dirac structures, storage and dissipative relations.

original_problem.value: Modular physical modeling with algebraic constraints and energy exchange.

claim.value: Within a justified port-Hamiltonian model, compatible power-conserving interconnection preserves the structural class.

mechanism.value: Compose dual port relations with common effort/opposite flow and sum component storage.

consumer.value: Modeler needing energy/passivity structure across a physical interconnection.

historical_attribution.value: Port modeling and geometric control tradition; inspected 2007 original composition proof and 2020 contributor exposition.

value: Both component relations are Dirac structures for the specified pairing

environment_boundary.value: The exact interconnection/model class; measured correspondence not supplied by the theorem.

exclusions.value: No arbitrary software-property composition theorem; no all-context stability guarantee.

trigger.value: Physical components have justified compatible port structure.

non_trigger_or_cheap_path.value: Small conservation equations suffice when no modular closure consumer exists.

authority.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: mathematical relation provides no change authority.

input_provenance.value: Component equations, units, port orientation, storage and dissipative sign convention.

cost.value: Constructing geometry, constraints and valid physical correspondences; unnecessary for some simple consumers.

currentness.value: Recheck after port-sign/unit changes, new components, altered pairing or structural reduction.

positive_witness.value: ESI-X-RT17 correct orientation cancels internal power; the source theorem gives full structural closure beyond this scalar calculation.

negative_witness.value: ESI-X-RT17 wrong orientation adds 12 units of internal power in the constructed port pair.

nontrigger_witness.value: A lookup table predicting a bounded sensor value has no port-composition obligation.

uncertainty.value: Port variables and energy functions may be model assumptions rather than measured quantities.

strongest_criticism.value: The physical meaning and sufficiency of energy variables are not guaranteed by elegant structural closure.

evidence_ceiling.value: Class closure and energy accounting in a model; not identification, empirical adequacy, asymptotic stability or authority.

next_discriminator.value: Check the port relation and then separately check the claimed physical/stability consequence.

dependencies.value: Complements physical priors but can conflict with a representation that loses shared constraints.

records.title: Rejected universal superiority of direct or model-free control

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Rejected universal superiority of direct or model-free control

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: A research-admitted overgeneralization exposed by modern direct/indirect comparisons; not attributed to a specific author as an endorsed slogan.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: direct and indirect data-driven control
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Prefer a direct method universally because it omits explicit identification.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Avoid mismatch between fitting and control objectives.
GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: The universal slogan is the researcher’s adversarial candidate, not a quotation from the cited authors.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Candidate under criticism: omission of an explicit model guarantees lower cost or superior control across tasks.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A comparative method-choice claim.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Identification effort or objective mismatch, as claimed by the promotion.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Purported removal of a modeling step; actual formulations may encode identification in regularization.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: NO_GENERAL_PROPERTY: retain formulation-specific comparison and ESI-RC-RT10’s bounded alternative.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Purported universal efficiency/performance gain.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Not supported generally; source comparisons and relaxation analysis give contrary/context-dependent evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Method selector.
ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Identification then control with useful uncertainty
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CANONICAL_COMMON_AND_DISTINCT_CONTENT: B separately examines the claimed superiority of avoiding an explicit model. Preserve direct/indirect regularization, relaxation and cost tradeoffs, and distinguish no named parametric model from absence of modeling assumptions.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A universal adoption claim is based on method labels.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: A bounded demonstrated direct method needs no refutation of all indirect alternatives.
ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Valid comparator and matched information/tuning access
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Exact comparator, task class, data and loss.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Rejection is not a verdict against the entire direct-control family.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: NOT_APPLICABLE: comparative evidence supplies no authorization.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Full method and benchmark/tuning provenance, including failed trials.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: Conflicts with evidence showing noise, bias and computational trade-offs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Unmatched comparisons make the universal ranking uninterpretable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Complex data constraints and regularizers may exceed a compact model’s cost.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Retire universal promotion; re-enter only as a specified bounded comparison.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: The actual direct/indirect optimization, information budget and consumer loss.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: Comparative control study
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.VALUE_TYPE_AND_DOMAIN: Named methods, common tasks and declared noise/tuning/cost conditions
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Loss units and resource units must be declared separately
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Named methods, common tasks and declared noise/tuning/cost conditions
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.QUANTITATIVE_OR_QUALITATIVE: Structured/formal with quantitative components where the declared variable units require them.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.OBSERVED_DERIVED_ASSUMED_OR_STIPULATED: Schema stipulated here; subject values must be observed or derived with the method below, never inherited from this research.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MEASUREMENT_OR_DERIVATION_METHOD: Inspect objectives, constraints, tuning access and realized performance; labels alone are not measurements.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.RESOLUTION_AND_UNCERTAINTY: Exact symbolic objects when supplied exactly; numeric rank or equality requires an explicit tolerance and error bound.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MISSING_UNKNOWN_NOT_APPLICABLE_DISTINCTI: MISSING: object not supplied; UNKNOWN: supplied but its relevant semantics/correspondence not established; NOT_APPLICABLE: bearer is outside the declared property class.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.CHANGE_IMPACT: A changed baseline, dataset or tuning budget invalidates superiority claims.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Universal superiority from the direct/model-free label
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: universally_dominates(direct_method,indirect_method,declared_task_class,loss,cost)
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Tasks in a fixed class; paired methods using comparable information; loss/cost with declared units
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admissible task, direct loss/cost is no worse under the declared ordering.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: universally_dominates(direct_method,indirect_method,declared_task_class,loss,cost)

ASSUMPTIONS: Task class and ordering specified
Valid comparator and matched information/tuning access
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An advocate asserts universal direct-method superiority.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For all tasks t in T: direct(t) dominates_or_equals indirect(t) under the predeclared order; one valid violating t refutes the assertion.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher reconstruction of a criticized universal claim, not a source-endorsed theorem.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Bind task outcomes to implementations, data, tuning, noise and consumer loss; count failures and costs.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: A complete universal argument for PASS, or a valid comparative countercase for FAIL.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.PASS: Only a sound argument for the entire stated class; no such result is established here.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.FAIL: A valid task in the stated class reverses the asserted dominance.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.UNKNOWN: Only favorable case studies or incomparable budgets are supplied.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.INAPPLICABLE: The claim is only a bounded feasibility result or no universal comparison is made.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: No general finite empirical decision procedure for an unrestricted universal class; falsification is asymmetric.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: A bounded exact-data equivalence may establish equal solutions for its own formulations; it cannot witness this unrestricted superiority claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: ESI-RS0218 §V-D: under the paper’s noisy LTI comparison, the direct method degrades more than the specified indirect method.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing baseline code, tuning budget, task membership, uncertainty or cost.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A researcher explicitly claims one bounded useful direct construction without comparative superiority.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_positive: Compare a tuned direct method to a knowingly misspecified/undertuned baseline.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_negative: A failure of one formulation is generalized to all direct methods.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Select a task denominator after seeing results or omit infeasible/noisy cases.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Compare the cheapest adequate qualified methods; do not run broad benchmarks merely to decide a small local task.

RECONCILIATION.reverse_inference_withheld: Shared claim vocabulary or a restricted PASS does not establish the stronger ancestor claim, universal usefulness, external truth or mandatory adoption.

original_problem.value: Avoid mismatch between fitting and control objectives.

claim.value: Candidate under criticism: omission of an explicit model guarantees lower cost or superior control across tasks.

mechanism.value: Purported removal of a modeling step; actual formulations may encode identification in regularization.

consumer.value: Method selector.

historical_attribution.value: A research-admitted overgeneralization exposed by modern direct/indirect comparisons; not attributed to a specific author as an endorsed slogan.

value: Valid comparator and matched information/tuning access

environment_boundary.value: Exact comparator, task class, data and loss.

exclusions.value: Rejection is not a verdict against the entire direct-control family.

trigger.value: A universal adoption claim is based on method labels.

non_trigger_or_cheap_path.value: A bounded demonstrated direct method needs no refutation of all indirect alternatives.

authority.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: comparative evidence supplies no authorization.

input_provenance.value: Full method and benchmark/tuning provenance, including failed trials.

cost.value: Complex data constraints and regularizers may exceed a compact model’s cost.

currentness.value: New methods or changed budgets require a new bounded comparison; existing counterexample still refutes the old universal statement.

positive_witness.value: A bounded exact-data equivalence may establish equal solutions for its own formulations; it cannot witness this unrestricted superiority claim.

negative_witness.value: ESI-S-RT007 §V-D: under the paper’s noisy LTI comparison, the direct method degrades more than the specified indirect method.

nontrigger_witness.value: Use direct scalar certificate ESI-X-RT16 for its stated task without any universal superiority claim.

uncertainty.value: Unreported human tuning and collection costs leave efficiency unknown.

strongest_criticism.value: Direct formulations can have implicit identification, noisy vacuity, larger data requirements and unfavorable variance.

evidence_ceiling.value: Rejection of the universal promotion, not rejection of direct data-driven control.

next_discriminator.value: Compare candidates on the relevant noise, operating regime, cost and control loss.

value: Identification then control with useful uncertainty

dependencies.value: Conflicts with evidence showing noise, bias and computational trade-offs.

signature.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Universal superiority from the direct/model-free label
signature.SUBJECT_AND_ARGUMENT_SIGNATURE: universally_dominates(direct_method,indirect_method,declared_task_class,loss,cost)
signature.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Tasks in a fixed class; paired methods using comparable information; loss/cost with declared units
signature.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admissible task, direct loss/cost is no worse under the declared ordering.
signature.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: universally_dominates(direct_method,indirect_method,declared_task_class,loss,cost)
signature.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Universal comparative hypothesis; a finite contrary task can refute it, finite favorable tasks cannot establish it.
ASSUMPTIONS: Task class and ordering specified
Valid comparator and matched information/tuning access
signature.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An advocate asserts universal direct-method superiority.
signature.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For all tasks t in T: direct(t) dominates_or_equals indirect(t) under the predeclared order; one valid violating t refutes the assertion.
signature.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher reconstruction of a criticized universal claim, not a source-endorsed theorem.
signature.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Bind task outcomes to implementations, data, tuning, noise and consumer loss; count failures and costs.
signature.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: A complete universal argument for PASS, or a valid comparative countercase for FAIL.

EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.PASS: Only a sound argument for the entire stated class; no such result is established here.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.FAIL: A valid task in the stated class reverses the asserted dominance.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.UNKNOWN: Only favorable case studies or incomparable budgets are supplied.
EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE.INAPPLICABLE: The claim is only a bounded feasibility result or no universal comparison is made.

signature.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: No general finite empirical decision procedure for an unrestricted universal class; falsification is asymmetric.
signature.POSITIVE_WITNESS: A bounded exact-data equivalence may establish equal solutions for its own formulations; it cannot witness this unrestricted superiority claim.
signature.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: ESI-S-RT007 §V-D: under the paper’s noisy LTI comparison, the direct method degrades more than the specified indirect method.
signature.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing baseline code, tuning budget, task membership, uncertainty or cost.
signature.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: A researcher explicitly claims one bounded useful direct construction without comparative superiority.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_positive: Compare a tuned direct method to a knowingly misspecified/undertuned baseline.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.false_negative: A failure of one formulation is generalized to all direct methods.

signature.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Select a task denominator after seeing results or omit infeasible/noisy cases.
signature.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: New methods or changed budgets require a new bounded comparison; existing counterexample still refutes the old universal statement.
signature.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Compare the cheapest adequate qualified methods; do not run broad benchmarks merely to decide a small local task.
signature.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Rejection of the universal promotion, not rejection of direct data-driven control.

predicates.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: The unqualified candidate that positive-only observations suffice for exact recovery of every regular behavior is rejected. The retained constraint is to state class, presentation, equivalence and success criterion before claiming identifiability. Scope: Languages of strings; deployed state/time semantics are outside the theorem unless represented and justified.
predicates.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A language-learning problem (target class, evidence presentation, learner, equivalence and convergence criterion).
predicates.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. A change in class, presentation, oracle or success criterion invalidates the prior learnability judgment.
predicates.ASSUMPTIONS: The negative theorem uses arbitrary positive texts and eventual exact identification of each member; altered probability, presentation or target class requires separate analysis.
predicates.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: An exact/general reconstruction claim is based only on accepted traces with an unrestricted superfinite candidate class.
predicates.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: If class is superfinite, presentation is arbitrary positive text, and claim is eventual exact identification for every class member, mark that recovery claim unsupported and retain ambiguity. PASS means this limit is represented accurately; FAIL means universal recovery is asserted; UNKNOWN means class/presentation are unspecified; INAPPLICABLE means no general exact-recovery claim.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.rationale: Operational rule derived from the source-supported limit/mechanism; not claimed as a verbatim theorem or universally mandatory process.

predicates.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Keep accepted examples, evidence presentation contract, allowed target class and the precise output equivalence criterion.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Formal problem statement and domain restriction, challenged with alternative targets.
Inspect data-generation contract; distinguish accepted-only log from explicit negative labels.
Keep accepted examples, evidence presentation contract, allowed target class and the precise output equivalence criterion.
predicates.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: First establish applicability. Inspect the two attributes and source witnesses; challenge the claim using the negative example; determine whether the stated supported condition, an actual breach, or unresolved evidence is present. Apply the explicit outcome semantics below.
predicates.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Qualified impossibility and constructed ambiguity; no blanket impossibility of useful inference or human language learning. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
predicates.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: observations {a, aa} fit both finite language {a, aa} and a+. Recording both and withholding unique recovery passes the evidential limit.
predicates.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: declaring a+ uniquely recovered from {a, aa} fails because {a, aa} remains consistent.
predicates.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Which restricted classes and observation regimes fit a particular task remains target-dependent. Also unknown when a load-bearing field is missing or assumptions cannot be checked.
predicates.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Known finite target alternatives with a proven distinguishing presentation, or a task requiring only a finite observed-trace summary.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: Treating a restrictive sample promise as arbitrary text can falsely reject a valid restricted result.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Failing to recognize an implicit superfinite hypothesis class can allow an impossible universal promise.

predicates.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Stating “bounded model” without specifying the allowed alternatives hides the unrestricted premise.
predicates.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: A change in class, presentation, oracle or success criterion invalidates the prior learnability judgment.
predicates.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Enumerating all alternatives is generally unnecessary; a small counterexample pair can refute an unjustified uniqueness claim. Cheaper route: Informant data; exact or approximate active queries; prior restriction of target class; prediction on a bounded input distribution; retain multiple compatible candidates.
predicates.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Qualified impossibility and constructed ambiguity; no blanket impossibility of useful inference or human language learning.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The precise scoped operational rule is satisfied with sufficient stated evidence; does not imply stronger truth, universality or adoption.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.FAIL: A valid witness or directly established mismatch contradicts that operational rule in its applicable context.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: The guard may apply but evidence, mapping, premise or computation is insufficient; this is neither pass nor logical negation.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: The declared guard is false; use the named non-trigger route rather than treating absence as failure.

predicates.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Let M_a=a(M), where a is the declared output observation map. If M_a∈F_a and T is F_a-complete for H in the same abstract-output semantics, then [∀w∈T: out_H(w)=out_M_a(w)] ⇒ H≡M_a. For identity abstraction this reduces to the native same-domain statement. Raw membership M∈F and raw completeness do not suffice after changing outputs.
predicates.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Finite input traces over the specified abstraction and implementation version; no claim over unmodeled timing, clients or data relations.
predicates.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Finite input traces at the named version; no counterexample within T is a bounded past finding unless the conditional theorem extends it.
predicates.ASSUMPTIONS: Known common input alphabet, output semantics and initial/reset convention; a defines a deterministic complete abstract machine of the required class; target M_a belongs to F_a and T is complete for H relative to F_a. If abstraction changes these conditions, prove a corresponding transport before using the theorem.
predicates.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A learner announces success because an oracle callback or conformance suite found no counterexample.
predicates.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For output abstraction a, let M_a=a(M). If M_a belongs to F_a and T is F_a-complete for H, agreement of H and M_a on every w in T warrants H≡M_a. Raw-target membership M∈F or raw completeness alone cannot discharge abstract premises. Evaluate only the named facet. Exact equivalence is universal over the selected behavior domain. A finite suite establishes finite agreement; it entails full equivalence only under the stated fault-domain completeness theorem. Sampling errors remain distribution-relative.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: BH027 Definitions 2.7 and 3.1 apply completeness and membership to the same compared machine. The abstracted form and four-valued wrapper are present reconstructions and require the explicit same-semantics guard.

OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect teacher implementation/proof or statistical design, including counterexample and no-counterexample meanings.
Derive domain assumptions and completeness certificate; record tested traces and any privileged stopping oracle.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Known common input alphabet, output semantics and initial/reset convention; a defines a deterministic complete abstract machine of the required class; target M_a belongs to F_a and T is complete for H relative to F_a. If abstraction changes these conditions, prove a corresponding transport before using the theorem.
Explicit observation map, domain membership witness, completeness proof and executed suite record using the same bearer.
A desired specification additionally needs independent normative authority.
predicates.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Bind H and M_a=a(M) to one alphabet, initial/reset convention and abstract-output semantics. Establish M_a∈F_a and the F_a-completeness of T for H in those same semantics, then check all suite outputs. Alternatively supply a proved transport of the native theorem through a. Without those premises report only observed agreement on T. Statistical testing retains its own distribution/error statement. Apply the selected equivalence/finite-agreement claim separately; the counterexample trace refutes equivalence without needing completeness.
predicates.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite suite agreement and finite certificates can be checked. Black-box equivalence outside a justified fault domain cannot be concluded from finite tests.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.DESCRIPTION: SOURCE-THEORETICAL: HSI/Wp satisfies the stated k-A completeness condition and an independently justified target lies in that domain.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.DESCRIPTION: H outputs 0; M outputs 1 then 2; a maps 1 to 0. T={z} is complete for the raw two-machine domain and the abstract test passes, but zz distinguishes H from a(M). The abstracted target is outside that raw domain.

predicates.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: No mismatch found but M_a∈F_a, same-semantics completeness, or reliable observation/reset is unestablished. A raw-domain certificate is insufficient after abstraction without a transport argument.
predicates.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The requested result is only a witnessed violation or a passive trace description, not conformance/equivalence.
predicates.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: A weak F excludes the very fault of concern; repeated random samples may miss rare/long counterexamples.
predicates.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A weak F excludes the very fault of concern; repeated random samples may miss rare/long counterexamples. A checker/diagram/oracle interface existing is never itself the property witness. Completeness, target membership and observed agreement must use one representation; switching only the observations invalidates the implication.
predicates.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Recheck after implementation/harness/alphabet/fault-domain or sampling-policy change.

predicates.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For the identified candidate, report, evidence version and declared domain, assess whether each reported evidential status and promotion is justified by available observations, falsifiers, proof results and disclosed premises. This quantifies report fidelity, not the truth of φ. Mined value invariants and temporal protocols remain distinct candidate languages. An accurate report of refutation or unresolved truth may satisfy this predicate.
predicates.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A report or promotion claim about candidate φ, together with its declared domain, executions, code, proof outcomes and assumptions.
predicates.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate the stated claim for the bound evidence/context at review time. Persistence is conditional on unchanged validity envelope; historical demonstration does not mean always/for all future subjects. Change to code, test distribution, template language or proof annotations reopens supporting evidence.
predicates.ASSUMPTIONS: Candidate meaning, instrumentation and provenance must be adequate to judge the particular report. Disclosed unknown premises can support an honest UNKNOWN report; their truth is not an entry requirement for this reporting assessment.
predicates.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A report or promotion claim about the evidential status of an inferred candidate is asserted, relied upon, or expressly assessed. This includes a reported exploratory, refuted, or UNKNOWN status; downstream promotion is not required. Missing evidence or unresolved premises do not by themselves make this guard false.
predicates.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: First identify the report/promotion claim R, candidate φ, declared domain and available evidence E. PASS when R faithfully states what E establishes, refutes or leaves UNKNOWN, including relevant scope limits, counterexamples, proof premises and unresolved conditions. Thus an honest refutation report can PASS while φ FAILs, and an honest UNKNOWN report can PASS while φ remains UNKNOWN. FAIL only on an established mismatch between R and E, such as suppressing a reliable falsifier, reporting an unsupported universal or normative promotion, or presenting a timeout as proof or refutation. A counterexample to φ is not by itself a counterexample to reporting fidelity. UNKNOWN when the meaning of R, provenance or evidence is insufficient to determine fidelity. INAPPLICABLE only when no report/promotion claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.rationale: Operational rule derived from the source-supported limit/mechanism; not claimed as a verbatim theorem or universally mandatory process.

predicates.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Bind the exact report/status and declared domain to the generator, source/build, program points, trace/test evidence and proof annotations; compare the claimed status with retained outcomes and disclosed limitations.
REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: The exact candidate, report/status or promotion claim, declared domain and versioned provenance linking the report to generating observations and inference rules.
Supporting and falsifying observations, challenge or proof outcomes, including inconclusive results, disclosed assumptions and any independent normative basis actually claimed.
Enough evidence to compare the report with what was actually observed or proved; an honest UNKNOWN report requires a documented limitation, not a proof of the candidate.
Generator template/prompt, source/build, variable/program point, trace/test generation and imposed verification annotations, to the extent load-bearing for the reported claim.
predicates.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Select reporting fidelity as the target before applying the guard. Establish what the report actually claims and compare it with evidence and known limits. Treat a candidate falsifier as evidence for an honest refutation report, and an inconclusive proof as evidence for an honest UNKNOWN report. Decide PASS or FAIL only for fidelity; use UNKNOWN when that comparison is unresolved and INAPPLICABLE only when the reporting target is absent.
predicates.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Useful candidate generation and conditional validation, not universal or normative completeness. The operational review is evidence-bounded; it must not claim a complete decision procedure beyond the selected model/theorem.
predicates.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: φ is x>0 over T={x=2,x=0}; retained x=0 refutes φ, and the report says REFUTED with that domain and witness. Reporting fidelity PASSes while candidate truth FAILs. Separately, a documented proof timeout accurately reported as UNKNOWN can PASS reporting while candidate truth remains UNKNOWN.
predicates.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: the report calls φ universally proved despite the retained in-domain x=0 falsifier, or calls a timeout proof of ¬φ. This mismatch FAILs reporting. The original incidental-bound example also FAILs reporting when tests only construct arrays of length 7–13 but the report promotes that range to all legal callers.
predicates.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: The report/promotion claim applies, but evidence or meaning is insufficient to establish either fidelity or a mismatch. If uncertainty itself is known and accurately disclosed without stronger promotion, reporting can PASS while candidate truth is UNKNOWN. Missing or unknown premises never make the guard false by themselves.
predicates.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No candidate-status report or promotion claim is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. A bare unreported proposal may follow the cheap exploratory route; an explicitly exploratory status report can still be assessed for fidelity.

FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_POSITIVE: Treating unchecked provenance, a shared test generator or unsafe proof premise as sufficient basis for a stronger report can produce a false reporting PASS.
FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS.FALSE_NEGATIVE: Failing an honest report merely because its candidate was refuted or remained unproved confuses reporting fidelity with candidate truth.

predicates.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Filtering away every difficult candidate yields an impressive acceptance rate without useful coverage.
predicates.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Change to code, test distribution, template language or proof annotations reopens supporting evidence.
predicates.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Instrumentation, candidate explosion, validation and expert review; target the few candidates the decision needs. Cheaper route: Write a small direct assertion from a requirement, inspect a known invariant, or retain a descriptive trace summary.
predicates.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Evidence-bounded fidelity of the identified report or promotion. Reporting PASS can coexist with candidate FAIL or UNKNOWN and supplies no independent normative authority.

EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.PASS: The report or promotion accurately describes available evidence, scope, proof premises and unresolved limits. Accurate reporting of a refuted or UNKNOWN candidate can PASS; candidate truth and normative adoption do not follow.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.FAIL: An established mismatch falsifies the reporting/promotion claim: for example a retained falsifier is hidden, an unsupported status leap is asserted, or timeout/UNKNOWN is reported as proof or refutation. A falsifier of φ alone does not FAIL an honest report.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: A reporting/promotion claim applies, but its meaning, evidence, mapping or provenance is insufficient to decide fidelity. A known unresolved premise can be reported accurately and does not automatically make reporting UNKNOWN.
EVALUATION_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No report or promotion claim about candidate status is asserted, relied upon or expressly assessed. Merely calling a report exploratory does not switch off a reporting-fidelity assessment.

predicates.EVALUATED_PROPOSITION: Fidelity of candidate promotion/status to available evidence
predicates.EVALUATION_FACET: As specifically named in EVALUATED_PROPOSITION; no implication to a different target.
predicates.EVALUATION_TARGET_PRIORITY: Apply the reporting/promotion target, its guard and its outcome rules together. Candidate truth is the distinct target in ESI-RPG-BH08-02; no candidate counterexample or inconclusive proof is automatically a reporting failure.
